en: I have a few questions about the math homework for tomorrow.
exzh: 我對明天的數學作業有幾個問題。
note: 接可數複數名詞；few 表「幾乎沒有」

en: Could you add a little sugar to my tea, please?
exzh: 可以請你在我的茶裡加一點糖嗎？
note: 接不可數名詞；little 表「幾乎沒有」

en: Lisa practices the piano a lot before every big contest.
exzh: Lisa 在每次大比賽前都會花很多時間練鋼琴。

en: Our first class starts at 8:10 a.m. every weekday.
exzh: 我們每個平日的第一堂課在上午八點十分開始。
note: 放在時間之後；下午用 p.m.

en: Ben was able to finish the long report before the deadline.
exzh: Ben 能夠在截止期限前完成那份很長的報告。
note: be able to＋原形動詞＝能夠

en: Our teacher told us a story about her trip to Japan.
exzh: 我們老師跟我們說了一個關於她去日本旅行的故事。

en: The clock above the blackboard is always five minutes fast.
exzh: 黑板上方的時鐘總是快五分鐘。

en: Emma hopes to study abroad in Canada after high school.
exzh: Emma 希望高中畢業後到加拿大留學。
note: study abroad＝出國留學；前面不加 to

en: Kevin was absent from school yesterday because he had a fever.
exzh: Kevin 昨天因為發燒沒來上學。

en: Mia accepted the invitation to join the school dance club.
exzh: Mia 接受了加入學校熱舞社的邀請。

en: There was a car accident near the MRT station this morning.
exzh: 今天早上捷運站附近發生了一起車禍。

en: Be careful when you walk across the busy street.
exzh: 你走過那條繁忙的街道時要小心。

en: Leo acts in the school play every year with his drama club.
exzh: Leo 每年都和戲劇社一起在學校話劇中演出。

en: We need to take action to keep our classroom clean.
exzh: 我們需要採取行動來保持教室整潔。

en: My grandpa stays active by walking in the park every morning.
exzh: 我爺爺每天早上在公園散步來保持活力。

en: The young actor in that movie is only sixteen years old.
exzh: 那部電影裡的年輕演員只有十六歲。

en: Amy wants to become a famous actress in the future.
exzh: Amy 將來想成為一位有名的女演員。

en: Please add some salt to the soup before you serve it.
exzh: 上湯之前請加一點鹽。
note: add A to B＝把 A 加進 B

en: Please write your home address clearly on the form.
exzh: 請在表格上清楚寫下你的住家地址。

en: Tickets cost 300 dollars for adults and 150 for students.
exzh: 票價成人三百元，學生一百五十元。

en: My mom gave me some good advice about choosing a club.
exzh: 我媽媽給了我一些選社團的好建議。
note: 不可數；a piece of advice；動詞為 advise

en: Tom is afraid of dogs, so he walks the other way.
exzh: Tom 怕狗，所以他走另一條路。
note: be afraid of＝害怕；I'm afraid…＝恐怕…

en: Let's play basketball in the gym after school today.
exzh: 我們今天放學後去體育館打籃球吧。

en: We have a big math test this afternoon in the sixth period.
exzh: 我們今天下午第六節有一個數學大考。
note: in the afternoon；this afternoon 前不加介系詞

en: I missed the bus again, so I was late for class.
exzh: 我又錯過公車了，所以上課遲到。

en: Our school team will play against a strong team on Friday.
exzh: 我們校隊星期五將對上一支強隊。

en: Most students start high school at the age of fifteen.
exzh: 大部分學生在十五歲時開始讀高中。

en: My family moved from Taipei to Taichung three years ago.
exzh: 我家三年前從台北搬到台中。
note: 與過去式連用；…ago 不和現在完成式連用

en: I agree with Ben that the new rule is fair.
exzh: 我同意 Ben 的看法，新規定是公平的。

en: Go straight ahead, and the bakery is on your left.
exzh: 直直往前走，麵包店就在你的左邊。

en: The air in the mountains is much cleaner than in the city.
exzh: 山上的空氣比城市裡乾淨多了。

en: The airlines offer cheaper tickets to students during the summer.
exzh: 航空公司在暑假期間提供學生較便宜的機票。
note: 常作公司名稱用，單數為 airline

en: Last summer, Mia took an airplane for the first time.
exzh: 去年夏天，Mia 第一次搭飛機。

en: We have to get to the airport two hours before our flight.
exzh: 我們必須在班機起飛前兩小時到機場。

en: I set my alarm for six o'clock so I won't be late.
exzh: 我把鬧鐘設在六點，這樣我才不會遲到。

en: My grandma keeps our old family photos in a big album.
exzh: 我奶奶把我們家的舊照片放在一本大相簿裡。

en: The twins look alike, but their personalities are very different.
exzh: 這對雙胞胎長得很像，但個性非常不同。
note: 不放在名詞前；look alike＝長得像

en: The fish was still alive when we bought it at the market.
exzh: 我們在市場買那條魚時，牠還活著。

en: All the students in my class passed the English test.
exzh: 我們班上所有的學生都通過了英文考試。

en: My parents don't allow me to use my phone after ten.
exzh: 我爸媽不允許我十點以後用手機。

en: It's almost seven, so we should leave for school now.
exzh: 快七點了，所以我們現在該出門上學了。

en: Ken doesn't like to eat lunch alone at school.
exzh: Ken 不喜歡在學校一個人吃午餐。

en: We rode our bikes along the river on Sunday.
exzh: 我們星期天沿著河邊騎腳踏車。

en: Our teacher asked us to read the poem aloud in class.
exzh: 老師要我們在課堂上把那首詩唸出聲來。

en: I have already finished my homework, so I can watch TV.
exzh: 我已經寫完作業了，所以可以看電視。
note: 常用於現在完成式肯定句

en: Lisa plays the violin, and she also sings in the choir.
exzh: Lisa 會拉小提琴，她也參加合唱團。
note: 放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

en: Although it was raining, we still went to the night market.
exzh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是去了夜市。
note: 不和 but 同時使用

en: The shirt and the shoes cost 2,000 dollars altogether.
exzh: 襯衫和鞋子總共花了兩千元。

en: Emma always brings her own water bottle to school.
exzh: Emma 總是帶自己的水壺來學校。
note: 頻率副詞，放在一般動詞前

en: Kevin's cousin is going to study in America next year.
exzh: Kevin 的表哥明年要去美國讀書。

en: My English teacher is American, and she comes from California.
exzh: 我的英文老師是美國人，她來自加州。

en: Basketball is popular among the boys in our class.
exzh: 籃球在我們班的男生之間很受歡迎。

en: You should drink a large amount of water on hot days.
exzh: 大熱天你應該喝大量的水。

en: Amy and Leo went to the library to study together.
exzh: Amy 和 Leo 一起去圖書館讀書。

en: Ken tried to hide his anger after losing the game.
exzh: 輸了比賽後，Ken 試著掩飾他的怒氣。

en: Try to take the photo from a different angle next time.
exzh: 下次試著從不同的角度拍這張照片。

en: My mom was angry because I came home very late.
exzh: 我媽媽很生氣，因為我很晚才回家。
note: be angry with＋人；be angry about＋事

en: The zoo has many animals from Africa and South America.
exzh: 動物園有許多來自非洲和南美洲的動物。

en: Tom hurt his ankle during basketball practice yesterday.
exzh: Tom 昨天練籃球時弄傷了腳踝。

en: Can I have another piece of cake? It's really good.
exzh: 我可以再吃一塊蛋糕嗎？真的很好吃。
note: 接單數名詞；the other＝兩者中的另一個

en: Do you know the answer to the last question on the test?
exzh: 你知道考卷上最後一題的答案嗎？

en: Don't leave food on your desk, or ants will come.
exzh: 別把食物留在桌上，不然螞蟻會跑來。

zh: 任何的；一些（用於否定、疑問）
en: Do you have any plans for the summer vacation?
exzh: 你暑假有任何計畫嗎？

en: Is anybody sitting here, or can I take this seat?
exzh: 這裡有人坐嗎？還是我可以坐這個位子？

en: Does anyone know where the teachers' office is?
exzh: 有人知道教師辦公室在哪裡嗎？

en: I didn't eat anything for breakfast, so I'm very hungry.
exzh: 我早餐什麼都沒吃，所以很餓。

en: I can't find my phone anywhere in my room.
exzh: 我在房間裡到處都找不到我的手機。

en: Mia's family lives in an apartment on the tenth floor.
exzh: Mia 一家住在十樓的一間公寓。

en: A beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.
exzh: 雨後天空中出現了一道美麗的彩虹。

en: I eat an apple every day as an afternoon snack.
exzh: 我每天吃一顆蘋果當下午的點心。

en: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
exzh: 我真的很感謝你幫我做自然科專題。
note: appreciate 後接事物，不直接接人

en: Our school trip to Hualien will be in April this year.
exzh: 我們今年去花蓮的校外教學在四月。

en: There are many good restaurants in this area of the city.
exzh: 城市的這個地區有很多好餐廳。

en: My brother and I often argue about who should wash the dishes.
exzh: 我弟弟和我常常為了誰該洗碗而爭吵。

en: Ben broke his arm when he fell off his bike.
exzh: Ben 從腳踏車上摔下來時摔斷了手臂。

en: My grandpa likes to read the newspaper in his armchair.
exzh: 我爺爺喜歡坐在他的扶手椅上看報紙。

en: Lisa's older brother joined the army after he finished college.
exzh: Lisa 的哥哥大學畢業後加入了陸軍。

en: We walked around the lake after dinner last night.
exzh: 我們昨晚晚餐後繞著湖邊散步。

en: Our train will arrive in Kaohsiung at noon tomorrow.
exzh: 我們的火車明天中午將抵達高雄。
note: arrive in＋大地方；arrive at＋小地方

en: Amy is very good at art and loves drawing animals.
exzh: Amy 很擅長美術，很喜歡畫動物。

en: The artist painted a big picture on the wall of our school.
exzh: 那位藝術家在我們學校的牆上畫了一幅大畫。

en: Kevin works as a waiter at a restaurant on weekends.
exzh: Kevin 週末在一家餐廳當服務生。

en: If you don't understand, just ask the teacher for help.
exzh: 如果你不懂，就向老師求助。

en: My little brother fell asleep on the sofa while watching TV.
exzh: 我弟弟看電視時在沙發上睡著了。
note: fall asleep＝睡著；不放在名詞前

en: Let's meet at the convenience store at seven tomorrow.
exzh: 我們明天七點在便利商店碰面吧。

en: Our team attacked quickly in the second half of the game.
exzh: 我們隊在比賽下半場迅速進攻。

en: The weather in Taiwan is very hot in August.
exzh: 台灣八月的天氣非常熱。

en: My aunt sent us a box of mangoes from Tainan.
exzh: 我阿姨從台南寄了一箱芒果給我們。

en: The weather in autumn is cool and comfortable for hiking.
exzh: 秋天的天氣涼爽，很適合爬山。

zh: 可用的；有空的；可取得的
en: Are you available to help me move on Saturday?
exzh: 你星期六有空幫我搬家嗎？

en: The train station is about two kilometers away from my house.
exzh: 火車站離我家大約兩公里。

en: The baby next door cries every night around midnight.
exzh: 隔壁的嬰兒每晚大約半夜都會哭。

en: My aunt hired a baby sitter to watch her son on Friday night.
exzh: 我阿姨星期五晚上請了一位臨時保母照顧她兒子。

en: I'll be back in ten minutes, so please wait for me.
exzh: 我十分鐘後就回來，請等我。

en: Leo carries a heavy backpack full of books to school.
exzh: Leo 背著裝滿書的重背包上學。

en: Don't walk backward on the stairs, or you might fall down.
exzh: 不要在樓梯上倒退走，不然你可能會跌倒。

en: Eating too much fried food is bad for your health.
exzh: 吃太多油炸食物對你的健康不好。

en: Emma and I play badminton in the gym after school.
exzh: Emma 和我放學後在體育館打羽毛球。

en: Please put the empty bottles in the recycling bag.
exzh: 請把空瓶子放進回收袋裡。

en: My mom likes to bake cookies on Sunday afternoons.
exzh: 我媽媽喜歡在星期天下午烤餅乾。

en: I buy bread at the bakery near my school every morning.
exzh: 我每天早上在學校附近的麵包店買麵包。

en: We grow some small plants and herbs on our balcony.
exzh: 我們在陽台上種了一些小植物和香草。

en: Kevin kicked the ball hard, and it flew over the wall.
exzh: Kevin 用力踢球，球飛過了牆。

en: We decorated the classroom with colorful balloons for the party.
exzh: 我們用彩色氣球佈置教室來辦派對。

en: Bananas are a good snack before you go running.
exzh: 香蕉是跑步前很好的點心。

en: Tom plays the drums in the school band every Friday.
exzh: Tom 每週五在學校樂團打鼓。

en: My dad went to the bank to change some money for our trip.
exzh: 我爸爸去銀行為我們的旅行換了一些錢。

en: Our family has a barbecue with our neighbors every Moon Festival.
exzh: 我們家每年中秋節都和鄰居一起烤肉。

en: The barber cut my hair too short this time.
exzh: 理髮師這次把我的頭髮剪得太短了。

en: The dog next door barks loudly whenever someone walks by.
exzh: 每當有人經過，隔壁的狗就大聲吠叫。

en: The movie is based on a true story about a Taiwanese runner.
exzh: 這部電影是根據一位台灣跑者的真實故事改編的。
note: be based on＝根據…；以…為基礎

en: Baseball is one of the most popular sports in Taiwan.
exzh: 棒球是台灣最受歡迎的運動之一。

en: Everyone should learn some basic first aid skills.
exzh: 每個人都應該學一些基本的急救技巧。

en: My grandma put the fresh eggs in a small basket.
exzh: 我奶奶把新鮮雞蛋放進一個小籃子裡。

en: Ben plays basketball with his classmates every day after school.
exzh: Ben 每天放學後和同學打籃球。

en: Leo hit the ball with his bat and ran to first base.
exzh: Leo 用球棒擊中球，跑上了一壘。

en: I like to take a hot bath after a long day.
exzh: 漫長的一天後，我喜歡泡個熱水澡。
note: take a bath＝洗澡；動詞為 bathe

en: Mia bathes her puppy once a week in the backyard.
exzh: Mia 每週在後院幫她的小狗洗一次澡。

en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom on this floor?
exzh: 不好意思，這層樓的廁所在哪裡？

en: We went to the beach in Kenting during the summer vacation.
exzh: 我們暑假去了墾丁的海灘。

en: My mom often cooks green beans with garlic for dinner.
exzh: 我媽媽晚餐常煮蒜炒四季豆。

en: We saw a black bear at the zoo last weekend.
exzh: 我們上週末在動物園看到一隻黑熊。

en: My uncle has a long gray beard and short hair.
exzh: 我叔叔留著灰色的長鬍子和短髮。

en: Our class beat Class 3 in the basketball game yesterday.
exzh: 我們班昨天在籃球比賽中打敗了三班。

en: Emma took a beautiful photo of the sunset at the beach.
exzh: Emma 在海邊拍了一張很美的夕陽照片。

en: Many tourists come to enjoy the beauty of Sun Moon Lake.
exzh: 許多遊客來欣賞日月潭的美景。

en: I stayed home yesterday because I had a bad cold.
exzh: 我昨天待在家，因為我得了重感冒。
note: because of＋名詞；不和 so 同時使用

en: Amy wants to become a nurse after she finishes school.
exzh: Amy 畢業後想成為一名護理師。

en: I usually go to bed at eleven on school nights.
exzh: 上學日的晚上我通常十一點上床睡覺。

en: My bedroom is small, but it is quiet and comfortable.
exzh: 我的臥室很小，但很安靜又舒服。

en: A bee flew into our classroom and everyone started screaming.
exzh: 一隻蜜蜂飛進教室，大家都開始尖叫。
note: as busy as a bee＝非常忙碌

en: My favorite dish is beef noodles with lots of vegetables.
exzh: 我最喜歡的菜是加很多青菜的牛肉麵。

en: At the barbecue, the adults had beer and the kids had juice.
exzh: 烤肉時，大人喝啤酒，小孩喝果汁。

en: Please wash your hands before you eat lunch.
exzh: 吃午餐前請洗手。

en: The school concert will begin at seven in the evening.
exzh: 學校音樂會將在晚上七點開始。

en: This yoga class is perfect for beginners like me.
exzh: 這堂瑜伽課很適合像我這樣的初學者。

en: I didn't understand the beginning of the movie at all.
exzh: 我完全看不懂電影的開頭。
note: at the beginning of＝在…的開始

en: The children behaved well during the long bus ride.
exzh: 孩子們在漫長的公車車程中表現得很乖。

en: There is a small park behind our school.
exzh: 我們學校後面有一個小公園。

en: I believe that hard work will help you reach your goals.
exzh: 我相信努力會幫助你達成目標。

en: The bell rang, and all the students ran out of the classroom.
exzh: 鐘聲響了，所有學生都跑出了教室。
note: ring the bell 按鈴；敲鐘

en: Does this black umbrella belong to you or to Ben?
exzh: 這把黑色雨傘是你的還是 Ben 的？
note: belong to + 人／團體，不用進行式

en: The temperature dropped below ten degrees in Taipei last night.
exzh: 昨晚台北的氣溫降到十度以下。

en: Please fasten your seat belt before the bus starts moving.
exzh: 公車開動前請繫好安全帶。

en: Lisa and Mia ate their lunch on a bench in the park.
exzh: Lisa 和 Mia 坐在公園的長椅上吃午餐。

en: Kevin always sits beside me in math class.
exzh: Kevin 數學課總是坐在我旁邊。

en: The convenience store is between the bank and the bookstore.
exzh: 便利商店在銀行和書店之間。
note: between A and B；三者以上多用 among

zh: 超出；在…之外；在…的那一邊
en: The math problem was beyond me, so I asked our teacher.
exzh: 這道數學題超出我的能力，所以我去問了老師。
note: beyond one's ability 超出能力範圍

en: Ben rides his bicycle to school every day, even in the rain.
exzh: Ben 每天騎腳踏車上學，即使下雨也一樣。

en: We had a big dinner at my grandma's house on Sunday.
exzh: 我們星期天在奶奶家吃了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

en: Amy and I like to ride our bikes along the river on weekends.
exzh: Amy 和我週末喜歡沿著河邊騎腳踏車。

en: After dinner, my dad asked the waiter for the bill.
exzh: 晚餐後，我爸爸請服務生拿帳單來。

en: We heard birds singing outside the window early this morning.
exzh: 今天一大早我們聽到窗外有鳥在唱歌。

en: My friends gave me a surprise party for my sixteenth birthday.
exzh: 朋友們幫我辦了一個十六歲生日驚喜派對。

en: A mosquito bit my arm while we were camping last night.
exzh: 昨晚我們露營時，有隻蚊子叮了我的手臂。

zh: 黑色的；（咖啡）不加奶的；黑色
en: Ken wore a black jacket to the school concert.
exzh: Ken 穿了一件黑色夾克去參加學校音樂會。

en: Our teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard.
exzh: 老師把新單字寫在黑板上。
note: write on the blackboard 寫在黑板上

en: It was cold, so my mom put an extra blanket on my bed.
exzh: 天氣很冷，所以媽媽在我床上多加了一條毯子。

en: The blind man crossed the street with the help of his guide dog.
exzh: 那位盲人在導盲犬的協助下過馬路。
note: be blind to 對…視而不見

en: The MRT station is just two blocks away from our school.
exzh: 捷運站離我們學校只有兩個街區遠。

en: The nurse checked my blood pressure during the health exam at school.
exzh: 護理師在學校健康檢查時幫我量了血壓。
note: blood pressure 血壓；動詞「流血」是 bleed

en: A strong wind blew my umbrella away on the way to school.
exzh: 上學途中一陣強風把我的雨傘吹走了。

en: The sky was clear and blue on the day of our class trip.
exzh: 我們班遊那天，天空晴朗湛藍。

zh: 木板；布告欄；登上（車、船、飛機）
en: Our teacher posted the exam schedule on the board outside the classroom.
exzh: 老師把考試時間表貼在教室外的布告欄上。
note: bulletin board 布告欄；board a plane 登機

en: We took a boat to Green Island during the summer vacation.
exzh: 暑假時我們搭船去綠島。

en: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and your mind clear.
exzh: 規律運動能讓你身體強壯、頭腦清楚。

en: My mom boiled some eggs for our breakfast this morning.
exzh: 媽媽今天早上煮了幾顆蛋給我們當早餐。

en: Leo broke a bone in his arm while playing basketball.
exzh: Leo 打籃球時手臂骨折了。

en: Emma borrowed three books from the school library yesterday.
exzh: Emma 昨天從學校圖書館借了三本書。
note: v. 預訂，如 book a table 訂位

en: There is a big bookstore near the train station.
exzh: 火車站附近有一家大書店。

en: Kevin got bored during the long movie and fell asleep.
exzh: Kevin 看那部很長的電影時覺得無聊，睡著了。
note: 人感到 bored；事物令人 boring

en: The speech was so boring that many students started yawning.
exzh: 那場演講非常無聊，很多學生開始打哈欠。
note: 比較 bored（人感到無聊的）

en: My little sister was born in Tainan in 2015.
exzh: 我妹妹 2015 年在台南出生。

en: Can I borrow your eraser? I left mine at home.
exzh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？我把我的忘在家裡了。

en: Lisa's boss at the café let her leave early on her birthday.
exzh: Lisa 打工咖啡店的老闆讓她生日那天提早下班。

en: Both of my parents work in the same hospital.
exzh: 我爸媽都在同一家醫院工作。
note: both A and B：A 和 B 兩者都

en: Please don't bother your brother while he is studying for exams.
exzh: 你哥哥準備考試時，請不要打擾他。
note: Sorry to bother you. 抱歉打擾了

en: Mia always brings a bottle of water to her dance class.
exzh: Mia 上舞蹈課總是帶一瓶水。

en: Please write your name at the bottom of the page.
exzh: 請把你的名字寫在這頁的最下面。
note: at the bottom of；反義 top

en: The students bowed to their teacher at the end of the ceremony.
exzh: 典禮結束時，學生們向老師鞠躬。

en: Tom ate two bowls of beef noodles for lunch.
exzh: Tom 午餐吃了兩碗牛肉麵。
note: a bowl of rice 一碗飯

en: We packed all my old books into a big box.
exzh: 我們把我所有的舊書裝進一個大箱子。

en: The boy next door often plays basketball with my brother.
exzh: 隔壁的男孩常常和我哥哥打籃球。

en: A bird was singing on a branch outside our classroom.
exzh: 一隻鳥在我們教室外的樹枝上唱歌。

en: Emma was brave enough to sing alone on stage.
exzh: Emma 很勇敢，敢獨自上台唱歌。

en: I usually have bread and milk for breakfast before school.
exzh: 我上學前通常吃麵包配牛奶當早餐。

en: Ken broke his phone screen when he dropped it on the floor.
exzh: Ken 把手機掉到地上，螢幕摔破了。
note: break–broke–broken；take a break 休息一下

en: My mom makes breakfast for the whole family every morning.
exzh: 我媽媽每天早上為全家做早餐。

en: We walked across the bridge to watch the fireworks by the river.
exzh: 我們走過橋到河邊看煙火。

en: The classroom looks bright and clean with the new lights.
exzh: 裝了新燈後，教室看起來明亮又乾淨。

en: Don't forget to bring your textbook to class tomorrow.
exzh: 明天別忘了帶課本來上課。

en: My older brother is studying engineering at a university in Taichung.
exzh: 我哥哥在台中一所大學讀工程。

en: Leo has a brown dog that loves to run in the park.
exzh: Leo 有一隻很愛在公園跑的棕色狗。

en: I brush my teeth twice a day, after breakfast and before bed.
exzh: 我一天刷兩次牙，早餐後和睡前各一次。
note: brush one's teeth 刷牙；toothbrush 牙刷

en: There was a small bug crawling on my desk this morning.
exzh: 今天早上有一隻小蟲在我桌上爬。

en: The city is building a new MRT line near our school.
exzh: 市政府正在我們學校附近蓋一條新的捷運線。

en: Our school library is in the tallest building on campus.
exzh: 我們學校的圖書館在校園裡最高的那棟大樓。

en: I bought a steamed bun and soy milk at the breakfast shop.
exzh: 我在早餐店買了一個包子和豆漿。

en: Kevin ordered a chicken burger and fries after soccer practice.
exzh: Kevin 足球練習後點了一個雞肉漢堡和薯條。

en: I burned my finger when I touched the hot pan.
exzh: 我碰到熱鍋子時燙到了手指。

en: I take the bus to school when it rains.
exzh: 下雨時我搭公車上學。
note: take the bus；by bus 搭公車

en: My uncle runs a small business selling bubble tea in Kaohsiung.
exzh: 我叔叔在高雄做賣珍珠奶茶的小生意。
note: It's none of your business. 不關你的事

en: Emma's father is a businessman who often travels to Japan.
exzh: Emma 的爸爸是一位常去日本出差的商人。

zh: 忙碌的；（電話）佔線的；熱鬧的
en: Amy is busy preparing for her English speech contest this week.
exzh: Amy 這週忙著準備英語演講比賽。
note: be busy (in) V-ing／be busy with N

en: I wanted to join the basketball team, but I was too busy.
exzh: 我想加入籃球隊，但我太忙了。

en: Tom put some butter on his toast for breakfast.
exzh: Tom 早餐在吐司上抹了一些奶油。
note: 不可數；peanut butter 花生醬

en: We saw many beautiful butterflies on our hike in the mountains.
exzh: 我們在山上健行時看到許多美麗的蝴蝶。

en: Press the red button to stop the machine.
exzh: 按下紅色按鈕讓機器停下來。

en: Mia bought a new phone case at the night market.
exzh: Mia 在夜市買了一個新的手機殼。

en: Ben goes to school by MRT, and it takes twenty minutes.
exzh: Ben 搭捷運上學，要花二十分鐘。
note: by bus/MRT 不加冠詞；by + 時間 = 在…之前

en: My grandma grows cabbage in the small garden behind her house.
exzh: 我奶奶在她家後面的小菜園種高麗菜。

en: Leo keeps two small birds in a cage in his room.
exzh: Leo 在他房間的籠子裡養了兩隻小鳥。

en: We bought a chocolate cake for our teacher's birthday.
exzh: 我們買了一個巧克力蛋糕幫老師慶生。
note: a piece of cake 小事一樁

en: I marked the date of the school sports day on my calendar.
exzh: 我在月曆上標出學校運動會的日期。

en: Call me when you get to the train station, okay?
exzh: 你到火車站的時候打電話給我，好嗎？
note: call sb. 打給某人；be called… 被稱為…

en: Stay calm and read each question carefully during the exam.
exzh: 考試時保持冷靜，仔細讀每一道題目。

en: Kevin took his camera on the class trip to take photos.
exzh: Kevin 帶相機去班遊拍照。

en: Our club is going to camp by the lake this weekend.
exzh: 我們社團這週末要去湖邊露營。
note: go camping 去露營；summer camp 夏令營

en: Can you help me carry these books to the library?
exzh: 你可以幫我把這些書搬到圖書館嗎？
note: can + 原形動詞；過去式 could

en: The baseball game was canceled because of the heavy rain.
exzh: 棒球比賽因為大雨取消了。

en: Smoking can cause lung cancer and many other health problems.
exzh: 吸菸會導致肺癌和許多其他健康問題。

en: Lisa made a wish and blew out the candles on her cake.
exzh: Lisa 許了願，吹熄蛋糕上的蠟燭。
note: blow out the candles 吹蠟燭

en: My little brother is not allowed to eat candy before dinner.
exzh: 我弟弟晚餐前不准吃糖果。

en: Ben wears a baseball cap to protect his face from the sun.
exzh: Ben 戴棒球帽保護臉不被太陽曬。
note: cap 多指有帽舌的帽子；hat 泛指帽子

en: My dad drives his car to work every morning.
exzh: 我爸爸每天早上開車上班。

en: We made a thank-you card for our homeroom teacher.
exzh: 我們做了一張感謝卡給導師。

en: Amy takes care of her little sister after school.
exzh: Amy 放學後照顧她妹妹。
note: take care of 照顧；care about 在乎

en: Be careful when you cross the street near the school.
exzh: 在學校附近過馬路時要小心。

en: My mom puts carrots and potatoes in her curry.
exzh: 我媽媽在咖哩裡放紅蘿蔔和馬鈴薯。

en: Ken helped me carry the heavy boxes up to the third floor.
exzh: Ken 幫我把重箱子搬上三樓。

en: My little brother watches cartoons every Saturday morning.
exzh: 我弟弟每週六早上看卡通。

en: Bring an umbrella in case it rains this afternoon.
exzh: 帶把傘，以防今天下午下雨。
note: in case 以防萬一；in that case 那樣的話

en: The small noodle shop near our school only accepts cash.
exzh: 我們學校附近那家小麵店只收現金。

en: We visited an old castle during our family trip to Japan.
exzh: 我們家去日本旅行時參觀了一座古老的城堡。

en: Our cat likes to sleep on the sofa all afternoon.
exzh: 我們家的貓喜歡整個下午睡在沙發上。

en: Hurry up, or we won't catch the last bus home.
exzh: 快點，不然我們會趕不上最後一班回家的公車。

en: Staying up late can cause headaches and poor grades.
exzh: 熬夜可能造成頭痛和成績變差。

en: There is a fan on the ceiling of our classroom.
exzh: 我們教室的天花板上有一台電風扇。

en: We celebrated Mia's birthday with a big cake after class.
exzh: 下課後我們用一個大蛋糕慶祝 Mia 的生日。

en: Students are not allowed to use their cellphones during class.
exzh: 學生上課時不准使用手機。

zh: 分（貨幣單位，一元的百分之一）
en: When Ben traveled in the US, a bottle of water cost ninety-nine cents.
exzh: Ben 在美國旅行時，一瓶水要價九十九美分。

en: There is a big fountain in the center of the park.
exzh: 公園的中央有一座大噴水池。
note: 英式拼法 centre；in the center of

en: Kevin grew five centimeters taller during his first year of high school.
exzh: Kevin 高一那年長高了五公分。

en: Our hotel was in central Tokyo, close to many shops.
exzh: 我們的飯店在東京市中心，離很多商店都很近。

en: This old bridge was built more than a century ago.
exzh: 這座老橋是一百多年前建造的。

en: Leo eats a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.
exzh: Leo 每天早上吃一碗牛奶穀片。

en: Are you certain that the test is on Monday?
exzh: 你確定考試是在星期一嗎？

en: Our teacher wrote the answers on the blackboard with white chalk.
exzh: 老師用白色粉筆把答案寫在黑板上。

en: Emma finally had a chance to visit her cousin in Canada.
exzh: Emma 終於有機會去加拿大探望她的表姊。

en: Lisa changed her hairstyle before the new school year.
exzh: Lisa 在新學年開始前換了髮型。

en: My dad likes to watch the sports channel after dinner.
exzh: 我爸爸喜歡在晚餐後看體育頻道。

en: Which character in the movie did you like the most?
exzh: 你最喜歡電影裡的哪個角色？

en: I need to charge my phone before we leave for the trip.
exzh: 出發去旅行前我需要幫手機充電。
note: free of charge 免費；charger 充電器

en: Our teacher showed us a chart of the class test scores.
exzh: 老師給我們看了一張全班考試成績的圖表。

en: The food at the night market is cheap and delicious.
exzh: 夜市的食物便宜又好吃。

en: Students who cheat on the exam will get zero points.
exzh: 考試作弊的學生會被記零分。
note: cheat on an exam 考試作弊

en: Please check your answers again before you hand in the test.
exzh: 交卷前請再檢查一次答案。
note: check in 報到；check out 退房

en: Our whole class went to cheer for Ben at the swimming contest.
exzh: 我們全班去游泳比賽為 Ben 加油。
note: cheer for 為…加油；cheer up 打起精神

en: Mia ordered a pizza with extra cheese for the party.
exzh: Mia 為派對點了一個加量起司的披薩。

en: Ken and his grandpa play chess together every Sunday afternoon.
exzh: Ken 和他爺爺每週日下午一起下西洋棋。

en: We had fried chicken and rice for dinner last night.
exzh: 我們昨晚晚餐吃炸雞配飯。

en: Every child in the village learns to swim at an early age.
exzh: 村裡的每個孩子都很小就學游泳。

en: My mom often tells me stories about her childhood in Hualien.
exzh: 我媽媽常常跟我說她在花蓮的童年故事。

en: Stop being so childish and say sorry to your sister.
exzh: 別這麼幼稚了，去跟你妹妹道歉。
note: 貶義；比較 childlike 天真的（褒義）

en: My grandpa still has a childlike love for flying kites.
exzh: 我爺爺仍然像孩子一樣熱愛放風箏。
note: 褒義；比較 childish 幼稚的

en: Pandas are originally from China, and they mainly eat bamboo.
exzh: 貓熊原產於中國，主要吃竹子。
note: 指國家時首字母大寫；小寫 china 指瓷器

en: Lisa's friend from Canada is learning to speak Chinese.
exzh: Lisa 來自加拿大的朋友正在學說中文。

en: Emma gave me a box of chocolates after her trip to Belgium.
exzh: Emma 去比利時旅行回來後送我一盒巧克力。

en: Going to bed early before the exam was a wise choice.
exzh: 考試前早點睡是明智的選擇。
note: make a choice 做選擇；v. choose

en: Tom chose the guitar club because he loves music.
exzh: Tom 選了吉他社，因為他熱愛音樂。

en: My friend from France learned to use chopsticks in Taiwan.
exzh: 我那位來自法國的朋友在台灣學會用筷子。
note: a pair of chopsticks 一雙筷子

en: Our class had a gift exchange party right before Christmas.
exzh: 我們班就在聖誕節前辦了交換禮物派對。
note: 首字母大寫；Merry Christmas! 聖誕快樂

en: There is an old church with a tall tower near the park.
exzh: 公園附近有一座有高塔的老教堂。

en: The students sat in a circle and shared their summer stories.
exzh: 學生們圍成一圈，分享他們的暑假故事。
note: v. 圈出，如 circle the answer

en: Taipei is a busy city with a convenient MRT system.
exzh: 台北是一個擁有便利捷運系統的繁忙城市。

en: Everyone clapped loudly after Mia finished her piano performance.
exzh: Mia 彈完鋼琴後，大家都大聲鼓掌。

en: We have six classes on Monday, including two hours of math.
exzh: 我們星期一有六堂課，包括兩小時的數學。

en: Lisa listens to classical music while she does her homework.
exzh: Lisa 寫作業時會聽古典音樂。

en: Ben and his classmates cleaned the classroom after school.
exzh: Ben 和他的同學們放學後打掃教室。

en: Our classroom is on the fourth floor, next to the library.
exzh: 我們教室在四樓，在圖書館旁邊。

en: We clean the classroom together every afternoon before going home.
exzh: 我們每天下午回家前一起打掃教室。

en: Our teacher's explanation was so clear that everyone understood the problem.
exzh: 老師的說明非常清楚，大家都懂了這題。
note: It is clear that... 很明顯……

en: The clerk at the bookstore helped Mia find the dictionary she needed.
exzh: 書店店員幫 Mia 找到她需要的字典。

en: Taiwan has a warm climate, so it rarely snows in the cities.
exzh: 臺灣氣候溫暖，所以城市裡很少下雪。
note: climate 指長期氣候；weather 指短期天氣

en: Kevin and his friends plan to climb Jade Mountain this summer.
exzh: Kevin 和朋友打算今年夏天去爬玉山。

en: The clock in our classroom is five minutes fast, so we often leave early.
exzh: 我們教室的時鐘快了五分鐘，所以我們常提早離開。

en: Please close the window because it is getting cold outside.
exzh: 請把窗戶關起來，因為外面越來越冷了。
note: be close to 靠近；親近

en: Lisa packed enough clothes for a three-day trip to Hualien.
exzh: Lisa 帶了足夠去花蓮三天的衣服。

en: Dark clouds covered the sky just before the baseball game started.
exzh: 棒球比賽剛要開始時，烏雲就布滿了天空。

en: It was cloudy all morning, but the sun came out after lunch.
exzh: 整個早上都是陰天，但午餐後太陽出來了。

en: Ben joined the guitar club because he wants to play in a band.
exzh: Ben 加入吉他社，因為他想在樂團裡表演。
note: join a club 加入社團

en: We rode our bikes along the east coast during winter vacation.
exzh: 寒假時我們沿著東海岸騎腳踏車。

en: Don't forget to bring a coat because it will be cold tonight.
exzh: 別忘了帶外套，因為今晚會很冷。

en: Emma screamed when a cockroach ran across the kitchen floor.
exzh: 一隻蟑螂跑過廚房地板時，Emma 尖叫了起來。

en: My dad drinks a cup of coffee every morning before work.
exzh: 我爸爸每天早上上班前都會喝一杯咖啡。
note: a cup of coffee 一杯咖啡

en: Tom put two coins into the machine to buy a bottle of water.
exzh: Tom 投了兩枚硬幣到機器裡買一瓶水。

en: Ken ordered a large cola with his fried chicken after practice.
exzh: 練習結束後，Ken 點了炸雞配一大杯可樂。

en: Leo stayed home from school today because he caught a bad cold.
exzh: Leo 今天沒去上學，因為他得了重感冒。

en: Amy likes to collect stamps from the countries she has visited.
exzh: Amy 喜歡收集她去過國家的郵票。

en: My cousin is studying computer science at a college in Taichung.
exzh: 我表哥在臺中的一所大學讀資訊工程。

en: What color do you want to paint the wall of your room?
exzh: 你想把房間的牆漆成什麼顏色？

en: Mia always keeps a small comb in her school bag.
exzh: Mia 總是在書包裡放一把小梳子。

en: Can you come to my birthday party next Saturday afternoon?
exzh: 你下星期六下午可以來我的生日派對嗎？

en: These running shoes are light and very comfortable to wear all day.
exzh: 這雙跑鞋很輕，整天穿著也很舒服。

en: Ben reads Japanese comic books on the MRT on his way to school.
exzh: Ben 上學途中在捷運上看日本漫畫。

en: The dog sat down as soon as it heard its owner's command.
exzh: 那隻狗一聽到主人的命令就坐下了。

en: Colds are very common among students when the weather changes.
exzh: 天氣變化時，感冒在學生之間很常見。
note: have... in common 有共同點

en: My aunt works for a small company that designs mobile games.
exzh: 我阿姨在一家設計手機遊戲的小公司上班。

en: Before buying a new phone, Kevin compared the prices at three stores.
exzh: 買新手機前，Kevin 比較了三家店的價格。
note: compare A with B 比較 A 和 B

en: Lisa uses her computer to do her homework and watch videos.
exzh: Lisa 用電腦寫作業和看影片。

en: After practicing all week, Emma felt confident about her English speech.
exzh: 練習了一整週後，Emma 對她的英文演講很有信心。
note: be confident about/of 對……有信心

en: Congratulations on winning first place in the school singing contest!
exzh: 恭喜你在校內歌唱比賽中拿到第一名！
note: 常用複數 Congratulations on + N/V-ing

en: Tom is considering joining the basketball team next semester.
exzh: Tom 正在考慮下學期加入籃球隊。

en: Amy wears contact lenses when she plays volleyball with her friends.
exzh: Amy 和朋友打排球時會戴隱形眼鏡。

en: Before starting the part-time job, Ken read the contract carefully.
exzh: 開始打工前，Ken 仔細看過了合約。

en: We bought some snacks at the convenience store near our school.
exzh: 我們在學校附近的便利商店買了一些零食。

en: Living near the MRT station is very convenient for my family.
exzh: 住在捷運站附近對我們家來說很方便。
note: 主詞通常是事物，不說 I am convenient

en: Leo had a long conversation with his grandpa about life in the past.
exzh: Leo 和爺爺聊了很久過去的生活。
note: have a conversation with 和……交談

en: My mom cooks beef noodles for us every Sunday night.
exzh: 我媽媽每個星期日晚上都煮牛肉麵給我們吃。

en: Mia baked chocolate cookies and shared them with her classmates.
exzh: Mia 烤了巧克力餅乾，和同學們分享。

en: The weather in the mountains was cool and pleasant this weekend.
exzh: 這個週末山上的天氣涼爽宜人。

en: Ben made a copy of his notes for his friend who was sick.
exzh: Ben 把筆記影印一份給生病的朋友。
note: make a copy 影印一份

en: We bought some grilled corn at the night market last night.
exzh: 我們昨晚在夜市買了一些烤玉米。

en: The convenience store is on the corner of this street.
exzh: 便利商店就在這條街的轉角。

en: Kevin got all the answers correct on today's math quiz.
exzh: Kevin 在今天的數學小考中答對了所有題目。

en: This bubble tea costs sixty dollars at the shop near our school.
exzh: 學校附近那家店的這杯珍珠奶茶要六十元。

en: My dad fell asleep on the couch while watching the news.
exzh: 我爸爸看新聞時在沙發上睡著了。

zh: 能夠（can 的過去式）；可以（客氣）
en: Could you help me carry these boxes to the classroom?
exzh: 你可以幫我把這些箱子搬到教室嗎？
note: Could you...? 比 Can you...? 更客氣

en: Our teacher counted the students before the bus left for the trip.
exzh: 遊覽車出發前，老師清點了學生人數。

en: Japan is the country Lisa most wants to visit after graduation.
exzh: 日本是 Lisa 畢業後最想去的國家。

en: I will finish the report in a couple of days.
exzh: 我會在幾天內完成這份報告。
note: a couple of 兩三個；幾個

en: Emma is taking a cooking course at the community center this month.
exzh: Emma 這個月在社區中心上烹飪課。

en: The students played basketball on the court during lunch break.
exzh: 學生們午休時在球場上打籃球。
note: basketball/tennis court 籃球場／網球場

en: My cousin from Kaohsiung is staying with us during summer vacation.
exzh: 我高雄的表哥暑假要住在我們家。

en: Snow covered the top of the mountain when we got there.
exzh: 我們到達時，山頂被雪覆蓋著。

en: We fed the cows and drank fresh milk at the farm in Taitung.
exzh: 我們在臺東的農場餵牛，還喝了新鮮牛奶。

en: Leo wore a cowboy hat in the school play last Friday.
exzh: Leo 上星期五在校內話劇中戴了一頂牛仔帽。

en: My little sister drew our family with crayons on a big piece of paper.
exzh: 我妹妹用蠟筆在一大張紙上畫了我們全家。

en: Ken is crazy about baseball and watches every game on TV.
exzh: Ken 對棒球很著迷，每場比賽都在電視上看。

en: Would you like some cream in your coffee this morning?
exzh: 你今天早上的咖啡要加一些奶精嗎？

en: My mom paid for our train tickets with her credit card.
exzh: 我媽媽用信用卡付了我們的火車票錢。

en: The police work hard to keep crime low in our neighborhood.
exzh: 警察努力讓我們社區的犯罪率保持很低。

en: Always look both ways before you cross the street near school.
exzh: 在學校附近過馬路前，一定要先左右看。
note: across 是介系詞，cross 是動詞

en: A large crowd gathered to watch the fireworks on New Year's Eve.
exzh: 跨年夜有一大群人聚集觀賞煙火。

en: The baby on the train began to cry when it got hungry.
exzh: 火車上的嬰兒餓了就開始哭。

en: Would you like a cup of hot tea after the long walk?
exzh: 走了這麼久之後，你想喝一杯熱茶嗎？

en: Scientists are still looking for a way to cure the disease.
exzh: 科學家仍在尋找治癒這種疾病的方法。
note: cure 治好；treat 治療（過程）

zh: 目前的；當前的；水流；電流
en: Our teacher asks us to read news about current events every week.
exzh: 老師要我們每週閱讀時事新聞。

en: Please open the curtains and let some sunlight into the room.
exzh: 請拉開窗簾，讓一些陽光照進房間。

en: Amy cut the birthday cake into twelve pieces for the whole club.
exzh: Amy 把生日蛋糕切成十二塊分給全社團。

en: The puppy at the pet shop is so cute that Mia wants to take it home.
exzh: 寵物店裡的小狗好可愛，Mia 好想帶牠回家。

en: Our class will dance on stage at the school's anniversary party.
exzh: 我們班將在校慶晚會上台跳舞。

en: The sign warned swimmers about the danger of strong waves.
exzh: 告示牌警告泳客大浪的危險。

en: It is dangerous to use your phone while riding a scooter.
exzh: 騎機車時使用手機很危險。

en: It gets dark very early in winter, so we leave school before six.
exzh: 冬天天很早就黑了，所以我們六點前就離開學校。

en: What is the date of the final exam this semester?
exzh: 這學期期末考是哪一天？
note: date 問日期；day 問星期幾

en: Our neighbor's daughter just started her first year of high school.
exzh: 我們鄰居的女兒剛升上高一。

en: Lisa spends two hours a day practicing the piano.
exzh: Lisa 每天花兩個小時練鋼琴。
note: every day 每天；everyday 日常的

en: The plants on our balcony were dead after we forgot to water them.
exzh: 我們忘了澆水，陽台上的植物都枯死了。
note: die 動詞；dead 形容詞；death 名詞

en: Ben learned sign language so he could talk with his deaf neighbor.
exzh: Ben 學了手語，好跟他失聰的鄰居聊天。

en: Kevin knows how to deal with stress before big exams.
exzh: Kevin 知道如何在大考前應付壓力。
note: deal with 處理；a great deal of 大量的

en: Emma started her letter to her grandma with the words "Dear Grandma."
exzh: Emma 寫給奶奶的信開頭是「親愛的奶奶」。

en: The death of our old dog made the whole family very sad.
exzh: 我們家老狗的死讓全家都很難過。

en: Our school holds a big Christmas party every December.
exzh: 我們學校每年十二月都會舉辦盛大的聖誕派對。

en: Tom decided to study harder after seeing his math grade.
exzh: Tom 看到數學成績後，決定更加用功。

en: Choosing a college major is an important decision for every student.
exzh: 選擇大學科系對每個學生都是重要的決定。

en: The lake is too deep for children to swim in safely.
exzh: 這座湖太深了，小孩在裡面游泳不安全。

en: We saw a group of deer in the forest during our camping trip.
exzh: 露營時我們在森林裡看到一群鹿。

en: The temperature dropped to twelve degrees in Taipei last night.
exzh: 昨晚臺北的氣溫降到十二度。

en: The beef noodles at this small shop are cheap and delicious.
exzh: 這家小店的牛肉麵又便宜又好吃。

en: Leo goes to the dentist twice a year to check his teeth.
exzh: Leo 一年看兩次牙醫檢查牙齒。

en: My sister studies in the English department at a university in Tainan.
exzh: 我姊姊在臺南一所大學的英文系就讀。

en: We went shopping for winter clothes at the department store downtown.
exzh: 我們去市區的百貨公司買冬天的衣服。

en: Whether we go to the beach depends on the weather tomorrow.
exzh: 我們要不要去海邊取決於明天的天氣。

en: Very few plants can grow in the hot and dry desert.
exzh: 在炎熱乾燥的沙漠裡，很少植物能生長。

en: Mia designed the poster for our class's food stand at the school fair.
exzh: Mia 設計了我們班園遊會攤位的海報。

en: Kevin keeps his desk clean so he can focus on studying.
exzh: Kevin 保持書桌整潔，這樣他才能專心讀書。

en: Playing team sports helps students develop good communication skills.
exzh: 參加團隊運動有助於學生培養良好的溝通能力。

en: In an emergency, dial 119 for an ambulance right away.
exzh: 遇到緊急狀況時，要立刻撥打 119 叫救護車。

en: My grandma's old ring has a small diamond in the middle.
exzh: 我奶奶的舊戒指中間有一顆小鑽石。

en: Lisa writes in her diary every night before she goes to bed.
exzh: Lisa 每天晚上睡前都會寫日記。

en: You can look up new words in an online dictionary on your phone.
exzh: 你可以用手機上的線上字典查生字。

zh: 做（do 的過去式）；（助動詞，用於過去式問句、否定）
en: Did you finish your science report before the deadline yesterday?
exzh: 你昨天在截止前完成自然報告了嗎？

en: Many fish died when the river became polluted last summer.
exzh: 去年夏天河流受到汙染時，許多魚死掉了。

en: Ben is on a diet and eats more vegetables instead of fried food.
exzh: Ben 正在節食，多吃蔬菜而不吃炸物。
note: be on a diet 節食

en: My sister and I have very different tastes in music.
exzh: 我和我姊姊對音樂的喜好很不同。

en: The last question on the math test was really difficult for everyone.
exzh: 數學考試最後一題對大家來說都很難。

en: Amy had difficulty understanding the speaker because the room was noisy.
exzh: 房間很吵，所以 Amy 很難聽懂講者在說什麼。
note: have difficulty (in) V-ing 做……有困難

en: The children dug a big hole in the sand at the beach.
exzh: 孩子們在海灘的沙裡挖了一個大洞。

en: Our family eats dinner together in the dining room every evening.
exzh: 我們全家每天晚上都在飯廳一起吃晚餐。

en: What did your mom cook for dinner last night?
exzh: 你媽媽昨晚晚餐煮了什麼？

zh: 直接的；直達的；指導；指引
en: There is a direct bus from our school to Taipei Main Station.
exzh: 從我們學校有直達臺北車站的公車。

en: Excuse me, could you tell me which direction the train station is in?
exzh: 不好意思，可以告訴我火車站在哪個方向嗎？
note: in the direction of 朝……方向

en: Tom's soccer uniform was very dirty after the game in the rain.
exzh: 在雨中比賽後，Tom 的足球隊服變得很髒。

en: Kevin discovered a great little café near the train station.
exzh: Kevin 在火車站附近發現了一家很棒的小咖啡店。

en: We had a long discussion about where to go for our class trip.
exzh: 我們針對班遊要去哪裡討論了很久。
note: have a discussion about 討論……

en: Fried rice is my favorite dish at that small restaurant.
exzh: 炒飯是我在那家小餐廳最喜歡的一道菜。

en: Emma dreams of traveling to distant countries after she finishes college.
exzh: Emma 夢想大學畢業後到遙遠的國家旅行。

en: Our teacher divided the class into five groups for the project.
exzh: 老師把全班分成五組來做專題。
note: divide A into B 把 A 分成 B

en: Leo saw a doctor because he had a fever and a sore throat.
exzh: Leo 發燒又喉嚨痛，所以去看了醫生。

en: Our class played dodge ball against Class 3 in PE class.
exzh: 體育課時我們班和三班比賽躲避球。

en: Mia walks her dog in the park every evening after dinner.
exzh: Mia 每天晚餐後在公園遛狗。

en: My little sister carries her favorite doll everywhere she goes.
exzh: 我妹妹走到哪裡都帶著她最喜歡的洋娃娃。

en: The notebook costs fifty dollars at the bookstore near school.
exzh: 學校附近書店的那本筆記本要五十元。

en: Please knock on the door before you enter the teachers' office.
exzh: 進入教師辦公室前請先敲門。
note: knock on the door 敲門

en: Lisa wore a white dress with small blue dots to the party.
exzh: Lisa 穿著一件有藍色小圓點的白色洋裝去參加派對。

en: We booked a double room for two nights at the hotel in Kenting.
exzh: 我們在墾丁的飯店訂了一間雙人房，住兩晚。

en: I doubt that Ken will finish his project by tomorrow.
exzh: 我懷疑 Ken 明天前完成不了他的專題。
note: no doubt 無疑地；b 不發音

en: Please sit down and open your textbooks to page twenty.
exzh: 請坐下，把課本翻到第二十頁。
note: sit down 坐下；calm down 冷靜

en: You can download the class schedule from the school's website.
exzh: 你可以從學校網站下載課表。

en: My parents are watching TV downstairs in the living room.
exzh: 我爸媽在樓下的客廳看電視。

en: My mom bought a dozen eggs at the supermarket this morning.
exzh: 我媽媽今天早上在超市買了一打雞蛋。

en: Dr. Lin told Kevin to drink more water and get more rest.
exzh: 林醫師要 Kevin 多喝水、多休息。

en: We watched the exciting dragon boat races by the river in June.
exzh: 我們六月在河邊觀看了精彩的龍舟賽。

en: My mom watches a Korean drama every night after dinner.
exzh: 我媽媽每天晚餐後都看一部韓劇。

en: Emma likes to draw cartoon characters in her free time.
exzh: Emma 有空時喜歡畫卡通人物。

en: Ben keeps his old photos in the top drawer of his desk.
exzh: Ben 把舊照片放在書桌最上層的抽屜裡。

en: Leo's dream is to become a professional basketball player someday.
exzh: Leo 的夢想是將來成為職業籃球員。

en: Amy wore a long blue dress to her cousin's graduation party.
exzh: Amy 穿了一件藍色長洋裝去參加表姊的畢業派對。

en: You should drink plenty of water when you exercise on hot days.
exzh: 大熱天運動時，你應該多喝水。

en: My dad drives me to school when it rains heavily.
exzh: 下大雨時，我爸爸會開車載我去上學。

en: The bus driver waited for Emma because she was running late.
exzh: 因為 Emma 快遲到了，公車司機等了她一下。

en: Ken dropped his phone on the floor and broke the screen.
exzh: Ken 把手機掉到地上，螢幕摔破了。

en: Leo plays the drums in our school band every Friday afternoon.
exzh: Leo 每週五下午在我們學校的樂隊裡打鼓。

en: Please hang your wet towel outside so it can get dry.
exzh: 請把濕毛巾掛到外面，這樣它才會乾。

en: My mom puts our clothes in the dryer on rainy days.
exzh: 下雨天我媽媽會把我們的衣服放進烘乾機。

en: We fed bread to the ducks at the park near our house.
exzh: 我們在家附近的公園餵鴨子吃麵包。

en: Students must turn off their phones during the exam.
exzh: 考試期間學生必須把手機關機。
note: during + 名詞；接子句要用 while

en: It is my duty to take out the trash every evening.
exzh: 每天晚上倒垃圾是我的責任。

en: Our teacher sent us an e-mail about the field trip.
exzh: 我們老師寄了一封關於校外教學的電子郵件給我們。

en: Each student has to give a short speech in English class.
exzh: 英文課上每位學生都必須做一段簡短的演講。
note: each + 單數名詞，動詞用單數

en: We saw an eagle flying high above the mountain during our hike.
exzh: 我們健行時看到一隻老鷹在山的上空高飛。

en: Tom hurt his ear during basketball practice yesterday afternoon.
exzh: Tom 昨天下午練籃球時傷到了耳朵。

en: Ben gets up early every morning to go jogging before school.
exzh: Ben 每天早上很早起床，上學前去慢跑。

en: Lisa earns some pocket money by teaching her neighbor math.
exzh: Lisa 靠教鄰居數學賺一些零用錢。

en: Amy bought a pair of earrings as a birthday gift for her mom.
exzh: Amy 買了一副耳環當作送給媽媽的生日禮物。
note: 常用複數：a pair of earrings

en: We should save water and energy to protect the earth.
exzh: 我們應該節約用水和能源來保護地球。
note: on earth 在地球上；（疑問句）究竟

en: The earthquake last night woke up everyone in my family.
exzh: 昨晚的地震把我家所有人都吵醒了。

en: Kevin solved the hard math problem with ease during the test.
exzh: Kevin 在考試中輕鬆解出了那道難的數學題。
note: with ease 輕易地；at ease 自在

en: The sun rises in the east, so my bedroom gets bright early.
exzh: 太陽從東方升起，所以我的房間很早就變亮。

en: Emma's family in Canada paints eggs together every Easter.
exzh: Emma 在加拿大的家人每年復活節都會一起彩繪蛋。

en: The first part of the test was easy, but the second was hard.
exzh: 考試的第一部分很簡單，但第二部分很難。

en: We usually eat dinner together and talk about our day.
exzh: 我們通常一起吃晚餐，聊聊各自的一天。

en: Don't put your cup on the edge of the desk.
exzh: 不要把杯子放在書桌的邊緣。
note: on the edge of… 在…的邊緣

en: My mom makes eggs and toast for breakfast every morning.
exzh: 我媽媽每天早上做蛋和吐司當早餐。

en: Our first class starts at eight o'clock every morning.
exzh: 我們每天早上第一堂課八點開始。

en: In Taiwan, you can get a driver's license at eighteen.
exzh: 在臺灣，你滿十八歲就可以考駕照。

en: Ben got eighty points on his English test this week.
exzh: Ben 這週英文考試考了八十分。
note: 注意拼字：eight + y，只有一個 t

zh: (兩者中)任一的；任一個；(否定句)也
en: Mia doesn't like spicy food, and I don't like it either.
exzh: Mia 不喜歡辣的食物，我也不喜歡。
note: either A or B 不是 A 就是 B；肯定句的「也」用 too

en: My uncle rides an electric scooter to work every day.
exzh: 我叔叔每天騎電動機車上班。

en: Lisa and I have been best friends since elementary school.
exzh: Lisa 和我從小學起就是最好的朋友。

en: We watched a baby elephant drink water at the zoo.
exzh: 我們在動物園看小象喝水。

en: Kevin usually goes to bed at eleven after finishing his homework.
exzh: Kevin 通常寫完功課後十一點上床睡覺。

en: Is there anything else you want to buy at the convenience store?
exzh: 你在便利商店還有其他想買的東西嗎？
note: 放在疑問詞或 some-／any-／no- 開頭的字後面

en: Music helps Mia express her emotions when she feels stressed.
exzh: 壓力大時，音樂幫助 Mia 表達她的情緒。

en: Our teacher emphasized that we should check our answers carefully.
exzh: 我們老師強調我們應該仔細檢查答案。

en: The classroom was empty because everyone went to the sports field.
exzh: 教室空無一人，因為大家都去運動場了。

en: At the end of the movie, everyone in the theater clapped.
exzh: 電影結束時，戲院裡的每個人都鼓掌了。
note: at the end of… 在…的末尾；in the end 最後

en: Too much sugar is the enemy of healthy teeth, says my dentist.
exzh: 我的牙醫說，太多糖是健康牙齒的敵人。

en: The car engine made a strange noise, so Dad stopped the car.
exzh: 汽車引擎發出奇怪的聲音，所以爸爸把車停了下來。

en: Ken wants to become an engineer and design faster trains.
exzh: Ken 想成為工程師，設計更快的火車。

en: Amy practices English by watching videos with English subtitles.
exzh: Amy 藉由看有英文字幕的影片來練習英文。

en: Tom enjoys playing basketball with his friends after school.
exzh: Tom 喜歡放學後和朋友打籃球。
note: enjoy + V-ing；enjoy oneself 玩得愉快

en: We don't have enough time to finish the project today.
exzh: 我們今天沒有足夠的時間完成這個專題。

en: Please take off your shoes before you enter the room.
exzh: 進入房間前請脫鞋。

en: Grandma gave me money in a red envelope during Chinese New Year.
exzh: 過年時奶奶給了我一個紅包。

en: Can I borrow your eraser? I made a mistake on my answer sheet.
exzh: 可以借我你的橡皮擦嗎？我在答案卡上寫錯了。

en: Ben found a spelling error in his report before handing it in.
exzh: Ben 在交報告前發現了一個拼字錯誤。
note: make an error 犯錯；同義 mistake

en: I love fruit, especially mangoes in the summer.
exzh: 我很愛水果，特別是夏天的芒果。

en: Our family eats hot pot together on Chinese New Year's Eve.
exzh: 我們家在除夕夜一起吃火鍋。
note: Christmas Eve 平安夜；New Year's Eve 跨年夜

en: Kevin studies hard, even on weekends and holidays.
exzh: Kevin 很用功，甚至週末和假日也一樣。
note: even + 比較級：even better 更好

en: We often take a walk in the park in the evening.
exzh: 我們常在傍晚到公園散步。
note: in the evening；特定日子用 on：on Friday evening

en: Have you ever tried stinky tofu at a night market?
exzh: 你曾在夜市吃過臭豆腐嗎？

en: Lisa practices the piano for an hour every day.
exzh: Lisa 每天練一小時鋼琴。
note: every day 每天；everyday 日常的

en: Everybody in our class passed the math test this time.
exzh: 這次我們班每個人數學考試都及格了。

en: Everyone was excited about the school trip to Hualien.
exzh: 每個人對去花蓮的校外教學都很興奮。
note: 動詞用單數；every one 指「每一個」

en: Emma packed everything she needed for the camping trip last night.
exzh: Emma 昨晚把露營需要的東西都打包好了。

en: I looked everywhere for my keys, but I couldn't find them.
exzh: 我到處找鑰匙，卻找不到。

en: In the story, the evil witch turns the prince into a frog.
exzh: 在故事裡，邪惡的女巫把王子變成了青蛙。

en: Mia stayed up late to prepare for her history exam.
exzh: Mia 熬夜準備歷史考試。

en: Our teacher gave us an example to explain the new grammar rule.
exzh: 我們老師舉了一個例子來說明新的文法規則。
note: for example 例如；set an example 樹立榜樣

en: Ken did an excellent job on his science project this semester.
exzh: Ken 這學期的科學專題做得非常好。

en: Everyone went on the trip except Kevin, who was sick.
exzh: 除了生病的 Kevin，大家都去旅行了。
note: except 不包含在內；besides 包含在內

en: The news about the class trip excited all the students.
exzh: 班遊的消息讓所有學生都很興奮。
note: excited（人）感到興奮；exciting 令人興奮的

en: Leo is excited about his first trip to Japan next month.
exzh: Leo 對下個月第一次去日本感到很興奮。
note: be excited about…；形容人的感受

en: The basketball game was so exciting that nobody wanted to leave.
exzh: 那場籃球賽太精彩了，沒有人想離開。
note: 形容事物；人感到興奮用 excited

en: Ben always has an excuse for not doing his homework.
exzh: Ben 總是有不寫功課的藉口。
note: Excuse me. 不好意思；打擾一下

en: Doctors say we should exercise for at least thirty minutes a day.
exzh: 醫生說我們每天應該至少運動三十分鐘。

en: Do you think life exists on other planets?
exzh: 你認為其他星球上有生命存在嗎？

en: Let's meet at Exit 2 of the MRT station after school.
exzh: 放學後我們在捷運站二號出口碰面吧。

en: The new phone is too expensive, so Kevin decided to wait.
exzh: 那支新手機太貴了，所以 Kevin 決定再等等。

en: Working at the summer camp was a great experience for Amy.
exzh: 在夏令營工作對 Amy 來說是很棒的經驗。

en: Lisa brought an extra umbrella in case her friend forgot one.
exzh: Lisa 多帶了一把傘，以防她朋友忘了帶。

en: Looking at your phone for too long is bad for your eyes.
exzh: 盯著手機太久對眼睛不好。

en: Tom washed his face with cold water to wake himself up.
exzh: Tom 用冷水洗臉讓自己清醒。
note: face a problem 面對問題

en: In fact, Mia is the fastest runner in our class.
exzh: 事實上，Mia 是我們班跑得最快的人。

en: My uncle works at a factory that makes bicycle parts.
exzh: 我叔叔在一家製造腳踏車零件的工廠工作。

en: Ken failed the driving test, but he will try again next week.
exzh: Ken 駕照考試沒過，但他下週會再試一次。
note: fail to V 未能…；名詞 failure

en: It's not fair that Ben always gets the biggest piece of cake.
exzh: Ben 總是拿到最大塊的蛋糕，這不公平。

en: Leo fell off his bike on the way to school this morning.
exzh: Leo 今天早上上學途中從腳踏車上摔下來。
note: fall–fell–fallen；美式英語 fall 也指秋天

en: Please mark each statement true or false after reading the article.
exzh: 讀完文章後，請把每一句敘述標示為對或錯。

en: My family usually goes hiking together on Sunday mornings.
exzh: 我們家通常星期天早上一起去爬山。

en: Tainan is famous for its delicious snacks and old streets.
exzh: 臺南以美味的小吃和老街聞名。

en: Our classroom has no air conditioner, only four old fans.
exzh: 我們教室沒有冷氣，只有四台舊電風扇。
note: a big fan of… 是…的忠實粉絲

en: Emma's home is far from school, so she takes the bus.
exzh: Emma 家離學校很遠，所以她搭公車。

en: We picked strawberries on a farm in Miaoli last weekend.
exzh: 我們上週末在苗栗的農場採草莓。

en: The farmer grows rice and vegetables near the river.
exzh: 那位農夫在河邊種稻米和蔬菜。

en: Leo ran so fast that he won first place in the race.
exzh: Leo 跑得非常快，所以在賽跑中得了第一名。

en: Fried food has a lot of fat, so I don't eat it often.
exzh: 炸的食物脂肪很多，所以我不常吃。

en: It was my fault that we missed the bus this morning.
exzh: 我們今天早上沒趕上公車是我的錯。
note: It's one's fault. 是某人的錯

zh: 最喜愛的；最喜愛的人事物
en: Beef noodles are my favorite food when the weather is cold.
exzh: 天氣冷的時候，牛肉麵是我最喜歡的食物。
note: 本身就有「最」的意思，不加 most

en: Kevin overcame his fear of speaking in front of the class.
exzh: Kevin 克服了在全班面前說話的恐懼。

en: Chinese New Year usually comes in January or February.
exzh: 農曆新年通常在一月或二月。

en: The club fee is five hundred dollars for the whole semester.
exzh: 整學期的社費是五百元。
note: 指服務費、學費等；tuition fees 學費

en: Mia feeds her cat before she leaves for school every morning.
exzh: Mia 每天早上出門上學前會餵她的貓。

en: I feel tired because I stayed up late studying last night.
exzh: 我覺得很累，因為昨晚熬夜讀書。

en: Lisa had a feeling that she had left her phone at home.
exzh: Lisa 有種感覺，她好像把手機忘在家裡了。
note: hurt one's feelings 傷害某人感情

en: We eat rice dumplings during the Dragon Boat Festival every year.
exzh: 我們每年端午節都吃粽子。

en: Ben stayed home from school because he had a high fever.
exzh: Ben 因為發高燒沒去上學。

en: Only a few students knew the answer to the last question.
exzh: 只有幾個學生知道最後一題的答案。
note: a few 一些；few 幾乎沒有（接可數名詞）

en: Our school has about fifty clubs for students to join.
exzh: 我們學校有大約五十個社團供學生參加。

en: Eating well and sleeping enough help your body fight colds.
exzh: 吃得好、睡得夠能幫助身體對抗感冒。

en: Don't forget to save the file before you close your laptop.
exzh: 闔上筆電前別忘了儲存檔案。

en: Tom filled his water bottle at the fountain before basketball practice.
exzh: Tom 練籃球前在飲水機把水壺裝滿。
note: fill A with B；fill in/out 填寫(表格)

en: Our club made a short film about life in our school.
exzh: 我們社團拍了一部關於校園生活的短片。

en: The final exam will cover everything we learned this semester.
exzh: 期末考會涵蓋這學期學過的所有內容。

en: After three hours of hard work, we finally finished our poster.
exzh: 努力了三個小時後，我們終於完成了海報。

en: Amy couldn't find her keys, so she called her mom for help.
exzh: Amy 找不到鑰匙，所以打電話向媽媽求助。
note: find–found–found；find + 受詞 + 形容詞 覺得…

en: I had a cold last week, but I feel fine now.
exzh: 我上週感冒了，但現在覺得很好。

en: Kevin cut his finger while helping his mom cook dinner.
exzh: Kevin 幫媽媽煮晚餐時割傷了手指。

en: Ken finished his homework before dinner, so he could play games.
exzh: Ken 晚餐前就寫完功課，所以可以玩遊戲。

en: A small fire started in the kitchen, but my dad put it out quickly.
exzh: 廚房發生了小火，但我爸爸很快就把它撲滅了。
note: on fire 著火；put out a fire 滅火

en: This is the first time Emma has taken the high-speed rail.
exzh: 這是 Emma 第一次搭高鐵。
note: for the first time 第一次；at first 起初

en: We had grilled fish and rice for lunch at the beach.
exzh: 我們在海邊午餐吃了烤魚配飯。
note: 複數通常仍為 fish；go fishing 去釣魚

en: The fisherman sells fresh fish at the harbor every morning.
exzh: 那位漁夫每天早上在港口賣新鮮的魚。

en: These shoes don't fit me anymore because my feet have grown.
exzh: 這雙鞋我已經穿不下了，因為我的腳長大了。

en: It takes about five minutes to walk from my house to the MRT station.
exzh: 從我家走到捷運站大約要五分鐘。

en: My dad fixed my bike so I could ride it to school.
exzh: 我爸爸修好了我的腳踏車，讓我能騎去上學。

en: Each team made its own flag for the school sports day.
exzh: 每一隊都為學校運動會做了自己的隊旗。

en: Ben was late for school because his bike had a flat tire.
exzh: Ben 上學遲到了，因為他的腳踏車爆胎了。
note: get a flat tire 爆胎

en: Our classroom is on the third floor of the new building.
exzh: 我們教室在新大樓的三樓。

en: Lisa bought some flowers for her mom on Mother's Day.
exzh: Lisa 母親節買了一些花給媽媽。

en: Many students got the flu, so our teacher told us to wear masks.
exzh: 很多學生得了流感，所以老師要我們戴口罩。
note: get/catch the flu；cold 一般感冒

en: We will fly to Japan for our family trip this summer.
exzh: 我們今年暑假會搭飛機去日本家族旅遊。

en: The heavy fog on the mountain made it hard to see the road.
exzh: 山上的濃霧讓人很難看清楚道路。

en: Please follow the teacher's instructions during the science experiment.
exzh: 做科學實驗時請遵照老師的指示。

en: Taiwan's night markets are full of delicious and cheap food.
exzh: 臺灣的夜市充滿了好吃又便宜的食物。

en: Kevin felt like a fool when he went to school on a holiday.
exzh: Kevin 在放假日跑去學校，覺得自己像個傻瓜。
note: April Fools' Day 愚人節；make a fool of oneself 出糗

en: It was foolish of me to leave my umbrella at home today.
exzh: 我今天把傘留在家裡，真是太笨了。
note: It is foolish of + 人 + to V

en: Leo hurt his foot while playing soccer during PE class.
exzh: Leo 在體育課踢足球時傷到了腳。
note: 複數 feet；on foot 步行

en: Tom's American friend loves watching football games on TV every weekend.
exzh: Tom 的美國朋友每個週末都愛看電視轉播的美式足球比賽。
note: 美式英語多指美式足球，足球常稱 soccer

en: Amy made a birthday card for her best friend.
exzh: Amy 為她最好的朋友做了一張生日卡。
note: for + 一段時間：for two hours

en: Learning a foreign language helps you make friends from other countries.
exzh: 學外語能幫助你結交來自其他國家的朋友。

en: A foreigner asked Ben how to get to the train station.
exzh: 一位外國人問 Ben 怎麼去火車站。

en: We saw many birds and insects in the forest during our hike.
exzh: 我們健行時在森林裡看到很多鳥和昆蟲。

en: Don't forget to bring your PE clothes to school tomorrow.
exzh: 明天別忘了帶體育服來學校。
note: forget–forgot–forgotten；forget to V 忘記要做／forget V-ing 忘記做過

en: Please forgive me for being late; the bus was very crowded.
exzh: 請原諒我遲到，公車實在太擠了。

en: Mia eats salad with a fork, but she uses chopsticks for noodles.
exzh: Mia 用叉子吃沙拉，但吃麵用筷子。

en: Please fill out this form to join the photography club.
exzh: 請填寫這張表格來加入攝影社。
note: fill out a form 填表格

en: You should wear formal clothes to the graduation ceremony.
exzh: 參加畢業典禮應該穿正式的服裝。

en: Our former English teacher still visits the school every year.
exzh: 我們以前的英文老師每年仍會回學校看看。
note: the former…the latter 前者…後者

en: About forty students joined the school dance club this semester.
exzh: 這學期大約有四十名學生加入學校的舞蹈社。
note: 拼字注意：four → forty（沒有 u）

en: Please move forward a little so everyone can fit in the photo.
exzh: 請往前移一點，讓大家都能入鏡。
note: look forward to + V-ing 期待…

en: Ken practices basketball four times a week after school.
exzh: Ken 每週放學後練習籃球四次。

en: My little sister will turn fourteen next month.
exzh: 我妹妹下個月就滿十四歲了。

en: We saw a red fox running across the field during our hike.
exzh: 我們健行時看到一隻紅狐狸跑過田野。

en: The museum is free for students on weekends.
exzh: 博物館週末對學生免費。
note: for free 免費；free time 空閒時間

en: It was freezing on the mountain, so we wore thick jackets.
exzh: 山上冷得要命，所以我們穿了厚外套。

en: Ben ordered a burger and some French fries for lunch.
exzh: Ben 午餐點了一個漢堡和一些薯條。
note: 通常用複數；英式英語說 chips

en: My grandma buys fresh vegetables at the morning market every day.
exzh: 我奶奶每天在早市買新鮮的蔬菜。

en: We have a math quiz every Friday morning.
exzh: 我們每週五早上都有數學小考。
note: 星期名稱首字母大寫；on Friday

en: Mom put the leftover fried rice in the fridge last night.
exzh: 媽媽昨晚把剩下的炒飯放進冰箱。

en: Lisa and I have been good friends since elementary school.
exzh: Lisa 和我從小學起就是好朋友。
note: make friends with 和…交朋友

en: The people at the night market were very friendly to us.
exzh: 夜市的人對我們很友善。
note: 字尾 -ly 但是形容詞；be friendly to

en: Their friendship grew stronger after they joined the same volleyball team.
exzh: 他們加入同一支排球隊後，友誼變得更深厚了。

en: Can I have some ketchup with my fries, please?
exzh: 可以給我一些番茄醬配薯條嗎？
note: ＝French fries；也是 fry 的第三人稱單數

en: We played frisbee on the beach until the sun went down.
exzh: 我們在海灘上玩飛盤，一直玩到太陽下山。

en: After the heavy rain, we heard frogs singing near the rice fields.
exzh: 大雨過後，我們聽到稻田附近有青蛙在叫。

en: Emma comes from Tainan, but now she studies in Taipei.
exzh: Emma 來自台南，但現在在台北念書。
note: from A to B 從 A 到 B；be different from 與…不同

en: Leo always sits in the front row in chemistry class.
exzh: Leo 化學課總是坐在前排。
note: in front of 在…前面（外部）；in the front of 在…前部（內部）

en: Eating fruit after dinner is a habit in my family.
exzh: 晚餐後吃水果是我們家的習慣。
note: 泛指時多不可數；fruits 指多種水果

en: My dad likes to fry eggs for our breakfast on weekends.
exzh: 我爸週末喜歡煎蛋給我們當早餐。

en: The bus was so full that we had to wait for the next one.
exzh: 公車太擠了，所以我們只好等下一班。
note: be full of 充滿…；I'm full. 我吃飽了。

en: We had a lot of fun at the school sports day.
exzh: 我們在學校運動會上玩得很開心。
note: have fun 玩得開心；fun 是「好玩的」，funny 是「好笑的」

en: Tom told a funny story, and the whole class laughed.
exzh: Tom 講了個好笑的故事，全班都笑了。

en: We bought some new furniture for my bedroom last weekend.
exzh: 上週末我們幫我的房間買了一些新家具。
note: 不可數；a piece of furniture 一件家具

en: Mia wants to become a doctor in the future.
exzh: Mia 將來想當醫生。

en: Our class won the basketball game against Class 3 yesterday.
exzh: 我們班昨天在籃球賽中贏了三班。
note: video game 電玩；play a game

en: Please take out the garbage before the garbage truck comes tonight.
exzh: 今晚垃圾車來之前請把垃圾拿出去。
note: 不可數；take out the garbage 倒垃圾

en: My grandpa grows tomatoes and green onions in his garden.
exzh: 我爺爺在他的菜園裡種番茄和蔥。

en: Let's meet at the school gate at seven tomorrow morning.
exzh: 我們明天早上七點在校門口見面吧。

en: Our school nurse is very gentle with sick students.
exzh: 我們學校的護理師對生病的學生很溫柔。

en: Ken acted like a gentleman and held the door for everyone.
exzh: Ken 很有紳士風度，幫大家扶著門。
note: 複數 gentlemen；Ladies and gentlemen 各位先生女士

en: Amy got a new phone for her sixteenth birthday.
exzh: Amy 十六歲生日時得到一支新手機。

en: Kevin told us a ghost story during the class camping trip.
exzh: Kevin 在班級露營時跟我們講了一個鬼故事。

en: There is a giant tree in the middle of our campus.
exzh: 我們校園中央有一棵巨大的樹。

en: I made a card as a birthday gift for my best friend.
exzh: 我做了一張卡片當作送給好朋友的生日禮物。
note: have a gift for 有…的天分

en: The girl sitting next to me is the captain of the volleyball team.
exzh: 坐我旁邊的女孩是排球隊隊長。

en: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework for the long weekend.
exzh: 老師給了我們很多連假要寫的作業。

en: I'm glad you could come to my piano concert tonight.
exzh: 很高興你今晚能來我的鋼琴演奏會。
note: be glad to V／that…；不放在名詞前

en: Ben drinks a glass of warm milk before going to bed.
exzh: Ben 睡前會喝一杯溫牛奶。
note: a glass of 一杯；glasses 也指眼鏡

en: Mia started wearing glasses because she couldn't see the board clearly.
exzh: Mia 因為看不清楚黑板而開始戴眼鏡。
note: 常用複數；a pair of glasses 一副眼鏡

en: Don't forget your gloves; it's very cold outside today.
exzh: 別忘了戴手套，今天外面很冷。
note: a pair of gloves 一副手套

en: We used glue to put the photos on our class poster.
exzh: 我們用膠水把照片貼到班級海報上。

en: We went to Kenting with our classmates during the summer vacation.
exzh: 暑假時我們和同學去了墾丁。

en: We fed the goats at a small farm in Yilan last weekend.
exzh: 上週末我們在宜蘭的一座小農場餵山羊。

en: Thank God it stopped raining before our soccer game started.
exzh: 謝天謝地，在我們足球比賽開始前雨停了。
note: 指上帝時大寫 God；Thank God 謝天謝地

en: Kevin won a gold medal in the school swimming contest.
exzh: Kevin 在校內游泳比賽中贏得金牌。
note: gold 指材質；golden 金色的、珍貴的

en: The rice fields turn golden in the fall.
exzh: 稻田在秋天變成一片金黃色。
note: a golden chance 大好機會

en: Lisa is good at drawing, so she designed our class T-shirt.
exzh: Lisa 很會畫畫，所以她設計了我們的班服。

en: My goodness, this bubble tea is way too sweet for me!
exzh: 我的天啊，這杯珍奶對我來說太甜了！
note: My goodness!／Oh my goodness! 表驚訝

en: A goose walked slowly across the path in the park.
exzh: 一隻鵝慢慢地走過公園的小路。

en: The government built a new bike path along the river.
exzh: 政府沿著河邊蓋了一條新的自行車道。

en: Tom got good grades in math this semester.
exzh: Tom 這學期數學成績很好。

en: This recipe needs two hundred grams of flour and three eggs.
exzh: 這份食譜需要兩百公克的麵粉和三顆蛋。

en: Grandpa took his granddaughter Mia to the zoo on Sunday.
exzh: 爺爺星期天帶孫女 Mia 去動物園。

en: My grandfather walks in the park every morning to stay healthy.
exzh: 我爺爺每天早上到公園散步保持健康。

en: Grandma always cooks my favorite soup when I visit her.
exzh: 每次我去看奶奶，她都會煮我最愛的湯。

en: My grandmother taught me how to make rice dumplings.
exzh: 我奶奶教我怎麼包粽子。

en: Grandpa likes to tell us stories about his childhood.
exzh: 爺爺喜歡跟我們講他小時候的故事。

en: Ken is the only grandson in his big family.
exzh: Ken 是他們大家族裡唯一的孫子。

en: We picked fresh grapes at a farm in Changhua.
exzh: 我們在彰化的一座農場採新鮮葡萄。
note: a bunch of grapes 一串葡萄

en: Please don't walk on the grass in front of the library.
exzh: 請不要踩圖書館前的草地。

en: The sky turned gray, and it started to rain.
exzh: 天空變灰，接著開始下雨。

en: We had a great time at the beach last Sunday.
exzh: 上週日我們在海邊玩得很開心。
note: have a great time 玩得愉快

en: The mountains look so green after a week of rain.
exzh: 下了一週雨後，山看起來好綠。

en: Our principal greets students at the school gate every morning.
exzh: 我們校長每天早上在校門口跟學生打招呼。

en: Be careful! The ground is wet and slippery after the rain.
exzh: 小心，雨後地面又濕又滑。
note: on the ground 在地上；playground 操場

en: Our teacher divided the class into groups of four for the project.
exzh: 老師把全班分成四人一組做專題。

en: My mom grows herbs on the balcony of our apartment.
exzh: 我媽在我們公寓的陽台種香草。

en: The guard at the gate checks everyone's student ID.
exzh: 校門口的警衛會檢查每個人的學生證。

en: Guava is one of my favorite fruits in summer.
exzh: 芭樂是我夏天最喜歡的水果之一。

en: Can you guess how many people came to the concert?
exzh: 你猜得到有多少人來聽演唱會嗎？

en: We cleaned the whole house before the guests arrived.
exzh: 客人到之前我們把整間房子打掃乾淨。
note: guest 受邀的客人；customer 顧客

en: Leo practices the guitar for an hour every evening.
exzh: Leo 每天晚上練一小時吉他。
note: play the guitar（樂器前加 the）

en: The kids had fun playing with water guns at the pool party.
exzh: 孩子們在泳池派對上玩水槍玩得很開心。

en: Ben is a nice guy who always helps his classmates.
exzh: Ben 是個好人，總是幫助同學。
note: you guys 你們（口語，男女皆可）

en: We have PE class in the gym when it rains.
exzh: 下雨時我們在體育館上體育課。

en: Reading for twenty minutes before bed is a good habit.
exzh: 睡前閱讀二十分鐘是個好習慣。
note: break a habit 戒掉習慣

en: Emma has long black hair and usually wears it in a ponytail.
exzh: Emma 有一頭黑長髮，通常綁馬尾。

en: My aunt works as a hair dresser in a small shop.
exzh: 我阿姨在一家小店當美髮師。

en: Tom got a short haircut before the new semester started.
exzh: Tom 新學期開始前去剪了短髮。
note: get a haircut 去剪頭髮

en: I spent half an hour waiting for the bus this morning.
exzh: 我今天早上等公車等了半小時。
note: 複數 halves；half an hour 半小時

en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the school hall.
exzh: 畢業典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

en: Our English club held a costume party on Halloween.
exzh: 我們英文社在萬聖節辦了一場變裝派對。
note: 首字母大寫；10 月 31 日

en: I had a ham and egg sandwich for breakfast today.
exzh: 我今天早餐吃了火腿蛋三明治。

en: Kevin was so hungry that he ate two hamburgers.
exzh: Kevin 餓到吃了兩個漢堡。

en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
exzh: 知道答案的話就舉手。
note: hand in 繳交；on the other hand 另一方面

en: Leo looked handsome in his suit at his sister's wedding.
exzh: Leo 穿西裝參加姊姊的婚禮，看起來很帥。
note: 多形容男性；女性多用 beautiful／pretty

en: Please hang your wet umbrella outside the classroom.
exzh: 請把濕雨傘掛在教室外面。

en: What happened to your phone? The screen is broken.
exzh: 你的手機怎麼了？螢幕破了。
note: happen to sb. 某人發生某事；不用被動

en: My parents were happy to hear about my test results.
exzh: 我爸媽聽到我的考試成績很高興。

en: The last question on the math test was really hard.
exzh: 數學考卷的最後一題真的很難。
note: hardly 是「幾乎不」，不是「努力地」

en: Mia is a hard-working student who never misses a class.
exzh: Mia 是個勤奮的學生，從不缺課。

en: Wear a hat when you go hiking in the hot sun.
exzh: 頂著大太陽去健行時要戴帽子。
note: hat 有一圈帽簷；cap 指棒球帽

en: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
exzh: 我討厭在寒冷的冬天早上早起。

en: Ben hit his head on the door when he stood up.
exzh: Ben 站起來時頭撞到門。

en: I had a headache, so I went to the school nurse.
exzh: 我頭痛，所以去找學校護理師。

en: Getting enough sleep is important for your health.
exzh: 充足的睡眠對健康很重要。
note: health 是名詞，healthy 是形容詞

en: My mom always makes healthy lunches for me with lots of vegetables.
exzh: 我媽總是幫我準備有很多蔬菜的健康午餐。

en: Did you hear the news about our school trip?
exzh: 你有聽說我們校外教學的消息嗎？

en: My heart was beating fast before my speech in front of the class.
exzh: 在全班面前演講之前，我的心跳得好快。

en: Please heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
exzh: 請把湯用微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

en: My school bag is really heavy because of all these textbooks.
exzh: 因為這些課本，我的書包真的很重。
note: heavy rain 大雨；heavy traffic 交通擁擠

en: The nurse checked our height and weight at the start of school.
exzh: 開學時護理師幫我們量身高和體重。
note: 形容詞為 high；拼字注意 -ght

en: Please say hello to your parents for me when you get home.
exzh: 你回家時，請幫我向你爸媽問好。

en: Can you help me carry these boxes to the classroom?
exzh: 你可以幫我把這些箱子搬到教室嗎？
note: help sb. (to) V；Help yourself. 請自便

en: These online videos were really helpful for my chemistry review.
exzh: 這些線上影片對我複習化學非常有幫助。

en: My grandma keeps a few hens, so we always have fresh eggs.
exzh: 我奶奶養了幾隻母雞，所以我們總有新鮮的蛋。

en: Come here and look at this cute photo of my cat.
exzh: 過來看看我家貓咪這張可愛的照片。
note: Here you are. 給你；here 是副詞，不說 come to here

en: Kevin was the hero of the game after scoring the winning goal.
exzh: Kevin 踢進致勝一球，成了比賽的英雄。

en: This blue umbrella isn't mine; I think it's hers.
exzh: 這把藍色雨傘不是我的，我想是她的。

en: Hey, do you want to grab lunch after class?
exzh: 嘿，下課後要不要一起去吃午餐？

en: Lisa said hi to me when we passed in the hallway.
exzh: 我們在走廊擦身而過時，Lisa 跟我打招呼。
note: say hi to 向…打招呼

en: My cat likes to hide under the bed when guests come.
exzh: 有客人來時，我的貓喜歡躲在床底下。

en: The price of vegetables is very high after the typhoon.
exzh: 颱風過後菜價很高。
note: high 用於物體或程度；形容人高用 tall

en: There was heavy traffic on the highway during the holiday.
exzh: 連假期間高速公路很塞。

en: We plan to hike up Yangmingshan this weekend.
exzh: 我們打算這週末去爬陽明山。

en: Our school is on a hill, so we walk uphill every morning.
exzh: 我們學校在山坡上，所以每天早上都要走上坡。

en: Grandpa hurt his hip, so he walks slowly now.
exzh: 爺爺髖部受傷，所以現在走得很慢。

en: The hippo at the zoo spent the whole afternoon in the water.
exzh: 動物園的河馬整個下午都待在水裡。

en: Ben left his phone on the bus this morning.
exzh: Ben 今天早上把手機忘在公車上了。
note: his 可當所有格，也可當所有代名詞

en: We learned about the history of Tainan in class today.
exzh: 我們今天在課堂上學到台南的歷史。
note: historic 有歷史意義的；historical 歷史的

en: Tom hit the ball over the fence during the baseball game.
exzh: Tom 在棒球比賽中把球打出了圍牆。
note: hit–hit–hit；a hit song 熱門歌曲

en: My hobby is taking photos of street food.
exzh: 我的嗜好是拍街頭小吃的照片。

en: Please hold my bag while I tie my shoes.
exzh: 我綁鞋帶時請幫我拿一下包包。

en: There is a big hole in my old sneakers.
exzh: 我的舊運動鞋上有一個大洞。

en: We usually visit our grandparents during the Lunar New Year holiday.
exzh: 農曆新年假期我們通常會去看祖父母。

en: I usually get home around six after cram school.
exzh: 補習完我通常六點左右到家。
note: go home／get home 不加 to

en: I always finish my homework before I check my phone.
exzh: 我總是先寫完作業才看手機。
note: 不可數；do homework 寫作業

en: Be honest with me: do you like my new haircut?
exzh: 老實跟我說：你喜歡我的新髮型嗎？
note: h 不發音，前面用 an（an honest person）

en: I like to add some honey to my lemon tea.
exzh: 我喜歡在檸檬茶裡加一些蜂蜜。

en: We watched the little rabbit hop across the grass in the park.
exzh: 我們看著小兔子在公園的草地上跳過去。

en: I hope it doesn't rain on our class trip tomorrow.
exzh: 希望我們明天的班遊不要下雨。

en: Amy rode a horse for the first time on a farm in Taitung.
exzh: Amy 在台東的一座農場第一次騎馬。

en: My dad took me to the hospital when I had a high fever.
exzh: 我發高燒時，爸爸帶我去醫院。

en: It's so hot today that everyone wants to buy shaved ice.
exzh: 今天好熱，大家都想買剉冰。

en: Ben grabbed a hot dog at the convenience store before class.
exzh: Ben 上課前在便利商店買了一份熱狗。

en: Our family stayed at a hotel near the beach in Hualien.
exzh: 我們家住在花蓮海邊附近的一家飯店。

en: It takes about an hour to get to school by bus.
exzh: 坐公車到學校大約要一個小時。
note: h 不發音，用 an hour

en: Our family moved into a bigger house near the train station.
exzh: 我們家搬進火車站附近一間比較大的房子。
note: 「在家」說 at home，不說 at house

en: Kevin's mom was a housewife before she opened her own small bakery.
exzh: Kevin 的媽媽在開自己的小麵包店之前是家庭主婦。

en: Can you show me how to download the app on my phone?
exzh: 你可以教我怎麼在手機上下載這個應用程式嗎？
note: how to + V 表「如何做」

en: The test was hard; however, most students in our class passed it.
exzh: 這次考試很難；然而，我們班大部分學生都及格了。
note: 常見寫法：前用分號或句點，後接逗號

en: Robots can do many jobs, but they cannot replace human teachers completely.
exzh: 機器人能做很多工作，但無法完全取代人類老師。
note: human being 人；human nature 人性

en: Even after winning first prize, Leo stayed humble and thanked his coach.
exzh: 即使得了第一名，Leo 仍然很謙虛，並感謝他的教練。

en: About three hundred students joined the school sports day this year.
exzh: 今年大約有三百名學生參加學校運動會。
note: three hundred 不加 s；hundreds of 表「數以百計的」

en: I skipped breakfast this morning, so I was very hungry by ten.
exzh: 我今天早上沒吃早餐，所以到十點時已經非常餓了。

en: Lions usually hunt in groups to catch larger animals.
exzh: 獅子通常成群狩獵，以捕捉較大的動物。
note: hunt for 尋找（如 hunt for a job）

en: The old hunter knew every path in the mountains near his village.
exzh: 那位老獵人熟悉他村莊附近山裡的每一條小路。

en: Ben had to hurry to catch the last bus home after cram school.
exzh: Ben 補習完必須趕快去搭最後一班公車回家。
note: in a hurry 匆忙；hurry up 快點

en: Mia hurt her ankle during basketball practice yesterday afternoon.
exzh: Mia 昨天下午練籃球時弄傷了腳踝。

en: My aunt and her husband run a small noodle shop in Tainan.
exzh: 我阿姨和她先生在台南開一家小麵店。

en: Could I have my green tea with less ice, please?
exzh: 我的綠茶可以少冰嗎？麻煩了。
note: 不可數；ice cream 冰淇淋

en: Lisa had a great idea for our class performance at the school festival.
exzh: Lisa 對我們班在校慶的表演有個很棒的點子。
note: have no idea 完全不知道

en: If it rains tomorrow, our class trip will be canceled.
exzh: 如果明天下雨，我們的班遊就會取消。
note: 條件句用現在式表未來

en: Tom was ill with the flu, so he stayed home for three days.
exzh: Tom 得了流感，所以在家休息了三天。
note: 多放在 be 動詞後；比較級 worse

en: Can you imagine life without phones or the internet?
exzh: 你能想像沒有手機或網路的生活嗎？

en: It is impolite to look at your phone while someone is talking.
exzh: 別人在說話時看手機是不禮貌的。

en: Our coach often talks about the importance of warming up before games.
exzh: 我們教練常談到比賽前暖身的重要性。

en: Getting enough sleep is important for students before a big exam.
exzh: 大考前睡飽對學生來說很重要。
note: It is important (for sb.) to V

en: It is impossible to finish all this homework in one hour.
exzh: 一小時內寫完這些作業是不可能的。

zh: 在…裡面；在（某時間）；用（某語言）
en: Emma was born in 2008 and now lives in Kaohsiung.
exzh: Emma 生於 2008 年，現在住在高雄。
note: 年、月、季節用 in；日期用 on；時刻用 at

en: Ken grew almost two inches taller during the summer vacation.
exzh: Ken 暑假期間長高了將近兩英寸。
note: 1 英寸約 2.54 公分；複數 inches

en: The number of students riding bikes to school has increased this year.
exzh: 今年騎腳踏車上學的學生人數增加了。
note: 名詞重音在前；an increase in…

en: Living in the dorm helped Amy become more independent.
exzh: 住宿舍讓 Amy 變得更獨立。

en: My grandfather had a strong influence on my love of reading.
exzh: 我爺爺對我熱愛閱讀有很大的影響。
note: have an influence on 對…有影響

en: My pen ran out of ink in the middle of the math test.
exzh: 我的筆在數學考試考到一半時沒水了。
note: run out of ink 沒墨水

en: We saw many colorful insects during our nature walk on the mountain.
exzh: 我們在山上走自然步道時看到很多色彩鮮豔的昆蟲。

en: It started to rain, so we moved the party inside.
exzh: 開始下雨了，所以我們把派對移到室內。

en: Kevin often eats instant noodles when he studies late at night.
exzh: Kevin 熬夜讀書時常吃泡麵。
note: instant noodles 泡麵；in an instant 一瞬間

en: Ben has a strong interest in science and wants to be an engineer.
exzh: Ben 對科學很有興趣，想當工程師。
note: have an interest in 對…有興趣

en: Are you interested in joining the school photography club?
exzh: 你有興趣加入學校的攝影社嗎？
note: be interested in + N/V-ing；人用 interested，事物用 interesting

en: Our history teacher always tells interesting stories about old Taiwan.
exzh: 我們歷史老師總是講關於早期台灣的有趣故事。

en: Our school holds an international culture fair every spring.
exzh: 我們學校每年春天舉辦國際文化博覽會。

en: I use the internet to look up words I don't know.
exzh: 我用網路查不認識的單字。
note: on the internet 在網路上；也常寫作 the Internet

en: Lisa practiced answering questions before her college interview.
exzh: Lisa 在大學面試前先練習回答問題。

en: Tom jumped into the pool as soon as he got there.
exzh: Tom 一到那裡就跳進游泳池。
note: turn A into B 把 A 變成 B

en: Emma invited all her classmates to her birthday party on Saturday.
exzh: Emma 邀請全班同學參加她星期六的生日派對。
note: invite sb. to + N；名詞 invitation

en: The old bridge in our town is made of iron and wood.
exzh: 我們鎮上那座老橋是用鐵和木頭做的。

en: Taiwan is an island with high mountains and beautiful beaches.
exzh: 台灣是一座有高山和美麗海灘的島嶼。

en: Take a jacket with you because it gets cold in the evening.
exzh: 帶件外套吧，因為傍晚會變冷。

en: Mia spread strawberry jam on her toast for breakfast.
exzh: Mia 早餐在吐司上塗草莓果醬。

en: Our final exams usually take place in January before winter vacation.
exzh: 我們的期末考通常在一月、寒假前舉行。
note: 月份首字母大寫；縮寫 Jan.

en: Leo usually wears jeans and a T-shirt on weekends.
exzh: Leo 週末通常穿牛仔褲和 T 恤。
note: 恆用複數；a pair of jeans

en: Amy found a part-time job at a bakery during summer vacation.
exzh: Amy 暑假在一家麵包店找到一份打工。
note: do a good job 做得好

en: Ken jogs around the school track every morning before class.
exzh: Ken 每天早上上課前繞著學校跑道慢跑。
note: 過去式 jogged；go jogging 去慢跑

en: Tom decided to join the basketball team this semester.
exzh: Tom 決定這學期加入籃球隊。
note: join + 團體；take part in + 活動

en: Ben told a funny joke, and the whole class laughed.
exzh: Ben 講了一個好笑的笑話，全班都笑了。
note: tell a joke 講笑話；play a joke on sb. 捉弄某人

en: Our team shouted with joy when we won the final game.
exzh: 我們隊贏得決賽時高興得大叫。

en: Three teachers served as judges for the English speech contest.
exzh: 三位老師擔任英文演講比賽的評審。
note: Don't judge a book by its cover. 勿以貌取人

en: I'd like a glass of orange juice with my sandwich.
exzh: 我想要一杯柳橙汁配三明治。

en: We are planning a family trip to Hualien in July.
exzh: 我們計畫七月全家去花蓮旅行。
note: 月份首字母大寫；縮寫 Jul.

en: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over my cup.
exzh: 貓跳上桌子，打翻了我的杯子。

en: The school year in Taiwan usually ends in late June.
exzh: 台灣的學年通常在六月底結束。
note: 月份首字母大寫；縮寫 Jun.

en: Mia and I have been best friends since junior high school.
exzh: Mia 和我從國中起就是最好的朋友。

en: I just finished my homework, so I can play games now.
exzh: 我剛寫完作業，所以現在可以玩遊戲了。

en: Please keep the classroom clean after you finish eating lunch.
exzh: 吃完午餐後請保持教室整潔。

en: Leo always puts too much ketchup on his french fries.
exzh: Leo 總是在薯條上加太多番茄醬。

en: I can't open the door because I left my key at school.
exzh: 我打不開門，因為我把鑰匙忘在學校了。

en: Kevin kicked the ball hard and scored the winning goal.
exzh: Kevin 用力一踢，踢進了致勝的一球。

en: My aunt has two kids, and they both love playing soccer.
exzh: 我阿姨有兩個小孩，他們都很愛踢足球。

en: The cold weather killed most of the flowers in our garden.
exzh: 寒冷的天氣凍死了我們花園裡大部分的花。

en: My backpack weighs almost five kilograms because of all my textbooks.
exzh: 因為裝滿課本，我的背包重將近五公斤。

en: It was kind of you to help me carry these boxes.
exzh: 你真好心，幫我搬這些箱子。
note: a kind of 一種；kind of 有點

en: The king in the story gave his gold to the poor people.
exzh: 故事裡的國王把他的金子送給窮人。

en: My mom kissed my little sister goodnight and turned off the light.
exzh: 我媽媽親了妹妹一下道晚安，然後關燈。

en: Dad is cooking beef noodles in the kitchen for dinner tonight.
exzh: 爸爸正在廚房煮牛肉麵當今天的晚餐。

en: We flew kites on the beach on a windy Saturday afternoon.
exzh: 我們在一個有風的星期六下午到海邊放風箏。

en: Ken fell off his bike and hurt his knee on the way home.
exzh: Ken 回家路上從腳踏車上摔下來，傷到了膝蓋。

en: Please use this knife to cut the cake into eight pieces.
exzh: 請用這把刀把蛋糕切成八塊。

en: Someone knocked on the door while we were having dinner.
exzh: 我們吃晚餐時有人敲門。
note: knock on/at the door 敲門

en: Do you know where the new convenience store is?
exzh: 你知道那間新開的便利商店在哪裡嗎？

en: Reading the news every day can increase your knowledge of the world.
exzh: 每天閱讀新聞可以增加你對世界的認識。

en: Many students feel tired in class because of a lack of sleep.
exzh: 很多學生因為睡眠不足而在課堂上感到疲累。
note: 名詞 lack of + N；動詞 lack 直接接受詞，不加 of

en: A kind lady helped us find the way to the museum.
exzh: 一位好心的女士幫我們找到去博物館的路。
note: 複數 ladies；ladies and gentlemen 各位先生女士

en: We rented bikes and rode around the lake last summer.
exzh: 我們去年夏天租了腳踏車繞著湖騎。

en: The lamb on the farm followed the kids everywhere they went.
exzh: 農場上的小羊跟著孩子們到處跑。

en: I turned on the desk lamp to read my notes before bed.
exzh: 我睡前打開檯燈看筆記。

en: Our plane landed in Tokyo at about three in the afternoon.
exzh: 我們的飛機大約下午三點在東京降落。
note: 反義 take off 起飛

en: Besides English, Emma is learning Japanese as a second foreign language.
exzh: 除了英文，Emma 也在學日文當第二外語。

en: We made paper lanterns for the Lantern Festival at school.
exzh: 我們在學校為元宵節做了紙燈籠。

en: I ordered a large milk tea with less sugar.
exzh: 我點了一杯大杯少糖奶茶。
note: a large number of + 可數複數名詞

en: We went camping in the mountains last weekend.
exzh: 我們上週末去山上露營。
note: 當動詞表「持續」：The rain lasted all day.

en: Ben was late for school because he missed the bus.
exzh: Ben 因為錯過公車而上學遲到。
note: be late for 遲到；lately 最近

en: I'm busy now, so I'll call you back later.
exzh: 我現在在忙，所以晚點再回電給你。

en: Kevin always wants to buy the latest phone.
exzh: Kevin 總是想買最新款的手機。

en: Everyone laughed when our teacher wore a funny hat to class.
exzh: 我們老師戴了一頂好笑的帽子來上課時，大家都笑了。

en: In Taiwan, the law says riders must wear helmets on scooters.
exzh: 在台灣，法律規定騎機車必須戴安全帽。

en: Lisa wants to study law and become a lawyer in the future.
exzh: Lisa 想讀法律，將來當律師。

en: Mia laid her books on the desk and sat down.
exzh: Mia 把書放在桌上，然後坐下。

en: I felt too lazy to cook, so I bought dinner at the night market.
exzh: 我懶得煮飯，所以去夜市買晚餐。

en: Our teacher will lead the group on the hiking trip tomorrow.
exzh: 我們老師明天會帶領全組去健行。

en: Emma was chosen as the leader of our science project team.
exzh: Emma 被選為我們科展小組的組長。

en: In autumn, the leaves on that tree turn red and yellow.
exzh: 秋天時，那棵樹的葉子會變成紅色和黃色。

en: Leo learned to swim when he was in elementary school.
exzh: Leo 小學時學會了游泳。

en: You should drink at least six glasses of water a day.
exzh: 你一天應該至少喝六杯水。

en: The train leaves at seven, so don't be late.
exzh: 火車七點開，所以別遲到。
note: leave–left–left；leave A for B 離開 A 前往 B

en: Turn left at the corner, and you will see the post office.
exzh: 在轉角左轉，就會看到郵局。
note: left 也是 leave 的過去式

en: My legs were sore after running in the school marathon.
exzh: 參加學校馬拉松後，我的腿很痠。

en: Mom adds a little lemon juice to the fish before cooking it.
exzh: 媽媽在煮魚前會加一點檸檬汁。

en: Could you lend me your notes from yesterday's chemistry class?
exzh: 你可以把昨天化學課的筆記借我嗎？

en: You should spend less time on your phone and more on sleep.
exzh: 你應該少花點時間在手機上，多睡一點。

en: Amy has taken piano lessons every Saturday morning since she was eight.
exzh: Amy 從八歲起每週六早上都上鋼琴課。
note: learn a lesson 學到教訓

en: My parents let me stay up late on Friday nights.
exzh: 我爸媽週五晚上讓我晚睡。
note: let + 人 + 原形動詞；三態同形

en: Tom wrote a thank-you letter to his teacher on Teachers' Day.
exzh: Tom 在教師節寫了一封感謝信給他的老師。

en: This English book is too easy for my reading level.
exzh: 這本英文書對我的閱讀程度來說太簡單了。

en: Kevin studies in the school library after class every day.
exzh: Kevin 每天放學後在學校圖書館讀書。

en: Put the lid back on the pot so the soup stays hot.
exzh: 把蓋子蓋回鍋子上，湯才會保持熱。

en: After the long hike, I just wanted to lie on my bed.
exzh: 長途健行後，我只想躺在床上。

en: High school life is busy, but it is also full of fun.
exzh: 高中生活很忙碌，但也充滿樂趣。

en: Can you help me lift this heavy box onto the shelf?
exzh: 你可以幫我把這個重箱子抬到架子上嗎？
note: give sb. a lift 載某人一程

en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.
exzh: 離開教室時請關燈。
note: turn on/off the light 開／關燈

en: Ben likes playing basketball with his friends after school.
exzh: Ben 喜歡放學後和朋友打籃球。
note: would like to V 想要；look like 看起來像

en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
exzh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。
note: be likely to V 可能會…

en: We waited in line for an hour to buy the new bubble tea.
exzh: 我們排隊排了一個小時買新口味的珍珠奶茶。

en: Our teacher sent us a link to the online quiz.
exzh: 老師傳給我們線上小考的連結。
note: link A to/with B 把 A 與 B 連結

en: The lion at the zoo was sleeping under a big tree.
exzh: 動物園的獅子正在一棵大樹下睡覺。

en: My lips get dry in winter, so I always carry lip balm.
exzh: 我的嘴唇冬天容易乾，所以總是帶著護唇膏。

en: Mom made a shopping list before we went to the supermarket.
exzh: 媽媽在我們去超市前列了一張購物清單。

en: Leo likes to listen to music while he does his homework.
exzh: Leo 喜歡邊寫作業邊聽音樂。
note: listen to + 受詞；hear 強調「聽到」

en: There is only a little milk left in the fridge.
exzh: 冰箱裡只剩一點牛奶。
note: a little 有一些、little 幾乎沒有，修飾不可數

en: Emma lives with her grandparents near the beach in Yilan.
exzh: Emma 和她的祖父母住在宜蘭的海邊附近。
note: 形容詞 live 讀音不同，意為「現場的」

en: Our family watches movies together in the living room on weekends.
exzh: 我們家週末會一起在客廳看電影。

en: We tried some local snacks at the night market in Tainan.
exzh: 我們在台南的夜市吃了一些當地小吃。

en: Lisa felt lonely during her first week at the new school.
exzh: Lisa 在新學校的第一週覺得很孤單。

en: We had a long day of classes and club activities.
exzh: 我們上了一整天的課又參加社團活動，真是漫長的一天。
note: long for 渴望；as long as 只要

en: You look tired today; did you stay up late again?
exzh: 你今天看起來很累，又熬夜了嗎？
note: look at 看；look for 尋找；look like 看起來像

en: I lost my umbrella on the MRT this morning.
exzh: 我今天早上把雨傘掉在捷運上了。

en: The music next door was so loud that I couldn't study.
exzh: 隔壁的音樂太大聲，我沒辦法讀書。

en: My grandma loves growing vegetables in her small garden.
exzh: 我奶奶很喜歡在她的小菜園種菜。
note: love + V-ing / to V 喜愛做…

zh: 可愛的；美好的；令人愉快的
en: We had a lovely picnic by the river last Sunday.
exzh: 上週日我們在河邊野餐，玩得很愉快。
