en: The price of this jacket is low because it's on sale.
exzh: 這件外套的價格很低，因為正在特價。

en: Tom was lucky to find his lost wallet at the station.
exzh: Tom 很幸運，在車站找回了遺失的錢包。
note: luck 運氣；Good luck! 祝好運

en: We usually eat lunch in the classroom and then take a nap.
exzh: 我們通常在教室吃午餐，然後午睡。

en: I bought a cold drink from the vending machine near the gym.
exzh: 我在體育館附近的販賣機買了一瓶冷飲。
note: washing machine 洗衣機；vending machine 販賣機

en: My mom got mad because I forgot to clean my room again.
exzh: 我媽媽生氣了，因為我又忘了打掃房間。
note: be mad at sb. 生某人的氣

en: Ken reads a science magazine in the library every Friday.
exzh: Ken 每週五在圖書館看科學雜誌。

en: Ben showed us a magic trick with a deck of cards.
exzh: Ben 用一副撲克牌表演了一個魔術給我們看。

en: My grandparents still send me birthday cards by mail every year.
exzh: 我的祖父母每年仍用郵寄的方式寄生日卡給我。
note: by mail 用郵寄；email 電子郵件

en: The mail carrier brings letters to our building every morning around ten.
exzh: 郵差每天早上十點左右會把信送到我們大樓。

en: The mailman left a package for my mom at the front door.
exzh: 郵差把一個包裹留在門口給我媽媽。

en: The main reason Ben joined the club was to make new friends.
exzh: Ben 加入社團的主要原因是想交新朋友。
note: main idea 主旨；main road 主要道路

en: Lisa wants to major in English when she goes to college.
exzh: Lisa 上大學時想主修英文。
note: major in 主修…；反義 minor

en: My dad makes pancakes for the whole family every Sunday morning.
exzh: 我爸爸每個星期天早上都會幫全家人做鬆餅。
note: make–made–made；make sb. do 使某人做

en: There are more male students than female students in our science class.
exzh: 我們自然課班上的男生比女生多。

en: The man at the bus stop asked us how to get to the museum.
exzh: 公車站的那位男士問我們怎麼去博物館。

en: The manager of the restaurant gave us free drinks after the long wait.
exzh: 等了很久之後，餐廳經理免費招待我們飲料。

en: Mango shaved ice is one of the most popular desserts in Taiwan during summer.
exzh: 芒果冰是台灣夏天最受歡迎的甜點之一。

en: Our teacher always speaks to us in a kind and patient manner.
exzh: 我們老師總是用親切又有耐心的態度跟我們說話。
note: table manners 餐桌禮儀；have good manners 有禮貌

en: How many students in your class have their own phones?
exzh: 你們班上有多少學生有自己的手機？
note: 接可數名詞；不可數用 much

en: Kevin used a map on his phone to find the night market.
exzh: Kevin 用手機上的地圖找到了夜市。

en: Mia got high marks on her math test and felt very proud.
exzh: Mia 數學考試拿了高分，覺得很驕傲。
note: full marks 滿分；mark 也可當動詞「標記」

en: My grandma goes to the market early to buy fresh vegetables.
exzh: 我奶奶很早就去市場買新鮮的蔬菜。
note: night market 夜市；supermarket 超市

en: My aunt has been married for ten years and has two kids.
exzh: 我阿姨結婚十年了，有兩個小孩。
note: get married 結婚；be married to sb.

en: My cousin will marry her college classmate next spring in Tainan.
exzh: 我表姊明年春天要在台南和她的大學同學結婚。

en: Ken wears a mask on the MRT when he has a cold.
exzh: Ken 感冒時搭捷運會戴口罩。

en: A mass of people waited outside the stadium for the concert to start.
exzh: 一大群人在體育館外等演唱會開始。
note: mass media 大眾傳播媒體

en: It takes years of practice to master a musical instrument like the violin.
exzh: 要精通像小提琴這樣的樂器需要多年的練習。

en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before you come inside.
exzh: 進來之前請在腳踏墊上擦一下鞋子。

en: Lisa won her tennis match easily and moved on to the next round.
exzh: Lisa 輕鬆贏得網球比賽，晉級下一輪。
note: match 當動詞＝搭配：The shirt matches your pants.

en: Tom finds math hard, so he studies with Leo after school.
exzh: Tom 覺得數學很難，所以放學後和 Leo 一起讀書。
note: mathematics 的縮寫；英式為 maths

en: Mathematics is an important subject for students who want to study engineering.
exzh: 對想讀工程的學生來說，數學是重要的科目。
note: 形式為複數但當單數用

en: It doesn't matter if you are late; we will wait for you.
exzh: 你遲到也沒關係，我們會等你。
note: What's the matter? 怎麼了？；no matter 無論

en: It may rain this afternoon, so remember to bring an umbrella.
exzh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以記得帶傘。
note: May I...? 禮貌請求；may 後接原形動詞

en: Maybe we can go hiking this weekend if the weather is nice.
exzh: 如果天氣好，也許我們這個週末可以去爬山。
note: maybe（副詞，句首）≠ may be（助動詞＋be）

en: Eating a healthy meal before an exam helps you stay focused.
exzh: 考試前吃一頓健康的餐點能幫助你保持專注。
note: three meals a day 一日三餐

en: What does this word mean in the second paragraph of the article?
exzh: 這個字在文章第二段是什麼意思？

en: Amy looked up the meaning of the word in her dictionary app.
exzh: Amy 在字典 app 上查了這個字的意思。

en: My brother doesn't eat meat, so he usually orders vegetable noodles.
exzh: 我哥哥不吃肉，所以他通常點蔬菜麵。
note: 不可數；勿與 meet 混淆

en: Take this medicine three times a day after meals.
exzh: 這個藥一天吃三次，飯後服用。
note: take medicine 吃藥（用 take 不用 eat）

en: Let's meet in front of the library at two o'clock tomorrow.
exzh: 我們明天兩點在圖書館前面見面吧。

en: Our class leaders have a meeting with the principal every Friday.
exzh: 我們班級幹部每週五和校長開會。

en: Lisa became a member of the school dance club last semester.
exzh: Lisa 上學期成為學校熱舞社的社員。

en: Our trip to Kenting is one of my best memories from high school.
exzh: 我們的墾丁之旅是我高中最美好的回憶之一。
note: have a good memory 記性好；memorize 背誦

en: Excuse me, is the men's room on this floor or the next one?
exzh: 不好意思，男廁在這一層還是下一層？
note: 女廁 ladies' room / women's room

en: The waiter gave us the menu and asked what we would like.
exzh: 服務生給我們菜單，問我們想點什麼。

en: This water bottle is made of metal, so it won't break if you drop it.
exzh: 這個水壺是金屬做的，所以掉到地上也不會破。

en: Emma can swim one hundred meters in less than two minutes.
exzh: Emma 能在兩分鐘內游完一百公尺。

en: We took the metro to the city center to avoid the traffic.
exzh: 我們搭地鐵到市中心以避開塞車。

en: Ben sat in the middle of the front row during the class photo.
exzh: 拍班級照時，Ben 坐在第一排的中間。
note: in the middle of 在…中間

en: My sister often studies until midnight before big exams.
exzh: 我姊姊在大考前常常讀書讀到半夜。

en: You might feel tired tomorrow if you stay up too late tonight.
exzh: 如果你今晚熬夜太晚，明天可能會覺得累。
note: 可能性比 may 稍低

en: The school is about one mile from my house, so I walk.
exzh: 學校離我家大約一英里，所以我走路上學。

en: Mia drinks a glass of warm milk before she goes to bed.
exzh: Mia 睡前會喝一杯溫牛奶。

en: The singer's new video got over one million views in a week.
exzh: 那位歌手的新影片一週內觀看次數就超過一百萬。
note: two million（不加 s）；millions of 數以百萬的

en: Would you mind closing the window? It's a little cold in here.
exzh: 你介意關一下窗戶嗎？這裡有點冷。
note: mind + V-ing；change one's mind 改變主意

en: This blue umbrella is mine, and the black one is Kevin's.
exzh: 這把藍色的傘是我的，黑色那把是 Kevin 的。
note: 所有格代名詞：mine, yours, his, hers

zh: 次要的；較小的；未成年人
en: Don't worry about it; it's only a minor problem with your phone.
exzh: 別擔心，那只是你手機的一個小問題。

en: The bus will arrive in five minutes, so let's wait here.
exzh: 公車五分鐘後到，我們在這裡等吧。

en: Leo checked his hair in the mirror before leaving for school.
exzh: Leo 出門上學前照鏡子檢查了頭髮。

en: Hurry up, or we will miss the first train to Hualien.
exzh: 快一點，不然我們會錯過往花蓮的第一班火車。
note: miss 也作「想念」：I miss you.

en: Everyone makes mistakes, so don't be afraid to speak English in class.
exzh: 每個人都會犯錯，所以上課別怕說英文。
note: make a mistake 犯錯；by mistake 錯誤地

en: Mix the flour and eggs together before you add the milk.
exzh: 加牛奶之前，先把麵粉和蛋混合在一起。
note: mix A with B；mixture 混合物

en: Ken spent the whole weekend building a model of a train.
exzh: Ken 花了整個週末組裝一個火車模型。

en: The new library has a modern design with lots of glass windows.
exzh: 新圖書館是現代化的設計，有很多玻璃窗。

en: Please wait a moment while I find my student ID card.
exzh: 請稍等一下，我找一下我的學生證。
note: at the moment 此刻；for a moment 片刻

en: We have a math quiz every Monday, so I review on Sunday night.
exzh: 我們每週一都有數學小考，所以我星期天晚上會複習。
note: 星期名稱首字母大寫；on Monday

en: Amy saves part of her pocket money every week to buy a new phone.
exzh: Amy 每週存一部分零用錢來買新手機。
note: 不可數；pocket money 零用錢

en: We saw a monkey stealing food from a tourist on the mountain.
exzh: 我們在山上看到一隻猴子搶遊客的食物。

en: Our school sports day will be held next month, so we practice every day.
exzh: 我們學校運動會在下個月舉行，所以我們每天練習。

en: Families in Taiwan enjoy the full moon together during the Moon Festival.
exzh: 台灣的家家戶戶會在中秋節一起賞滿月。
note: the moon（加 the）；full moon 滿月

en: After the party, Tom helped mop the classroom floor.
exzh: 派對結束後，Tom 幫忙拖教室的地板。

en: You should drink more water when you exercise on hot days.
exzh: 大熱天運動時，你應該多喝水。
note: many/much 的比較級；more and more 越來越

en: I usually go jogging in the park early in the morning.
exzh: 我通常一大早去公園慢跑。
note: in the morning；on Monday morning（特定日用 on）

en: Most students in my class take the bus to school.
exzh: 我們班大部分的學生搭公車上學。
note: most of the + 名詞；the most + 形容詞（最高級）

en: The video shows the motion of the ball in slow motion.
exzh: 這段影片用慢動作呈現球的移動。

en: My dad rides his motorcycle to work, even on rainy days.
exzh: 我爸爸騎機車上班，即使下雨天也一樣。
note: 台灣常說「機車」；scooter 指速克達

en: We climbed the mountain early to see the sunrise from the top.
exzh: 我們一早去爬山，想從山頂看日出。

en: Kevin bought a new wireless mouse for his computer.
exzh: Kevin 為他的電腦買了一個新的無線滑鼠。

en: Please don't talk with food in your mouth during lunch.
exzh: 吃午餐時，嘴裡有食物請不要說話。

en: Emma's family will move to Taichung after she finishes junior high.
exzh: Emma 國中畢業後，她家會搬到台中。
note: move to 搬到；be moved 被感動

en: The dance teacher showed us each movement slowly before we tried it.
exzh: 舞蹈老師在我們試跳前慢慢示範每個動作。

en: Let's watch a movie together after the final exams are over.
exzh: 期末考結束後我們一起去看電影吧。
note: go to the movies 去看電影

en: Mr. Lin teaches us history and always tells interesting stories.
exzh: 林老師教我們歷史，總是講有趣的故事。

en: Mrs. Chen lives next door and often shares fruit with us.
exzh: 陳太太住在隔壁，常常分水果給我們。
note: 用於已婚女性，後接（夫）姓

en: Taking the MRT is the fastest way to get around Taipei.
exzh: 搭捷運是在台北移動最快的方式。
note: Mass Rapid Transit 的縮寫；take the MRT

en: Ms. Wang is our new English teacher, and she is very friendly.
exzh: 王老師是我們新的英文老師，她非常親切。
note: 不分婚姻狀況的女性稱謂

en: We didn't have much time, so we ate lunch quickly.
exzh: 我們沒有太多時間，所以很快吃完午餐。
note: 接不可數名詞；How much...? 多少錢／多少

en: After the soccer game in the rain, our shoes were covered in mud.
exzh: 雨中的足球賽結束後，我們的鞋子沾滿泥巴。

en: Our class visited the science museum to learn about space.
exzh: 我們班參觀了科學博物館，學習太空知識。

en: Lisa listens to music on her phone while she does homework.
exzh: Lisa 寫作業時會用手機聽音樂。

en: Ben dreams of becoming a musician and plays the guitar every night.
exzh: Ben 夢想成為音樂家，每天晚上都彈吉他。

en: All students must wear their uniforms on Monday mornings.
exzh: 所有學生星期一早上都必須穿制服。
note: must not 禁止；must be 一定是（推測）

en: My best friend and I have known each other since elementary school.
exzh: 我和我最好的朋友從國小就認識了。
note: 所有格；mine 是所有格代名詞

en: Mia painted her nails blue for the school dance performance.
exzh: Mia 為了學校舞蹈表演把指甲塗成藍色。

en: Can you write your name and class number at the top?
exzh: 你可以在上方寫下你的名字和班級座號嗎？

en: Athletes from many nations came to Taipei for the sports event.
exzh: 來自許多國家的運動員到台北參加這場運動賽事。
note: national 國家的；international 國際的

en: Our school team won first place in the national science contest.
exzh: 我們校隊在全國科展得到第一名。

en: This juice is made from natural fruit with no added sugar.
exzh: 這杯果汁用天然水果做成，沒有添加糖。

en: Kevin loves nature, so he often goes camping with his family.
exzh: Kevin 熱愛大自然，所以常和家人去露營。

en: My little brother was naughty and hid my phone under the sofa.
exzh: 我弟弟很頑皮，把我的手機藏在沙發底下。

en: There is a convenience store near our school, so we buy snacks there.
exzh: 我們學校附近有一家便利商店，所以我們在那裡買零食。

en: Nearly all of my classmates passed the English listening test.
exzh: 我幾乎所有同學都通過了英文聽力測驗。
note: nearly ＝ almost；不是 near 的副詞「靠近地」

en: It is necessary to bring your student ID to the exam.
exzh: 考試時必須帶學生證。
note: It is necessary (for sb.) to V；necessity 必需品

en: Leo hurt his neck after sleeping in a strange position.
exzh: Leo 睡姿不良之後脖子痛。

en: Emma got a silver necklace from her parents for her birthday.
exzh: Emma 生日時收到爸媽送的一條銀項鍊。

en: We need to finish this group report by Friday afternoon.
exzh: 我們需要在星期五下午前完成這份小組報告。
note: need to V；in need 有需要的

en: My grandma used a needle and thread to fix my school uniform.
exzh: 我奶奶用針線幫我修補校服。

en: Our neighbor often helps us water the plants when we travel.
exzh: 我們去旅行時，鄰居常幫我們澆花。
note: 英式 neighbour；neighborhood 鄰近地區

en: Neither of my parents can speak Japanese, so I translate for them.
exzh: 我爸媽兩個都不會說日文，所以我幫他們翻譯。
note: neither A nor B 既不 A 也不 B

en: My nephew is only five, but he can already read simple English books.
exzh: 我姪子才五歲，但已經會讀簡單的英文書了。

en: Tom always feels nervous before he speaks in front of the class.
exzh: Tom 在全班面前說話前總是覺得很緊張。

en: The ball hit the net, so the other team got a point.
exzh: 球打到網子，所以對方得了一分。

en: I have never been to Japan, but I hope to go next summer.
exzh: 我從沒去過日本，但我希望明年夏天能去。
note: 放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

en: Mia is a new student, so let's show her around the school.
exzh: Mia 是新同學，我們帶她參觀學校吧。

en: My dad watches the news on TV every evening after dinner.
exzh: 我爸爸每天晚餐後看電視新聞。
note: 不可數，當單數：The news is good.

en: My grandpa still reads a newspaper every morning with his coffee.
exzh: 我爺爺每天早上還是邊喝咖啡邊看報紙。

en: The next bus to the train station comes in ten minutes.
exzh: 下一班往火車站的公車十分鐘後到。
note: next to 在…旁邊；next week 下週（不加 the）

en: It was nice of Ken to help me carry my books upstairs.
exzh: Ken 很好心幫我把書搬上樓。
note: It is nice of sb. to V

en: Ben bought a nice-looking jacket at the night market for a good price.
exzh: Ben 在夜市用划算的價錢買了一件好看的外套。

en: My niece loves drawing and wants to be an artist someday.
exzh: 我姪女很愛畫畫，希望將來當畫家。

en: We stayed up all night to finish our science project.
exzh: 我們熬了一整夜完成自然科專題。
note: at night 在晚上；Good night. 晚安

en: My little brother goes to bed at nine every night.
exzh: 我弟弟每天晚上九點上床睡覺。

en: Lisa's older sister is nineteen and studies at a university in Taipei.
exzh: Lisa 的姊姊十九歲，在台北讀大學。

en: My grandma is ninety, but she still walks in the park every day.
exzh: 我奶奶九十歲了，但仍然每天去公園散步。

en: There is no milk in the fridge, so I'll buy some later.
exzh: 冰箱裡沒有牛奶了，我等一下去買一些。

en: Nobody in our class knew the answer to the last question.
exzh: 我們班上沒有人知道最後一題的答案。

en: Our teacher nodded and smiled when I gave the right answer.
exzh: 我答對時，老師點頭微笑。

en: The noise from the construction next door makes it hard to study.
exzh: 隔壁工地的噪音讓人很難讀書。

en: The night market is always noisy and crowded on weekends.
exzh: 夜市週末總是又吵又擠。

en: I bought three cookies, but now there are none left in the box.
exzh: 我買了三片餅乾，但現在盒子裡一片都不剩。

en: My mom cooks beef noodles for us on cold winter evenings.
exzh: 寒冷的冬天晚上，我媽媽會煮牛肉麵給我們吃。

en: We have a short break at noon to eat lunch and take a nap.
exzh: 我們中午有短暫休息時間吃午餐和午睡。

en: Tom can neither swim nor ride a bike, but he wants to learn.
exzh: Tom 既不會游泳也不會騎腳踏車，但他想學。

en: Keelung is in the north of Taiwan, and it rains a lot there.
exzh: 基隆在台灣北部，那裡很常下雨。

en: Kevin has a runny nose, so he stayed home from school today.
exzh: Kevin 流鼻水，所以今天請假在家。

en: I am not hungry now because I ate a big breakfast.
exzh: 我現在不餓，因為早餐吃很多。
note: not only A but also B 不但 A 而且 B

en: Amy takes careful notes in every class to prepare for exams.
exzh: Amy 每堂課都仔細做筆記準備考試。
note: take notes 做筆記；leave a note 留紙條

en: Ken forgot his notebook at home, so he borrowed paper from me.
exzh: Ken 把筆記本忘在家裡，所以跟我借紙。
note: notebook computer 筆電（也說 laptop）

en: There was nothing interesting on TV, so we played board games instead.
exzh: 電視上沒什麼好看的，所以我們改玩桌遊。

en: Did you notice that Leo got a new haircut this week?
exzh: 你有注意到 Leo 這週剪了新髮型嗎？
note: notice sb. V/V-ing；bulletin 公告也可說 notice

en: Emma finished reading a long novel during the summer vacation.
exzh: Emma 在暑假讀完了一本很長的小說。

en: Our school celebrates its anniversary every November with a big sports day.
exzh: 我們學校每年十一月以盛大的運動會慶祝校慶。

en: We are leaving now, so please turn off the lights.
exzh: 我們現在要走了，所以請把燈關掉。
note: right now 立刻；from now on 從現在起

en: Can you give me your phone number so we can keep in touch?
exzh: 可以給我你的電話號碼，讓我們保持聯絡嗎？
note: a number of 許多；the number of …的數量

en: The school nurse gave Mia some ice for her hurt ankle.
exzh: 學校護理師給 Mia 一些冰塊敷受傷的腳踝。

en: Eating a few nuts every day is a healthy habit for students.
exzh: 每天吃一些堅果對學生來說是健康的習慣。

en: Everyone must obey the traffic rules when riding a bike on the road.
exzh: 在路上騎腳踏車時，每個人都必須遵守交通規則。

en: The teacher asked us to draw an object we use every day.
exzh: 老師要我們畫一個每天會用到的物品。
note: 當動詞重音在後：object to 反對

en: We watched the sun go down over the ocean from the beach.
exzh: 我們在海灘上看著夕陽沉入大海。

en: Our school sports day is usually held in October every year.
exzh: 我們學校的運動會通常每年在十月舉行。
note: 月份首字母要大寫；in October

en: One of my best friends is the captain of the basketball team.
exzh: 我最好的朋友之一是籃球隊的隊長。

en: Please turn off your phone before the exam begins.
exzh: 考試開始前請把手機關機。
note: turn off 關掉；take off 脫下、起飛

en: Kevin went to the teachers' office to hand in his homework.
exzh: Kevin 去教師辦公室交作業。

en: A police officer helped the lost tourist find the MRT station.
exzh: 一位警察幫迷路的觀光客找到捷運站。

en: Lisa often studies at the library after school.
exzh: Lisa 放學後常常在圖書館讀書。
note: 頻率副詞放一般動詞前、be 動詞後；How often…? 多久一次

en: My mom uses less oil when she cooks to keep us healthy.
exzh: 我媽媽煮菜時少用油，讓我們保持健康。

en: Is it OK if I borrow your notes for the math test?
exzh: 我可以借你的筆記準備數學考試嗎？

en: My grandfather is eighty years old, but he still walks every morning.
exzh: 我爺爺八十歲了，但他每天早上還是去散步。

en: We have a club meeting on Friday afternoon in the music room.
exzh: 我們星期五下午在音樂教室有社團會議。
note: on + 星期／日期；in + 月／年；at + 時刻

en: Ben goes swimming once a week to stay in shape.
exzh: Ben 每週去游泳一次來保持身材。
note: once a week 一週一次；twice 兩次

zh: 一；一個；（代替前述名詞）那一個
en: I lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new one.
exzh: 我弄丟了雨傘，所以得買一把新的。
note: one 代替同類單數名詞；it 指同一個東西

en: It is important to take care of oneself during exam season.
exzh: 考試期間好好照顧自己很重要。
note: 字典中代表各人稱反身代名詞（myself, yourself…）；by oneself 獨自

en: Mia is the only student in our class who can play the violin.
exzh: Mia 是我們班上唯一會拉小提琴的學生。
note: not only A but also B 不但…而且…

en: The convenience store near our school is open twenty-four hours a day.
exzh: 我們學校附近的便利商店二十四小時營業。
note: open 也是形容詞；opened 是動詞過去式

en: Would you like tea or coffee with your breakfast?
exzh: 你早餐想配茶還是咖啡？
note: 命令句 + or 否則；either A or B

en: Amy drinks a glass of orange juice every morning before school.
exzh: Amy 每天早上上學前喝一杯柳橙汁。

en: We ordered two large pizzas for the class party on Friday.
exzh: 我們為星期五的班級派對訂了兩個大披薩。
note: in order to 為了；out of order 故障

en: Some students like math, while other students prefer English.
exzh: 有些學生喜歡數學，而其他學生比較喜歡英文。
note: the other 兩者中的另一個；others 其他人

en: Our teacher gave us extra time to finish the science project.
exzh: 我們老師給我們額外的時間完成科學專題。
note: our + 名詞；ours 單獨使用

en: Their classroom is on the third floor, and ours is on the second.
exzh: 他們的教室在三樓，我們的在二樓。
note: ours = our + 名詞，後面不接名詞

en: Let's go out for dinner after the basketball game tonight.
exzh: 今晚籃球比賽後我們出去吃晚餐吧。
note: out of 從…出來；find out 查明

en: The students waited outside the classroom until the teacher arrived.
exzh: 學生們在教室外面等到老師來。

en: Over two hundred students joined the school's English speech contest.
exzh: 超過兩百位學生參加了學校的英文演講比賽。
note: over = more than；be over 結束

en: The doctor told Ken he was a little overweight and should exercise.
exzh: 醫生告訴 Ken 他有點過重，應該多運動。

en: We used the overpass to cross the busy road safely.
exzh: 我們走天橋安全地穿越繁忙的馬路。

en: Leo saved money for a year to buy his own laptop.
exzh: Leo 存了一年的錢買自己的筆電。
note: on one's own 獨自；owner 擁有者

en: The owner of the noodle shop always gives us extra soup.
exzh: 麵店老闆總是多給我們一些湯。

en: The school bus leaves at 4:30 p.m. every weekday.
exzh: 校車每個平日下午四點半出發。
note: 放在時刻之後；a.m. 上午

en: Mia packed her bag the night before the school trip.
exzh: Mia 在校外教學前一晚就把包包收拾好了。
note: pack up 收拾；a pack of 一包

en: A package from my aunt in Japan arrived at our house today.
exzh: 我住在日本的阿姨寄來的包裹今天送到我們家了。

en: Please open your English textbooks to page forty-five now.
exzh: 請大家現在把英文課本翻到第四十五頁。

en: Ben hurt his ankle in the game, and walking was painful for days.
exzh: Ben 在比賽中弄傷腳踝，好幾天走路都很痛。

en: Our club painted the walls of the old classroom bright blue.
exzh: 我們社團把舊教室的牆漆成亮藍色。
note: draw 用筆畫線條；paint 用顏料畫

en: Kevin bought a new pair of running shoes for the race.
exzh: Kevin 為了比賽買了一雙新跑鞋。
note: a pair of + 複數名詞（shoes, jeans, glasses）

en: Lisa changed into her pajamas and went to bed early.
exzh: Lisa 換上睡衣，早早就上床睡覺。
note: 恆用複數；英式拼法 pyjamas

en: Tom looked pale this morning, so the nurse let him rest.
exzh: Tom 今天早上臉色蒼白，所以護理師讓他休息。

en: My dad fried two eggs in a pan for breakfast.
exzh: 我爸爸用平底鍋煎了兩顆蛋當早餐。
note: frying pan 煎鍋；pot 深鍋

en: We watched a panda eating bamboo at the zoo last weekend.
exzh: 我們上週末在動物園看到一隻貓熊在吃竹子。

en: Papaya milk is a popular drink at night markets in Taiwan.
exzh: 木瓜牛奶是台灣夜市很受歡迎的飲料。

en: Please write your name at the top of the paper.
exzh: 請在紙張上方寫下你的名字。
note: 紙不可數：a piece of paper；a paper 指報告、考卷

en: Pardon? I didn't hear the question because the room was noisy.
exzh: 抱歉，請再說一次好嗎？教室太吵，我沒聽到問題。
note: I beg your pardon? 請再說一遍

en: My parents always come to watch my piano performances.
exzh: 我爸媽總是來看我的鋼琴表演。

en: Emma and her friends often go jogging in the park near her home.
exzh: Emma 和她的朋友常在她家附近的公園慢跑。

en: My dad left his car in the parking lot next to the hospital.
exzh: 我爸爸把車停在醫院旁邊的停車場。

en: The last part of the test was much harder than I expected.
exzh: 考試的最後一部分比我預期的難多了。

en: Our teacher asked us to choose a partner for the science experiment.
exzh: 老師要我們為自然實驗挑一位搭檔。

en: Ken studied every night and passed the math test easily.
exzh: Ken 每晚都讀書，輕鬆通過了數學考試。

en: In the past, students had to look up words in paper dictionaries.
exzh: 以前學生必須用紙本字典查單字。
note: in the past 過去；passed 是 pass 的過去式

en: Copy the link and paste it into the class group chat.
exzh: 把連結複製後貼到班級群組裡。
note: copy and paste 複製貼上

en: Our math teacher is very patient when we ask the same question twice.
exzh: 當我們同一個問題問兩次時，我們的數學老師還是很有耐心。
note: be patient with 對…有耐心；patience 耐心

en: Can you find the pattern in these numbers on the board?
exzh: 你能找出黑板上這些數字的規律嗎？

en: I paid one hundred dollars for this T-shirt at the night market.
exzh: 我在夜市花一百元買了這件 T 恤。
note: pay–paid–paid；pay for 支付；pay attention to 注意

en: We have PE twice a week, and today we're playing volleyball.
exzh: 我們一週有兩節體育課，今天要打排球。
note: 也寫作 P.E.，即 physical education

en: After the busy exam week, Amy enjoyed the peace of a quiet Sunday.
exzh: 忙碌的考試週過後，Amy 享受了一個寧靜的星期天。

en: The small mountain village was quiet and peaceful in the early morning.
exzh: 清晨的小山村安靜又祥和。

en: My grandma bought a box of sweet peaches at the market.
exzh: 我奶奶在市場買了一盒很甜的桃子。

en: Ben cut a big pear into pieces and shared it with us.
exzh: Ben 把一顆大梨子切成塊，分給我們吃。

en: Can I borrow a pen? I forgot mine at home.
exzh: 我可以借一支筆嗎？我把我的忘在家裡了。

en: You must use a pencil to fill in the answer sheet.
exzh: 你必須用鉛筆畫答案卡。

en: Many people line up outside the new bakery every morning.
exzh: 每天早上都有很多人在那家新麵包店外面排隊。
note: person 的複數，動詞用複數

en: Perhaps we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
exzh: 也許我們應該早點出發以避開車潮。

en: We have English in the third period on Mondays.
exzh: 我們星期一第三節上英文。

en: Mia is the kind of person who always helps others.
exzh: Mia 是那種總是幫助別人的人。
note: 複數 people；in person 親自

en: Don't share your personal information with strangers online.
exzh: 不要在網路上跟陌生人分享你的個人資料。

en: Our family's pet dog always waits for me at the door.
exzh: 我們家養的狗總是在門口等我。

en: Leo checked his phone to see if the bus was coming.
exzh: Leo 看了看手機，確認公車是否快來了。
note: cell phone 手機；phone call 電話通話

en: We took a group photo in front of the school gate on graduation day.
exzh: 畢業典禮那天，我們在校門前拍了團體照。
note: take a photo 拍照；= photograph

en: Physical education helps students stay healthy and relieve stress.
exzh: 體育課幫助學生保持健康並紓解壓力。

en: Emma has been playing the piano since she was six.
exzh: Emma 從六歲起就開始彈鋼琴。
note: play the piano 樂器前加 the

en: My mom will pick me up after cram school tonight.
exzh: 我媽媽今晚補習班下課後會來接我。
note: pick up 接送、撿起；pick out 挑出

en: Our class had a picnic by the river last Saturday.
exzh: 我們班上星期六在河邊野餐。
note: go on a picnic 去野餐

en: Lisa drew a picture of her cat for the art class.
exzh: Lisa 在美術課畫了一張她家貓咪的圖。

en: My aunt baked an apple pie for my birthday party.
exzh: 我阿姨為我的生日派對烤了一個蘋果派。

en: Lisa cut the pizza into eight pieces for her friends.
exzh: Lisa 把披薩切成八片分給朋友。
note: a piece of + 不可數名詞（paper, advice）

en: The farm we visited had pigs, cows, and lots of chickens.
exzh: 我們參觀的農場有豬、牛和許多雞。

en: I can't sleep well without my soft pillow.
exzh: 沒有我的軟枕頭，我就睡不好。

en: Tom used a pin to put the notice on the board.
exzh: Tom 用圖釘把公告釘在佈告欄上。

en: Amy wore a pink dress to her cousin's wedding.
exzh: Amy 穿了一件粉紅色洋裝參加表姊的婚禮。

en: Water was leaking from a broken pipe under the kitchen sink.
exzh: 廚房水槽下有一根破水管在漏水。

en: We shared a large pizza after the soccer game.
exzh: 足球比賽後我們分吃了一個大披薩。

en: The night market is my favorite place to eat with friends.
exzh: 夜市是我最喜歡和朋友一起吃東西的地方。
note: take place 發生、舉行；in place of 代替

en: We plan to visit Hualien during the winter vacation.
exzh: 我們打算寒假去花蓮玩。

en: Our plane landed in Tokyo after a three-hour flight.
exzh: 經過三小時的飛行，我們的飛機降落在東京。

en: Earth is the only planet we know that has life.
exzh: 地球是我們所知唯一有生命的行星。

en: Our class planted ten small trees around the school field.
exzh: 我們班在學校操場周圍種了十棵小樹。

en: Please put the dirty plates in the sink after dinner.
exzh: 晚餐後請把髒盤子放進水槽。

en: We waited on the platform for the next train to Taichung.
exzh: 我們在月台上等下一班開往台中的火車。

en: Kevin and his friends play basketball every day after school.
exzh: Kevin 和他的朋友每天放學後打籃球。
note: play + 球類（不加 the）；play the + 樂器

en: Leo is the best player on our school's baseball team.
exzh: Leo 是我們校棒球隊最好的球員。

en: Students gather on the playground for the morning assembly.
exzh: 學生們在操場集合參加朝會。

en: Please turn down the music; I'm trying to study.
exzh: 請把音樂關小聲，我正在讀書。
note: pleased 高興的；pleasant 令人愉快的

en: Our coach was pleased with how hard we practiced this week.
exzh: 教練對我們這週練習的努力很滿意。
note: be pleased with 對…滿意；Pleased to meet you.

en: It was a pleasure to work with you on this project.
exzh: 能和你一起做這個專題是我的榮幸。
note: My pleasure. 不客氣（回應道謝）

en: The ticket costs 300 dollars, plus 50 dollars for the bus.
exzh: 門票三百元，再加上五十元車資。
note: minus 減；plus 也可指「優點」

en: Ken put his phone in his pocket and ran to catch the bus.
exzh: Ken 把手機放進口袋，跑去趕公車。

en: Each student has to write a short poem for the English class.
exzh: 每位學生都要為英文課寫一首短詩。

en: Our team won the game by just two points.
exzh: 我們隊只以兩分之差贏了比賽。
note: point out 指出；point of view 觀點

en: Some mushrooms contain poison, so never eat wild ones you find.
exzh: 有些菇類含有毒素，所以千萬別吃你找到的野生菇。

en: The police closed the road because of the heavy flooding.
exzh: 因為嚴重淹水，警方封閉了那條路。
note: the police 視為複數，動詞用複數

en: It is polite to say thank you when someone helps you.
exzh: 有人幫你時說聲謝謝是有禮貌的。

en: There are many colorful fish in the pond behind our library.
exzh: 我們圖書館後面的池塘裡有許多色彩繽紛的魚。

en: Our school has an indoor pool, so we can swim all year.
exzh: 我們學校有室內游泳池，所以一整年都能游泳。

en: Ben's grades were poor last semester, but he is working harder now.
exzh: Ben 上學期成績很差，但他現在更努力了。
note: be poor at 不擅長；the poor 窮人

zh: 流行的；流行音樂；突然出現
en: Lisa listens to pop songs on her phone on the way to school.
exzh: Lisa 上學途中用手機聽流行歌曲。
note: pop up 突然出現；pop 源自 popular

en: Many teenagers in Taiwan enjoy listening to Korean pop music.
exzh: 台灣有許多青少年喜歡聽韓國流行音樂。

en: We bought a big bucket of popcorn before the movie started.
exzh: 電影開始前我們買了一大桶爆米花。

en: Bubble tea is popular among students all over Taiwan.
exzh: 珍珠奶茶在全台灣的學生之間都很受歡迎。

en: Braised pork rice is one of my favorite Taiwanese dishes.
exzh: 滷肉飯是我最喜歡的台灣料理之一。
note: pig 豬；beef 牛肉；chicken 雞肉

en: What position does Tom play on the volleyball team?
exzh: Tom 在排球隊打什麼位置？

en: Please hand in your report as soon as possible.
exzh: 請盡快交出你的報告。
note: as soon as possible 盡快；impossible 不可能的

en: I went to the post office to mail a package to my cousin.
exzh: 我去郵局寄包裹給我表哥。

en: Mia sent us a postcard from her trip to Japan.
exzh: Mia 去日本旅行時寄給我們一張明信片。

en: My mom cooked a big pot of chicken soup for the family.
exzh: 我媽媽為家人煮了一大鍋雞湯。

en: Kevin ordered fried chicken and mashed potatoes for lunch.
exzh: Kevin 午餐點了炸雞和馬鈴薯泥。
note: 複數 potatoes；sweet potato 地瓜

en: My little brother's school bag weighs about ten pounds.
exzh: 我弟弟的書包大約重十磅。
note: 1 磅約 0.45 公斤；也是英國貨幣

en: The power went out during the typhoon, so we used flashlights.
exzh: 颱風期間停電了，所以我們用手電筒。
note: power outage 停電；powerful 強有力的

en: The band practices every Wednesday after school in the music room.
exzh: 樂隊每週三放學後在音樂教室練習。
note: practice + V-ing；英式動詞拼作 practise

en: Our teacher praised Emma for her excellent speech.
exzh: 老師稱讚 Emma 的演講很出色。
note: praise sb for sth 因某事稱讚某人

en: Kevin prayed for sunny weather before the school sports day.
exzh: Kevin 祈禱學校運動會那天會是晴天。
note: pray for 為…祈禱；prey 獵物（同音）

en: Lisa stayed up late to prepare for her history test.
exzh: Lisa 熬夜準備歷史考試。
note: prepare for 為…做準備；preparation 準備

zh: 禮物；出席的；現在的；呈現
en: Ben gave his mom a scarf as a birthday present.
exzh: Ben 送媽媽一條圍巾當生日禮物。
note: 動詞重音在後；at present 目前

en: Amy was elected president of the student council this year.
exzh: Amy 今年被選為學生會會長。
note: vice president 副總統、副會長

en: The test was pretty easy, so everyone finished early.
exzh: 考試相當簡單，所以大家都提早寫完。
note: pretty 當副詞 = quite 相當

en: The price of vegetables goes up after a typhoon.
exzh: 颱風過後菜價會上漲。
note: 價格高低用 high／low，不用 expensive／cheap

en: During our trip to Italy, a priest showed us around the old church.
exzh: 我們去義大利旅行時，一位神父帶我們參觀那座古老的教堂。

en: The prince in the story finally returns to his kingdom.
exzh: 故事裡的王子最後回到了他的王國。

en: My little sister dressed up as a princess for the Halloween party.
exzh: 我妹妹在萬聖節派對上打扮成公主。

en: Being honest is an important principle in our family.
exzh: 誠實是我們家很重要的原則。

en: Can you print out the class schedule for me?
exzh: 你可以幫我把課表印出來嗎？

en: The printer in the library is out of paper again.
exzh: 圖書館的印表機又沒紙了。

en: Leo won first prize in the school science fair.
exzh: Leo 在學校科展得了第一名。
note: win first prize 得第一名；price 價格易混

en: It will probably rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
exzh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

en: If you have any problems with the homework, just ask me.
exzh: 如果你作業有任何問題，儘管問我。
note: question 指「提問」，problem 指「難題」

en: Taiwan produces many kinds of delicious tropical fruit.
exzh: 台灣生產許多種美味的熱帶水果。

en: Our drama club's new production will be performed next month.
exzh: 我們戲劇社的新作品將在下個月演出。

en: My grandparents watch a cooking program on TV every evening.
exzh: 我爺爺奶奶每天晚上看電視上的烹飪節目。

en: My parents were proud of me when I won the speech contest.
exzh: 我贏得演講比賽時，爸媽以我為榮。
note: be proud of 以…為榮；pride 驕傲（名詞）

en: Please keep your voice down on public transportation like the MRT.
exzh: 搭捷運等大眾運輸工具時請降低音量。
note: in public 公開地；public transportation 大眾運輸

en: Ben pulled the heavy door open and let his classmates go in first.
exzh: Ben 把沉重的門拉開，讓同學先進去。
note: 反義 push；pull over 靠邊停車

en: My mom made pumpkin soup for dinner on a cold winter night.
exzh: 媽媽在寒冷的冬夜煮了南瓜湯當晚餐。

en: Our neighbor's new puppy keeps running around the yard and chasing leaves.
exzh: 鄰居新養的小狗一直在院子裡跑來跑去追葉子。

en: Lisa bought a purple phone case because it is her favorite color.
exzh: Lisa 買了紫色手機殼，因為那是她最喜歡的顏色。

en: The purpose of this club is to help students practice speaking English.
exzh: 這個社團的目的是幫助學生練習說英文。

en: Kevin pushed his bike up the hill because the tire was flat.
exzh: Kevin 因為輪胎沒氣，只好把腳踏車推上山坡。
note: 反義 pull；push the button 按按鈕

en: Please put your phones in the box before the test begins.
exzh: 考試開始前，請把手機放進盒子裡。

en: Mia and her brother spent the whole weekend finishing a huge puzzle.
exzh: Mia 和弟弟花了整個週末完成一幅超大的拼圖。

zh: 四分之一；一刻鐘（十五分鐘）
en: The bus leaves at a quarter past seven, so don't be late.
exzh: 公車七點十五分開，所以別遲到。
note: a quarter past／to 幾點過／差十五分

en: In the story, the queen gave the brave farmer a bag of gold.
exzh: 在故事裡，女王給了那位勇敢的農夫一袋金子。

en: If you have any questions about the homework, ask our teacher after class.
exzh: 如果你對作業有任何問題，下課後問老師。
note: ask a question 問問題；problem 指待解決的難題

en: Tom took a quick shower and ran to catch the early bus.
exzh: Tom 很快沖了個澡，跑去趕早班公車。

en: Please be quiet in the library because other students are studying.
exzh: 在圖書館請保持安靜，因為其他同學在讀書。

en: The math test was quite difficult, but most of us passed it.
exzh: 這次數學考試相當難，但我們大多數人都及格了。

en: We have an English vocabulary quiz every Monday morning.
exzh: 我們每週一早上都有英文單字小考。

en: Emma feeds her pet rabbit fresh carrots and leaves every evening.
exzh: Emma 每天晚上餵她的寵物兔新鮮的紅蘿蔔和菜葉。

en: Leo won the 100-meter race at our school sports day.
exzh: Leo 在學校運動會贏得一百公尺賽跑。

en: My dad listens to the radio while he drives to work.
exzh: 爸爸開車上班時會聽廣播。
note: listen to the radio 聽廣播

en: The old railroad along the coast is now a popular bike path.
exzh: 沿著海岸的舊鐵路現在是很受歡迎的自行車道。

en: We took the mountain railway to see the sunrise at Alishan.
exzh: 我們搭登山鐵路去阿里山看日出。
note: 英式用法；美式多用 railroad

en: It started to rain heavily just as we left the school gate.
exzh: 我們剛走出校門，就開始下起大雨。

en: After the storm, a bright rainbow appeared over the mountains.
exzh: 暴風雨過後，山上出現一道明亮的彩虹。

en: My dad always keeps a raincoat under his scooter seat.
exzh: 爸爸總是在機車座椅下放一件雨衣。

en: On rainy days, many students take the MRT instead of riding bikes.
exzh: 下雨天，很多學生改搭捷運，不騎腳踏車。

en: If you know the answer, please raise your hand.
exzh: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。
note: 及物動詞；比較 rise（不及物）

en: It is rare to see snow in Taipei, even in winter.
exzh: 即使在冬天，台北也很少見到雪。

en: A big rat ran across the kitchen floor and scared my sister.
exzh: 一隻大老鼠跑過廚房地板，嚇到了我妹妹。
note: rat 比 mouse 體型大

en: I would rather stay home and study than go to the movies tonight.
exzh: 今晚我寧願待在家讀書，也不要去看電影。
note: would rather A than B 寧願 A 也不要 B

en: We finally reached the top of the mountain after hiking for three hours.
exzh: 我們爬了三個小時，終於到達山頂。

en: Amy reads a few pages of an English novel before bed every night.
exzh: Amy 每晚睡前讀幾頁英文小說。

en: Are you ready for the final exam next week?
exzh: 你準備好下週的期末考了嗎？

en: The movie is based on the real life of a brave teacher.
exzh: 這部電影是根據一位勇敢老師的真實人生改編的。

en: I really enjoyed the class trip to Hualien last month.
exzh: 我真的很喜歡上個月去花蓮的校外教學。

en: Can you tell me the reason why you were late this morning?
exzh: 你能告訴我你今天早上遲到的原因嗎？
note: the reason for N／why 子句

en: Stop at the corner when the traffic light turns red.
exzh: 紅燈亮時要在路口停下。

en: Please put the leftover rice in the refrigerator after dinner.
exzh: 晚餐後請把剩飯放進冰箱。

en: Getting regular exercise helps students stay healthy and sleep better.
exzh: 規律運動有助於學生保持健康、睡得更好。

en: The principal rejected our idea of having no homework on Fridays.
exzh: 校長拒絕了我們週五不用寫作業的提議。

en: During Chinese New Year, we visit our relatives in the countryside.
exzh: 過年期間，我們會去鄉下拜訪親戚。

en: Remember to bring your student ID card to the exam tomorrow.
exzh: 記得明天考試要帶學生證。
note: remember to V 記得要去做；remember V-ing 記得做過

en: My dad repaired the brakes on my bike last weekend.
exzh: 爸爸上週末修好了我腳踏車的煞車。

en: Could you repeat the question, please? I didn't hear it clearly.
exzh: 可以請你再說一次問題嗎？我沒聽清楚。

en: We have to finish a science report on climate change by Friday.
exzh: 我們週五前要完成一份關於氣候變遷的自然科報告。

en: A reporter came to our school to interview the basketball team.
exzh: 一位記者來我們學校採訪籃球隊。

en: You look tired, so take a short rest before you continue.
exzh: 你看起來很累，繼續之前先休息一下。

en: We celebrated Grandma's birthday at a Japanese restaurant near the station.
exzh: 我們在車站附近的日本餐廳幫奶奶慶生。

en: Excuse me, where is the restroom on this floor?
exzh: 不好意思，請問這層樓的洗手間在哪裡？

en: Lisa was happy with the result of her English speaking test.
exzh: Lisa 對她英文口說測驗的結果很滿意。
note: as a result 結果；result in 導致

en: Please return these books to the library before the end of June.
exzh: 請在六月底前把這些書還給圖書館。
note: return 已含 back 之意，不說 return back

en: Most Taiwanese families eat rice with vegetables and soup for dinner.
exzh: 大多數台灣家庭晚餐吃米飯配蔬菜和湯。

en: The rich man in the story gave money to help build a school.
exzh: 故事中的有錢人捐錢幫忙蓋一所學校。

en: Ben rides his bike to school every day, even when it rains.
exzh: Ben 每天騎腳踏車上學，即使下雨也一樣。

en: Turn right at the convenience store, and you will see the MRT station.
exzh: 在便利商店右轉，就會看到捷運站。

en: The phone rang during class, and everyone turned to look at Tom.
exzh: 上課時手機響了，大家都轉頭看 Tom。

en: The sun rises earlier in summer, so I wake up before six.
exzh: 夏天太陽升起得比較早，所以我六點前就醒了。

en: We rode our bikes along the river on a sunny Sunday afternoon.
exzh: 一個晴朗的星期天下午，我們沿著河邊騎腳踏車。

en: Be careful when you cross the road near the school.
exzh: 在學校附近過馬路時要小心。

en: Our science club built a small robot that can pick up trash.
exzh: 我們的科學社做了一台能撿垃圾的小機器人。

en: Kevin climbed onto a big rock to take photos of the ocean.
exzh: Kevin 爬上一塊大岩石去拍海的照片。

en: Mia played the role of the princess in our class play.
exzh: Mia 在我們班的話劇中扮演公主的角色。
note: play an important role in 在…扮演重要角色

en: The ball rolled down the hill and into the river.
exzh: 球滾下山坡，掉進河裡。

en: Amy wears a helmet when she uses her roller blades in the park.
exzh: Amy 在公園溜直排輪時會戴安全帽。

en: Leo got a pair of roller skates for his birthday last year.
exzh: Leo 去年生日收到一雙溜冰鞋。
note: a pair of roller skates 一雙溜冰鞋

en: Our family likes to watch fireworks from the roof of our building.
exzh: 我們家喜歡在大樓頂樓看煙火。

en: Ken cleans his room every Saturday morning before he plays basketball.
exzh: Ken 每週六早上打籃球前會打掃房間。
note: 作「空間」時不可數：make room for

en: The roots of this old tree go deep into the ground.
exzh: 這棵老樹的根深入地下。

en: Our class won the tug-of-war because we held the rope tightly.
exzh: 我們班贏了拔河比賽，因為我們緊緊抓住繩子。

en: Ben gave his mom a red rose on Mother's Day.
exzh: Ben 在母親節送給媽媽一朵紅玫瑰。
note: 也是 rise 的過去式

en: We sat at a round table and shared dishes at the restaurant.
exzh: 我們在餐廳坐圓桌一起分享菜餚。
note: all year round 一年到頭

en: Tom always sits in the front row so he can see the board.
exzh: Tom 總是坐在第一排，這樣才看得到黑板。

en: Emma rubbed her eyes because she stayed up late studying.
exzh: Emma 揉揉眼睛，因為她熬夜讀書。

en: These shoes have rubber soles, so they won't slip on wet floors.
exzh: 這雙鞋是橡膠鞋底，所以在濕地板上不會滑。
note: 英式 rubber＝橡皮擦，美式說 eraser

en: One rule in our classroom is that phones must stay off during lessons.
exzh: 我們教室有一條規定：上課時手機必須關機。
note: break the rules 違反規定

en: Can I borrow your ruler? I need to draw a straight line.
exzh: 可以借我你的尺嗎？我需要畫一條直線。

en: Leo runs around the school track every morning before class.
exzh: Leo 每天早上上課前繞著學校跑道跑步。
note: run–ran–run；run a shop 經營店家

en: Amy felt sad when her best friend moved to another city.
exzh: Amy 的好朋友搬到別的城市，她很難過。

en: Always wear a helmet to stay safe when you ride a bike.
exzh: 騎腳踏車時一定要戴安全帽確保安全。

en: For your safety, please do not run on the stairs.
exzh: 為了你的安全，請不要在樓梯上奔跑。

en: We watched the boats sail slowly across the lake at sunset.
exzh: 我們看著船在夕陽下緩緩駛過湖面。

en: Lisa usually has a chicken salad for lunch to stay healthy.
exzh: Lisa 午餐通常吃雞肉沙拉來保持健康。

en: These sneakers were on sale, so I bought them for half price.
exzh: 這雙球鞋在特價，所以我用半價買下。
note: on sale 特價；for sale 待售

en: The salesman showed my dad several phones with large screens.
exzh: 那位銷售員給爸爸看了幾支大螢幕手機。

en: Too much salt in your food is bad for your health.
exzh: 食物中鹽太多對健康不好。

en: Ken and I go to the same cram school after class.
exzh: Ken 和我下課後去同一家補習班。

en: We sat on the warm sand and watched the waves at Kenting.
exzh: 我們在墾丁坐在溫暖的沙子上看海浪。

en: I grabbed a ham sandwich from the convenience store for breakfast.
exzh: 我在便利商店買了一個火腿三明治當早餐。

en: Nothing satisfies my hunger better than a big bowl of beef noodles.
exzh: 沒有什麼比一大碗牛肉麵更能填飽我的肚子。

en: On Saturday, our family usually goes hiking in the mountains.
exzh: 星期六我們家通常會去爬山。

en: Kevin saves part of his pocket money every month to buy a new phone.
exzh: Kevin 每個月存下一部分零用錢要買新手機。

en: Our teacher says the test will be easier than last time.
exzh: 老師說這次考試會比上次簡單。

en: Mia is scared of dogs, so she walks quickly past them.
exzh: Mia 怕狗，所以經過時都走得很快。

en: The last scene of the movie made everyone in the theater cry.
exzh: 電影的最後一幕讓戲院裡每個人都哭了。

en: Our school has a big library and a new swimming pool.
exzh: 我們學校有一座大圖書館和新游泳池。
note: go to school 上學，不加 the

en: Emma loves science and wants to become a doctor in the future.
exzh: Emma 很喜歡自然科學，將來想當醫生。

en: My mom rides her scooter to work because it is faster than the bus.
exzh: 媽媽騎機車上班，因為比搭公車快。

en: Ben got a perfect score on the math quiz yesterday.
exzh: Ben 昨天數學小考拿了滿分。

en: Looking at a phone screen for too long can hurt your eyes.
exzh: 看手機螢幕太久可能會傷眼睛。

en: Swimming in the sea is fun, but always listen to the lifeguard.
exzh: 在海裡游泳很好玩，但一定要聽救生員的話。

en: Keelung is famous for its fresh seafood and busy night market.
exzh: 基隆以新鮮海鮮和熱鬧的夜市聞名。

en: Lisa searched online for cheap train tickets to Tainan.
exzh: Lisa 上網搜尋去台南的便宜火車票。

en: Autumn is the best season for hiking in Taiwan.
exzh: 秋天是在台灣爬山最好的季節。

en: Tom gave his seat on the MRT to an elderly woman.
exzh: Tom 在捷運上把座位讓給一位老太太。

en: Kevin finished second in the swimming race, just one second behind Leo.
exzh: Kevin 在游泳比賽得了第二名，只比 Leo 慢一秒。

en: For me, winning is secondary; having fun with my teammates matters more.
exzh: 對我來說，贏是次要的，和隊友一起享受樂趣更重要。

en: Can you keep a secret? We're planning a surprise party for Amy.
exzh: 你能保守祕密嗎？我們正在計畫給 Amy 一個驚喜派對。
note: keep a secret 保守祕密

en: The school secretary called my mom because I forgot my lunch.
exzh: 學校的祕書打電話給媽媽，因為我忘了帶午餐。

en: The reading section of the test took me almost forty minutes.
exzh: 考試的閱讀部分花了我將近四十分鐘。

en: I can see the ocean from my grandparents' house in Yilan.
exzh: 從宜蘭爺爺奶奶家可以看見海。

en: Our class planted sunflower seeds in the school garden this spring.
exzh: 今年春天我們班在學校花園種了向日葵種子。

en: Ken seems tired today because he stayed up late playing games.
exzh: Ken 今天看起來很累，因為他熬夜打電動。

en: My little cousins laughed loudly while playing on the seesaw in the park.
exzh: 我的小表弟妹在公園玩蹺蹺板時笑得好大聲。

en: Lisa seldom eats fast food because she wants to stay healthy.
exzh: Lisa 很少吃速食，因為她想保持健康。

en: Our teacher selected five students to join the speech contest.
exzh: 老師挑選了五位學生參加演講比賽。

en: It's selfish to eat all the snacks without sharing with your friends.
exzh: 吃光所有零食卻不跟朋友分享是很自私的。

en: The shop near our school sells cheap and tasty bubble tea.
exzh: 我們學校附近那家店賣便宜又好喝的珍珠奶茶。

en: Amy sent me a photo of her new puppy last night.
exzh: Amy 昨晚傳給我一張她新小狗的照片。

en: After junior high, Ben plans to attend a senior high school in Taichung.
exzh: 國中畢業後，Ben 打算就讀台中的一所高中。

en: Tom has a great sense of humor, and everyone loves talking to him.
exzh: Tom 很有幽默感，大家都喜歡跟他聊天。

en: Please write a sentence using each new word on the list.
exzh: 請用清單上每個新單字各造一個句子。

en: Our school's sports day is held every year in September.
exzh: 我們學校的運動會每年九月舉行。

en: Kevin hurt his knee in the game, but it wasn't serious.
exzh: Kevin 在比賽中弄傷膝蓋，但並不嚴重。

en: In the fairy tale, the king's servant brought the prince a golden key.
exzh: 在童話中，國王的僕人帶給王子一把金鑰匙。

en: That restaurant serves the best beef noodles in our neighborhood.
exzh: 那家餐廳供應我們這一帶最好吃的牛肉麵。

en: The food was good, but the service at the restaurant was slow.
exzh: 食物很好吃，但那家餐廳的服務很慢。

en: I set my alarm for six o'clock so I won't miss the bus.
exzh: 我把鬧鐘設在六點，這樣就不會錯過公車。

en: I usually get up at seven and leave home at seven thirty.
exzh: 我通常七點起床，七點半出門。

en: Mia turned seventeen last week, and her classmates surprised her with a cake.
exzh: Mia 上週滿十七歲，同學們準備了蛋糕給她一個驚喜。

en: My grandpa is seventy years old, but he still swims every morning.
exzh: 我爺爺七十歲了，但每天早上仍去游泳。

en: I have read this book several times because the story is so good.
exzh: 這本書我讀了好幾次，因為故事很精彩。

en: Please shake the bottle well before you drink the juice.
exzh: 喝果汁前請把瓶子搖勻。

en: Shall we meet at the MRT station at ten tomorrow morning?
exzh: 我們明天早上十點在捷運站見面好嗎？

en: Lisa made cookies in the shape of stars for the class party.
exzh: Lisa 為班上派對做了星星形狀的餅乾。
note: in good shape 身體狀況好

en: Ben shared his umbrella with me when it started to rain.
exzh: 下雨時 Ben 和我共撐他的傘。
note: share A with B 與 B 分享 A

en: We saw a huge shark swimming behind the glass at the aquarium.
exzh: 我們在水族館看到一隻巨大的鯊魚在玻璃後面游。

en: Be careful with that knife; it is very sharp.
exzh: 小心那把刀，它非常鋒利。
note: 反義 dull；at seven sharp 七點整

en: We fed the sheep with grass at a farm in Nantou.
exzh: 我們在南投的一座農場餵羊吃草。

en: Our teacher gave each of us a sheet of paper for the test.
exzh: 老師給我們每人一張考試用紙。
note: a sheet of paper 一張紙

en: Kevin put his trophies on the top shelf in his room.
exzh: Kevin 把他的獎盃放在房間最上層的架子上。

en: The sun is shining, so let's play basketball outside after school.
exzh: 陽光正燦爛，放學後我們去外面打籃球吧。

en: The ship carried hundreds of tourists from Kaohsiung to Penghu.
exzh: 那艘船載著數百名遊客從高雄到澎湖。

en: Ben wore a white shirt and tie for the school photo.
exzh: Ben 為了拍學校團體照穿了白襯衫、打領帶。

en: I need a new pair of running shoes for the club.
exzh: 我需要為社團買一雙新的跑鞋。
note: 常用複數；a pair of shoes 一雙鞋

en: Kevin shot the ball from the corner and scored three points.
exzh: Kevin 從底角出手投籃，得了三分。

en: Lisa likes to shop for clothes at the night market on weekends.
exzh: Lisa 週末喜歡去夜市買衣服。

en: The shopkeeper gave us a free drink because we bought so much.
exzh: 因為我們買了很多東西，店老闆送我們一杯免費飲料。

en: We walked along the shore and watched the sunset in Hualien.
exzh: 我們在花蓮沿著海岸散步，看夕陽。

en: Our lunch break is too short to finish both lunch and homework.
exzh: 我們的午休太短，沒辦法同時吃完午餐又寫完作業。
note: 反義 long／tall；be short of 缺乏

en: Tom always wears shorts to school, even in the winter.
exzh: Tom 總是穿短褲上學，連冬天也是。
note: 恆用複數；a pair of shorts

en: You should drink more water when you play sports in summer.
exzh: 夏天運動時你應該多喝水。
note: should + 原形動詞；should have + p.p. 當初應該

en: My shoulder hurts after carrying my heavy backpack all day.
exzh: 背了一整天沉重的背包後，我的肩膀好痛。

en: The fans shouted with joy when our team won the game.
exzh: 我們的隊伍贏得比賽時，球迷開心地大喊。
note: shout at sb 對某人吼叫

en: Mia showed me the photos she took on her trip to Japan.
exzh: Mia 給我看她去日本旅行時拍的照片。

en: I usually take a quick shower after basketball practice.
exzh: 我通常在籃球練習後快速沖個澡。

en: Please shut the window; it's getting cold in the classroom.
exzh: 請把窗戶關上，教室裡越來越冷了。

en: Emma was too shy to speak in front of the whole class.
exzh: Emma 太害羞了，不敢在全班面前說話。

en: Leo stayed home from school because he was sick with a cold.
exzh: Leo 因為感冒生病，所以請假在家沒去上學。
note: be sick of 厭煩；feel sick 想吐

en: The convenience store is on the other side of the street.
exzh: 便利商店在街道的另一邊。
note: on the other side of 在…的另一邊；side by side 並肩

en: Please ride your bike on the road, not on the sidewalk.
exzh: 請在馬路上騎腳踏車，不要騎在人行道上。

en: The sight of the mountains from the train was really beautiful.
exzh: 從火車上看到的山景真的很美。
note: at first sight 第一眼；sights 名勝

en: There was a long silence after our teacher asked the question.
exzh: 老師問了問題之後，全班沉默了好一陣子。

en: Please keep your phone silent during the exam.
exzh: 考試期間請把手機調成靜音。
note: 名詞 silence；keep silent 保持安靜

en: Ken made a silly face and made everyone in class laugh.
exzh: Ken 扮了個傻氣的鬼臉，逗得全班哈哈大笑。

en: Amy won a silver medal in the school swimming contest.
exzh: Amy 在學校游泳比賽中得到銀牌。

en: My sister and I have similar tastes in music and movies.
exzh: 我和我姊姊在音樂和電影上的喜好很相似。

en: The math question looked hard, but the answer was quite simple.
exzh: 這道數學題看起來很難，但答案其實很簡單。

en: Ben has played the guitar since he was in junior high.
exzh: Ben 從國中就開始彈吉他了。

en: We sang "Happy Birthday" to Lisa in the classroom at lunch.
exzh: 午餐時我們在教室裡為 Lisa 唱生日快樂歌。

en: My favorite singer is holding a concert in Taipei next month.
exzh: 我最喜歡的歌手下個月要在台北開演唱會。

en: We didn't make a single mistake in our English presentation.
exzh: 我們的英文報告連一個錯誤都沒有。
note: not a single… 一個也沒有；a single room 單人房

en: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the station is?
exzh: 先生，不好意思，可以告訴我車站在哪裡嗎？

en: My older sister helps me with my English homework every night.
exzh: 我姊姊每天晚上教我寫英文作業。

en: Kevin always sits next to the window in our classroom.
exzh: Kevin 在教室裡總是坐在窗邊。

en: Our school bus leaves at six thirty every morning.
exzh: 我們的校車每天早上六點半出發。

en: Mia will turn sixteen next week, so we're planning a party.
exzh: Mia 下週就滿十六歲了，所以我們正在計畫辦派對。

en: There are about sixty students in our school's dance club.
exzh: 我們學校的熱舞社大約有六十名學生。
note: 注意與 sixteen 的發音、重音不同

en: Do you have these sneakers in a bigger size?
exzh: 這雙運動鞋有大一號的尺寸嗎？
note: What size do you wear? 你穿幾號？

en: Joining the debate club helped me improve my speaking skills.
exzh: 參加辯論社幫助我提升了口說技巧。

en: Remember to put on sunscreen to protect your skin at the beach.
exzh: 在海邊記得擦防曬乳保護皮膚。

en: Our school uniform for girls includes a dark blue skirt.
exzh: 我們學校的女生制服包括一件深藍色裙子。

en: The sky turned dark, and it soon started to rain heavily.
exzh: 天空變暗了，很快就開始下起大雨。
note: in the sky 在天空中

en: I only slept five hours last night because of the exam.
exzh: 因為考試，我昨晚只睡了五個小時。

en: I always feel sleepy in the first class after lunch.
exzh: 午餐後的第一堂課我總是覺得很睏。
note: sleepy 想睡的；asleep 睡著的

en: Tom slid on the wet floor and almost dropped his lunch.
exzh: Tom 在濕滑的地板上滑了一下，差點把午餐掉到地上。

en: This slim laptop is light enough to carry to school every day.
exzh: 這台輕薄的筆電很輕，可以每天帶去學校。

en: My mom asks us to wear slippers inside the house.
exzh: 我媽媽要求我們在家裡穿拖鞋。
note: 常用複數；a pair of slippers

en: The internet at school is so slow that videos keep stopping.
exzh: 學校的網路好慢，影片一直卡住。
note: slow down 減速；副詞 slowly

en: Our classroom is small, but it has a great view of the mountains.
exzh: 我們的教室雖小，但能看到很棒的山景。

en: Leo is smart enough to solve the hardest math problems quickly.
exzh: Leo 很聰明，能很快解出最難的數學題。

en: The beef noodles smell so good that I feel hungry already.
exzh: 牛肉麵聞起來好香，我已經覺得餓了。

en: Emma smiled when she saw her high score on the test.
exzh: Emma 看到自己考試的高分時笑了。
note: smile at sb 對某人微笑

en: The smoke from the barbecue made my eyes hurt.
exzh: 烤肉冒出的煙讓我的眼睛好痛。

en: We bought some snacks at the convenience store before the movie.
exzh: 看電影前我們在便利商店買了一些零食。

en: After the rain, we saw a snail moving slowly across the path.
exzh: 下過雨後，我們看到一隻蝸牛慢慢爬過小路。
note: at a snail's pace 慢吞吞地

en: We saw a small snake on the trail while hiking in the mountains.
exzh: 我們在山上健行時，在步道上看到一條小蛇。

en: Lisa saw snow for the first time on her trip to Hokkaido.
exzh: Lisa 去北海道旅行時第一次看到雪。

en: We built a big snowman with my cousins during our winter trip.
exzh: 冬天旅行時，我們和表兄弟姊妹一起堆了一個大雪人。
note: build／make a snowman 堆雪人；複數 snowmen

en: It was a snowy day, so we stayed inside and drank hot chocolate.
exzh: 那天下著雪，所以我們待在室內喝熱可可。

en: It was raining hard, so we decided to stay home and study.
exzh: 雨下得很大，所以我們決定待在家讀書。

en: Wash your hands with soap and water before you eat.
exzh: 吃東西前要用肥皂和水洗手。
note: 不可數；a bar of soap 一塊肥皂

en: Ben plays soccer with his classmates every Friday after school.
exzh: Ben 每週五放學後和同學一起踢足球。

en: Kevin spends too much time on social media instead of studying.
exzh: Kevin 花太多時間在社群媒體上，而沒有讀書。

en: Young people can make our society better by helping others.
exzh: 年輕人可以藉由幫助他人，讓我們的社會變得更好。

en: I can never find matching socks when I'm late for school.
exzh: 上學快遲到時，我總是找不到成對的襪子。
note: 單數 sock；a pair of socks

en: Drinking too much soda is bad for your teeth and health.
exzh: 喝太多汽水對牙齒和健康都不好。

en: My dad fell asleep on the sofa while watching TV last night.
exzh: 我爸爸昨晚看電視時在沙發上睡著了。

en: Our school stopped selling soft drinks to help students stay healthy.
exzh: 我們學校為了讓學生保持健康，停止販售汽水。

en: Amy joined the softball team and practices every Tuesday afternoon.
exzh: Amy 加入了壘球隊，每週二下午練習。

en: My cousin worked as a soldier for a year after college.
exzh: 我表哥大學畢業後當了一年的兵。

en: Our group worked together to solve the science problem.
exzh: 我們這組一起合作解出這道自然題目。

en: Can I borrow some paper? I forgot to bring my notebook.
exzh: 我可以借一些紙嗎？我忘了帶筆記本。
note: 肯定句用 some，否定、疑問多用 any；請求時仍用 some

en: Somebody left a water bottle on my desk this morning.
exzh: 今天早上有人在我桌上留下一個水壺。

en: I need someone to help me carry these books to the library.
exzh: 我需要有人幫我把這些書搬到圖書館。

en: I'm hungry. Let's get something to eat after class.
exzh: 我餓了。下課後我們去吃點東西吧。

en: Sometimes I take the MRT to school when it rains.
exzh: 下雨時，我有時候會搭捷運上學。
note: sometime 某時；some time 一段時間

en: I left my phone somewhere in the gym, but I can't find it.
exzh: 我把手機忘在體育館的某個地方，卻找不到。

en: Our neighbor's son is in the same class as my brother.
exzh: 我們鄰居的兒子和我弟弟同班。

en: This song is so popular that everyone at school can sing it.
exzh: 這首歌超紅，學校裡每個人都會唱。

en: Hurry up! The bus will arrive soon, and we can't miss it.
exzh: 快點！公車很快就到了，我們不能錯過。

en: My legs were sore for two days after the school sports day.
exzh: 學校運動會後，我的腿痠痛了兩天。
note: have a sore throat 喉嚨痛

en: I'm sorry I'm late; the traffic was terrible this morning.
exzh: 對不起我遲到了，今天早上交通很塞。
note: feel sorry for sb 為某人感到難過

en: Music is food for the soul, so Mia listens to it every day.
exzh: 音樂是心靈的養分，所以 Mia 每天都聽。

en: Your plan for the class trip sounds great to me.
exzh: 我覺得你的校外教學計畫聽起來很棒。

en: My grandma makes chicken soup for me when I'm sick.
exzh: 我生病時，奶奶會煮雞湯給我喝。

en: This lemon juice is too sour; can you add some sugar?
exzh: 這杯檸檬汁太酸了，可以加點糖嗎？

en: Kenting is in the south of Taiwan and has beautiful beaches.
exzh: 墾丁位於台灣南部，有美麗的海灘。
note: in the south of 在…南部；southern 南方的

en: My mom adds a little soy sauce when she cooks fried rice.
exzh: 我媽媽炒飯時會加一點醬油。
note: 一般寫作 soy sauce（不加連字號）

en: There isn't enough space in my bag for all these books.
exzh: 我的包包空間不夠放下這些書。
note: 不可數；outer space 外太空

en: Lisa can speak English, Japanese, and a little Korean.
exzh: Lisa 會說英文、日文，還會一點韓文。

en: The speaker at our school assembly talked about protecting the ocean.
exzh: 我們學校週會的講者談到保護海洋。

en: My grandma cooked a special dinner for my birthday last night.
exzh: 奶奶昨晚為我的生日煮了一頓特別的晚餐。

en: Kevin gave a speech about recycling in front of the whole school.
exzh: Kevin 在全校面前發表了一場關於回收的演講。
note: give／make a speech 發表演講

en: Please slow down; you're riding your bike at a dangerous speed.
exzh: 請慢一點，你騎腳踏車的速度太危險了。
note: at a speed of 以…的速度；speed–sped–sped

en: Can you spell your name for me? I want to write it correctly.
exzh: 你可以拼一下你的名字嗎？我想把它寫對。

en: Tom spends too much money on snacks every week.
exzh: Tom 每週花太多錢買零食。
note: spend–spent–spent；spend + 時間／金錢 + on N 或 V-ing

en: Emma screamed when she saw a big spider in the bathroom.
exzh: Emma 在浴室看到一隻大蜘蛛時尖叫了起來。

en: Could you give me a spoon? I want to try the soup.
exzh: 可以給我一支湯匙嗎？我想嚐嚐這碗湯。

en: Ken is good at sports, especially basketball and swimming.
exzh: Ken 擅長運動，尤其是籃球和游泳。

en: This park is a popular spot for taking photos in spring.
exzh: 這座公園是春天熱門的拍照地點。

en: Cherry blossoms in the mountains are beautiful in early spring.
exzh: 早春時山上的櫻花很美。

en: We met our friends at the square in front of the station.
exzh: 我們在車站前的廣場和朋友碰面。

en: Our classroom is on the fifth floor, so we climb the stairs daily.
exzh: 我們的教室在五樓，所以每天都要爬樓梯。
note: go up／down the stairs 上／下樓梯；upstairs 樓上

en: I need a stamp to mail this postcard to my friend in Japan.
exzh: 我需要一張郵票，把這張明信片寄給在日本的朋友。

en: We had to stand on the crowded bus all the way to school.
exzh: 我們在擁擠的公車上一路站到學校。

en: We could see many stars in the sky at the campsite.
exzh: 在露營區我們可以看到天空中許多星星。

en: Our first class starts at eight o'clock in the morning.
exzh: 我們的第一堂課早上八點開始。

en: Amy's cousin lives in the state of California in the US.
exzh: Amy 的表姊住在美國的加州。
note: the United States 美國；動詞為「陳述」

en: Let's meet at the MRT station near the school at nine.
exzh: 我們九點在學校附近的捷運站碰面吧。
note: train station 火車站；gas station 加油站

en: We stayed at my grandparents' house in Tainan for the summer.
exzh: 我們暑假住在台南的祖父母家。
note: stay up 熬夜；stay + adj. 保持

en: On my birthday, my family went out for a steak dinner.
exzh: 我生日那天，家人一起去外面吃牛排大餐。

en: The first step to learning a language is not being afraid of mistakes.
exzh: 學習語言的第一步，就是不要害怕犯錯。
note: step by step 一步一步地

en: It's ten o'clock, but Ben is still doing his homework.
exzh: 已經十點了，但 Ben 還在寫功課。
note: 當形容詞為「靜止的」：stand still

en: Leo had a stomachache after eating too much spicy food.
exzh: Leo 吃了太多辣的食物後肚子痛。

en: We sat on a big stone by the river and ate our lunch.
exzh: 我們坐在河邊的一塊大石頭上吃午餐。

en: Please stop talking and listen to the teacher's instructions.
exzh: 請不要講話，專心聽老師的指示。
note: stop V-ing 停止做；stop to V 停下來去做

en: I stopped at the convenience store to buy breakfast before school.
exzh: 上學前我在便利商店停下來買早餐。

en: Classes were canceled because a strong storm hit Taiwan last night.
exzh: 因為昨晚強烈暴風雨侵襲台灣，學校停課了。

en: Our teacher told us a funny story about her first trip abroad.
exzh: 老師跟我們講了一個她第一次出國旅行的有趣故事。
note: tell a story 講故事；複數 stories

en: Go straight down this road, and the library is on your left.
exzh: 沿著這條路直走，圖書館就在你的左手邊。
note: go straight 直走；straight hair 直髮

en: I heard a strange noise coming from the kitchen late at night.
exzh: 深夜時我聽到廚房傳來奇怪的聲音。

en: My parents told me not to share personal information with strangers online.
exzh: 我爸媽告訴我不要在網路上和陌生人分享個人資料。

en: We went strawberry picking in Miaoli with our class last spring.
exzh: 去年春天我們班去苗栗採草莓。

en: There are many food stands on the street near our school.
exzh: 我們學校附近的街上有很多小吃攤。

en: One string on my guitar broke during club practice.
exzh: 社團練習時，我的吉他斷了一根弦。

en: Ken goes to the gym every week to get strong and healthy.
exzh: Ken 每週上健身房，讓自己變得強壯又健康。

en: Every student in our class has to give a short presentation.
exzh: 我們班上每個學生都要做一個簡短的報告。

en: Mia studies at the library every evening before the big exam.
exzh: 大考前，Mia 每天晚上都在圖書館讀書。
note: study–studied；study for a test 準備考試

en: I made a stupid mistake and forgot to write my name on the test.
exzh: 我犯了一個愚蠢的錯誤，忘了在考卷上寫名字。
note: 語氣強烈，避免用來罵人

en: I really like Emma's style; her clothes always look simple but cool.
exzh: 我很喜歡 Emma 的風格，她的穿著總是簡單又有型。

en: Math is my favorite subject, but English is the hardest for me.
exzh: 數學是我最喜歡的科目，但英文對我來說最難。

en: In big cities like Tokyo, many people take the subway to work.
exzh: 在像東京這樣的大城市，很多人搭地鐵上班。
note: 台灣的捷運常稱 MRT；英式作 underground

en: If you keep practicing, you will succeed in the end.
exzh: 只要你持續練習，最後一定會成功。

en: Our booth at the school fair was very successful; we sold everything.
exzh: 我們在校慶園遊會的攤位非常成功，東西全賣光了。

en: It was such a hot day that we stayed in the air-conditioned library.
exzh: 那天實在太熱了，所以我們待在有冷氣的圖書館裡。

en: The sudden rain made everyone run into the convenience store.
exzh: 突如其來的雨讓大家都跑進便利商店。
note: all of a sudden 突然；副詞 suddenly

en: I asked for my bubble tea with less sugar and no ice.
exzh: 我點的珍珠奶茶要少糖去冰。

en: Our teacher suggested that we read English news every day.
exzh: 老師建議我們每天讀英文新聞。

en: This summer, my family is going to travel around eastern Taiwan.
exzh: 今年夏天，我們全家要去東台灣旅行。

en: The sun was so strong that we stayed under the trees.
exzh: 太陽很大，所以我們待在樹下。

en: On Sunday, I usually sleep late and then go hiking with my family.
exzh: 星期日我通常睡晚一點，然後和家人去爬山。
note: 首字母大寫；on Sundays 每逢星期日

en: It's sunny today, so let's play basketball in the park after school.
exzh: 今天天氣晴朗，放學後我們去公園打籃球吧。

en: Lisa thinks the new bubble tea shop near our school is super.
exzh: Lisa 覺得我們學校附近那家新的珍奶店超棒。
note: 口語；也可當副詞「超級」：super easy

en: My mom buys fresh fruit and vegetables at the supermarket every weekend.
exzh: 我媽媽每個週末都在超市買新鮮的蔬菜水果。

en: We usually have supper together at seven after my dad gets home.
exzh: 我們通常在爸爸回家後，七點一起吃晚餐。
note: 與 dinner 意思相近；have supper 吃晚餐

en: Are you sure the math test is on Friday, not Thursday?
exzh: 你確定數學考試是在星期五，不是星期四嗎？
note: be sure of/about 確定；make sure 確保

en: Ken and his friends went to the beach to surf last summer.
exzh: 去年夏天 Ken 和他的朋友去海邊衝浪。
note: surf the Internet 上網瀏覽

en: We planned a birthday surprise for our teacher during lunch break.
exzh: 我們在午休時間為老師策劃了一個生日驚喜。
note: to one's surprise 令某人驚訝的是

en: Mia was surprised to get a perfect score on the English test.
exzh: Mia 英文考試拿到滿分，感到很驚訝。
note: 人 be surprised at/by；surprising 令人驚訝的

en: Take a big drink of water to help you swallow the pill.
exzh: 喝一大口水，幫助你把藥丸吞下去。

en: It was cold this morning, so Leo wore a thick sweater to school.
exzh: 今天早上很冷，所以 Leo 穿了一件厚毛衣去上學。

en: This bubble tea is too sweet, so next time I'll order less sugar.
exzh: 這杯珍奶太甜了，所以下次我要點少糖。

en: Ben swims in the school pool for an hour every Wednesday.
exzh: Ben 每週三在學校游泳池游泳一小時。
note: 不規則變化：swim–swam–swum；go swimming 去游泳

en: Don't forget to pack your swimsuit for our trip to Kenting.
exzh: 別忘了帶泳衣去我們的墾丁之旅。

en: Tom swung the bat hard and hit the ball over the fence.
exzh: Tom 用力揮棒，把球打過了圍牆。

en: The dove is often used as a symbol of peace around the world.
exzh: 鴿子在世界各地常被用來象徵和平。

en: Our class designed a special T-shirt for the school sports day.
exzh: 我們班為學校運動會設計了一件特別的 T 恤。

en: Please put your phones on the table before the meeting starts.
exzh: 會議開始前，請把手機放在桌上。

en: Kevin plays table tennis with his classmates after school every Friday.
exzh: Kevin 每週五放學後和同學打桌球。
note: play table tennis（球類運動前不加 the）

en: Our dog wags its tail happily whenever I come home from school.
exzh: 每當我放學回家，我們家的狗都會開心地搖尾巴。

en: Many tourists come to Taiwan to enjoy night markets and mountain views.
exzh: 許多觀光客來臺灣享受夜市和山景。
note: 專有名詞首字母大寫；Taiwanese 臺灣的／臺灣人

en: It takes me about twenty minutes to get to school by MRT.
exzh: 我搭捷運上學大約要花二十分鐘。
note: 不規則變化：take–took–taken；It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V

en: Amy and I talked about our weekend plans on the bus.
exzh: Amy 和我在公車上聊我們的週末計畫。
note: talk to/with sb 和某人說話；talk about sth 談論某事

en: Leo is the tallest player on our school basketball team.
exzh: Leo 是我們學校籃球隊裡最高的球員。
note: tall 多指人、樹、建築物；high 指高度或位置高

en: Can I borrow some tape to put this poster up on the wall?
exzh: 我可以借一點膠帶，把這張海報貼在牆上嗎？

en: This beef noodle soup tastes even better than my grandma's.
exzh: 這碗牛肉麵嚐起來比我奶奶煮的還好吃。
note: 感官動詞：taste + 形容詞（tastes good）

en: It was raining hard, so we took a taxi to the train station.
exzh: 雨下得很大，所以我們搭計程車去火車站。
note: take a taxi 搭計程車

en: My grandpa drinks a cup of hot tea every morning after breakfast.
exzh: 我爺爺每天早餐後都會喝一杯熱茶。

en: Emma teaches her little brother how to ride a bike on weekends.
exzh: Emma 週末教她弟弟騎腳踏車。
note: 不規則變化：teach–taught–taught；teach sb to V

en: Our English teacher always gives us useful tips before big tests.
exzh: 我們的英文老師總是在大考前給我們實用的訣竅。

en: Mia joined the school volleyball team and practices three times a week.
exzh: Mia 加入了學校排球隊，每週練習三次。

en: Grandma filled the teapot with hot water and served tea to our guests.
exzh: 奶奶把茶壺裝滿熱水，倒茶給客人喝。

en: Tears ran down Lisa's face when she watched the sad movie.
exzh: Lisa 看那部悲傷的電影時淚流滿面。

en: Many teenagers spend too much time on their phones every day.
exzh: 許多青少年每天花太多時間在手機上。
note: 指 13–19 歲；teen 為口語說法

en: Ken answered the telephone and told the caller that Dad was out.
exzh: Ken 接起電話，告訴對方爸爸出去了。

en: My family often watches baseball games on television on Sunday nights.
exzh: 我們家常在星期天晚上看電視轉播的棒球賽。
note: 簡稱 TV；on television 在電視上

en: Could you tell me how to get to the library from here?
exzh: 你可以告訴我從這裡怎麼去圖書館嗎？
note: 不規則變化：tell–told–told；tell A from B 分辨 A 與 B

en: We visited an old temple in Tainan during our class trip.
exzh: 我們校外教學時參觀了臺南的一座古老寺廟。

en: The bus to school comes every ten minutes in the morning.
exzh: 早上往學校的公車每十分鐘來一班。

en: Ben and his dad play tennis at the park every Saturday morning.
exzh: Ben 和他爸爸每週六早上在公園打網球。
note: play tennis（球類運動前不加 the）

en: Our final exams for this term will begin next Monday.
exzh: 我們這學期的期末考下週一開始。

en: The traffic was terrible this morning, so many students were late.
exzh: 今天早上交通很糟，所以很多學生遲到。

en: We have a history test tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
exzh: 我們明天有歷史考試，所以我今晚得讀書。
note: take a test 參加考試；pass/fail a test 通過／沒通過考試

en: Please open your textbook to page thirty and read the first paragraph.
exzh: 請把課本翻到第三十頁，讀第一段。

en: Taking the MRT is much faster than riding a scooter in the city.
exzh: 在市區搭捷運比騎機車快多了。
note: 比較級 + than；勿與 then 混淆

en: Amy thanked her friends for helping her prepare for the speech contest.
exzh: Amy 感謝朋友們幫她準備演講比賽。

en: Kevin told me that the school trip was canceled because of rain.
exzh: Kevin 告訴我，校外教學因為下雨取消了。
note: 複數為 those；也可當關係代名詞

en: Our drama club will perform a play at the city theater next month.
exzh: 我們的戲劇社下個月將在市立劇院演出一齣戲。

en: The students put their bags under their desks before the exam.
exzh: 考試前，學生們把書包放在桌子底下。

en: Our classroom is on the second floor, and theirs is on the third.
exzh: 我們的教室在二樓，他們的在三樓。
note: 所有格代名詞＝their + 名詞，後面不再接名詞

en: We finished our homework first and then went to play basketball.
exzh: 我們先寫完作業，然後去打籃球。
note: by then 到那時；since then 從那時起

en: There are thirty-two students in our class this year.
exzh: 今年我們班有三十二個學生。
note: There is/are + 名詞 表示「有」

en: These shoes are comfortable, so I wear them for running.
exzh: 這雙鞋很舒服，所以我穿它們去跑步。

en: This dictionary is so thick that it doesn't fit in my bag.
exzh: 這本字典厚到放不進我的包包。

en: Lock your bike carefully, or a thief might take it.
exzh: 把腳踏車鎖好，不然可能會被小偷牽走。

en: Mom cut the bread into thin slices for our sandwiches.
exzh: 媽媽把麵包切成薄片，幫我們做三明治。

en: The first thing I do every morning is check the weather forecast.
exzh: 我每天早上做的第一件事是查看天氣預報。

en: I think we should leave early to avoid the heavy traffic.
exzh: 我認為我們應該早點出發，以避開塞車。

en: Our class won third place in the school singing contest.
exzh: 我們班在學校歌唱比賽中得到第三名。

en: After running five laps, Tom felt really thirsty.
exzh: Tom 跑完五圈後覺得非常口渴。

en: My little sister will turn thirteen next month.
exzh: 我妹妹下個月就滿十三歲了。
note: 注意與 thirty（三十）的發音區別

en: The movie starts at seven thirty, so let's meet at seven.
exzh: 電影七點半開始，所以我們七點碰面吧。
note: 注意與 thirteen（十三）的發音區別

en: This is the best beef noodle shop in our neighborhood.
exzh: 這是我們這附近最好吃的牛肉麵店。

en: Those students over there are practicing for the dance contest.
exzh: 那邊那些學生正在為舞蹈比賽練習。

en: Though it was raining, the baseball team still practiced outside.
exzh: 雖然在下雨，棒球隊還是在外面練習。
note: ＝although，不可再與 but 連用；放句尾當副詞表「不過」

en: Lisa shared her thoughts about the book in our reading club.
exzh: Lisa 在讀書會上分享她對這本書的想法。
note: 也是 think 的過去式及過去分詞

en: More than three thousand people ran in the city marathon last Sunday.
exzh: 上星期天有三千多人參加城市馬拉松。
note: 前有數字時不加 s；thousands of 成千上萬的

en: We have three tests this week, so I'm very busy.
exzh: 我們這週有三個考試，所以我很忙。

en: I have a sore throat, so I'll drink some warm water.
exzh: 我喉嚨痛，所以我要喝點溫水。
note: have a sore throat 喉嚨痛

en: The train goes through a long tunnel before reaching Hualien.
exzh: 火車在抵達花蓮前會穿過一條長隧道。
note: go through 經歷；勿與 though、thorough 混淆

en: Please don't throw your trash on the ground after the picnic.
exzh: 野餐後請不要把垃圾丟在地上。
note: 不規則變化：throw–threw–thrown；throw away 丟掉

en: We heard loud thunder and saw lightning during the afternoon storm.
exzh: 下午的暴風雨中，我們聽到很大的雷聲，也看到閃電。

en: Our club meets every Thursday after school in the music room.
exzh: 我們社團每週四放學後在音樂教室集合。
note: 首字母大寫；縮寫 Thu. 或 Thurs.

en: Ben bought two tickets online for the concert next Saturday.
exzh: Ben 在網路上買了兩張下週六演唱會的票。

en: Mom asked me to tidy my room before my friends came over.
exzh: 媽媽要我在朋友來之前把房間整理好。

en: Leo learned how to tie a tie for the school graduation ceremony.
exzh: Leo 為了學校的畢業典禮學會打領帶。
note: 動詞 tie–tied–tied；tie a tie 打領帶

en: We saw a sleeping tiger at the zoo during our class trip.
exzh: 校外教學時，我們在動物園看到一隻正在睡覺的老虎。

en: The library is open till nine o'clock on weekdays.
exzh: 圖書館平日開到九點。

en: I don't have much time to play games during exam week.
exzh: 考試週我沒有很多時間玩遊戲。
note: on time 準時；in time 及時；three times 三次

en: Kevin lives in a tiny apartment near the train station.
exzh: Kevin 住在火車站附近一間很小的公寓。

en: Our teacher gave us some useful tips for writing English essays.
exzh: 老師給了我們一些寫英文作文的實用訣竅。

en: Emma felt tired after staying up late to study for the test.
exzh: Emma 為了準備考試熬夜，之後覺得很累。
note: be tired of 厭倦；tiring 令人疲累的

en: What is the title of the book you read for your report?
exzh: 你為了寫報告讀的那本書，書名是什麼？

en: Mia goes to the library after school to borrow novels.
exzh: Mia 放學後去圖書館借小說。
note: to + 地點表方向；to + 原形動詞表目的

en: I usually eat toast with peanut butter and drink milk for breakfast.
exzh: 我早餐通常吃吐司配花生醬，再喝牛奶。

en: Today is my best friend's birthday, so I bought her a cake.
exzh: 今天是我最好朋友的生日，所以我買了一個蛋糕給她。

en: Ken hurt his toe when he kicked the table by accident.
exzh: Ken 不小心踢到桌子，弄傷了腳趾。

en: Stinky tofu is a popular night market snack in Taiwan.
exzh: 臭豆腐是臺灣很受歡迎的夜市小吃。

en: Our family eats dinner together every night and talks about our day.
exzh: 我們家每晚一起吃晚餐，聊聊一天發生的事。

en: Please flush the toilet and wash your hands after using it.
exzh: 上完廁所請沖馬桶並洗手。

en: Grandma makes delicious tomato and egg soup for us on cold days.
exzh: 冷天時奶奶會為我們煮美味的番茄蛋花湯。

en: Remember to bring your swimsuit tomorrow because we have PE class.
exzh: 明天記得帶泳衣，因為我們有體育課。

en: The soup was so hot that I burned my tongue.
exzh: 湯太燙了，我燙到了舌頭。

en: There will be heavy rain tonight, so remember to close the windows.
exzh: 今晚會下大雨，所以記得關窗戶。

en: This jacket is too expensive, so I'll look for a cheaper one.
exzh: 這件夾克太貴了，所以我要找便宜一點的。
note: too…to V 太……而不能；表「也」放肯定句句尾

en: A dictionary app is a useful tool for learning new English words.
exzh: 字典應用程式是學習英文新單字的實用工具。

en: Leo went to the dentist because one of his teeth hurt.
exzh: Leo 因為有一顆牙齒痛，去看了牙醫。

en: Tom had a bad toothache after eating too much candy.
exzh: Tom 吃太多糖果後牙痛得很厲害。
note: have a toothache 牙痛；headache 頭痛

en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush for the three-day class trip.
exzh: 別忘了帶牙刷去三天的校外教學。

en: We climbed to the top of the mountain and enjoyed the view.
exzh: 我們爬到山頂，欣賞美麗的風景。

en: The topic of our class discussion today is saving energy at home.
exzh: 我們今天課堂討論的主題是在家節約能源。

en: The total cost of the class trip is about three thousand dollars.
exzh: 校外教學的總費用大約三千元。

en: Please don't touch the paintings in the museum.
exzh: 請不要觸摸博物館裡的畫作。
note: keep in touch 保持聯絡

en: The children ran toward the beach as soon as they got off the bus.
exzh: 孩子們一下公車就朝海灘跑去。
note: 英式常用 towards；attitude toward 對……的態度

en: Bring a towel and a bottle of water to the gym.
exzh: 帶一條毛巾和一瓶水去健身房。

en: My grandparents live in a small town near the mountains.
exzh: 我爺爺奶奶住在山邊的一個小鎮。

en: Ben donated his old toys to a children's center in our town.
exzh: Ben 把他的舊玩具捐給我們鎮上的兒童中心。

en: Taiwan does a lot of trade with countries in Asia and Europe.
exzh: 臺灣和亞洲及歐洲各國有大量的貿易往來。
note: trade A for B 用 A 換 B

en: Eating mooncakes during the Moon Festival is a family tradition in Taiwan.
exzh: 中秋節吃月餅是臺灣的家庭傳統。

en: There is always heavy traffic near the station at rush hour.
exzh: 尖峰時段車站附近總是很塞。
note: heavy traffic 交通繁忙；traffic jam 塞車；不可數

en: We took the train to Taichung to visit our cousins last weekend.
exzh: 上週末我們搭火車去臺中拜訪表兄弟姊妹。

en: Please take out the trash before the garbage truck comes tonight.
exzh: 今晚垃圾車來之前，請把垃圾拿出去。
note: 美式用法，英式說 rubbish；不可數

en: Emma wants to travel around Japan with her family next summer.
exzh: Emma 明年夏天想跟家人去日本各地旅行。
note: travel 多作動詞；名詞「一趟旅行」常用 trip

en: Our teacher treats every student fairly and listens to our ideas.
exzh: 我們老師公平對待每個學生，也會聽我們的想法。

en: We sat under a big tree and ate our lunch in the shade.
exzh: 我們坐在一棵大樹下，在樹蔭裡吃午餐。

en: Draw a triangle on the board and measure each of its angles.
exzh: 在黑板上畫一個三角形，量出它的每個角。

en: Kevin showed us a cool card trick during the class party.
exzh: Kevin 在班級派對上表演了一個很酷的撲克牌魔術。
note: play a trick on sb 捉弄某人

en: Our class is going on a trip to Taitung next month.
exzh: 我們班下個月要去臺東旅行。
note: take a trip 去旅行；field trip 校外教學

en: Mia had trouble falling asleep the night before the big exam.
exzh: Mia 大考前一晚很難入睡。
note: have trouble (in) V-ing 做……有困難

en: A big truck blocked the road, so our bus was late.
exzh: 一輛大卡車擋住了路，所以我們的公車誤點了。

en: Is it true that our school will have a new swimming pool?
exzh: 我們學校要蓋新游泳池是真的嗎？
note: come true 實現；名詞 truth

en: You can trust Lisa because she always keeps her promises.
exzh: 你可以信任 Lisa，因為她總是信守承諾。

en: Ken told his parents the truth about his low test score.
exzh: Ken 把考試考差的真相告訴了爸媽。

en: Let's try the new ramen shop near the MRT station tonight.
exzh: 我們今晚去試試捷運站附近那家新開的拉麵店吧。
note: try to V 努力做；try V-ing 試試看做

en: Squeeze a little toothpaste from the tube onto your toothbrush.
exzh: 從軟管擠一點牙膏到你的牙刷上。

en: We have PE class on Tuesday, so bring your sports shoes.
exzh: 我們星期二有體育課，所以記得帶運動鞋。
note: 首字母大寫；縮寫 Tue. 或 Tues.

en: Our English teacher told us that many Americans eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
exzh: 英文老師告訴我們，很多美國人在感恩節吃火雞。
note: 大寫 Turkey 指土耳其

en: Turn left at the convenience store, and you'll see the post office.
exzh: 在便利商店左轉，你就會看到郵局。
note: turn on/off 打開／關掉；It's your turn. 輪到你了。

en: We saw a sea turtle swimming near the shore on Green Island.
exzh: 我們在綠島看到一隻海龜在岸邊游泳。

en: My brother watches TV for an hour after finishing his homework.
exzh: 我弟弟寫完功課後會看一小時電視。
note: television 的縮寫；watch TV（不加 the）

en: There are twelve students in our school's photography club.
exzh: 我們學校的攝影社有十二個學生。

en: It takes twenty minutes to walk from my house to school.
exzh: 從我家走路到學校要二十分鐘。

en: Ben practices the piano twice a week at his teacher's house.
exzh: Ben 每週去老師家練兩次鋼琴。
note: once 一次；three times 三次

en: I usually spend two hours on homework every night.
exzh: 我每天晚上通常花兩小時寫功課。

en: What type of music do you like to listen to when studying?
exzh: 你讀書時喜歡聽什麼類型的音樂？

en: School was canceled yesterday because a strong typhoon hit northern Taiwan.
exzh: 昨天因為強烈颱風侵襲北臺灣，學校停課。

en: The old building looked ugly, but the inside was clean and bright.
exzh: 那棟舊大樓外表很醜，但裡面乾淨又明亮。

en: Take an umbrella with you because it might rain this afternoon.
exzh: 帶把傘吧，因為今天下午可能會下雨。
note: umbrella 以母音開頭，用 an

en: My uncle runs a small breakfast shop near our school.
exzh: 我叔叔在我們學校附近經營一家小早餐店。

en: Leo found his missing phone under the sofa in the living room.
exzh: Leo 在客廳沙發底下找到他不見的手機。

en: Ask the teacher if you don't understand the math problem.
exzh: 如果你不懂這題數學，就去問老師。

en: Students at our school must wear their uniforms on Mondays.
exzh: 我們學校的學生星期一必須穿制服。

en: My sister wants to study biology at a university in Taipei.
exzh: 我姊姊想去臺北的一所大學讀生物。
note: a university（u 發 /ju/ 音，用 a）

en: We waited at the bus stop until the rain finally stopped.
exzh: 我們在公車站一直等到雨終於停了。

en: Ben picked up his phone and called his mom right away.
exzh: Ben 拿起手機，馬上打電話給他媽媽。
note: 常見片語：get up、pick up、give up

en: Lisa uploaded the photos from our class trip to the group chat.
exzh: Lisa 把我們班遊的照片上傳到群組。

en: Upon arriving at the station, Kevin found that his train had left.
exzh: 一到車站，Kevin 就發現他的火車已經開走了。
note: 用法同 on，較正式；once upon a time 從前

en: The students in the upper grades help the new students find their classrooms.
exzh: 高年級的學生幫新生找教室。

en: My room is upstairs, so I can see the mountains from my window.
exzh: 我的房間在樓上，所以從窗戶就能看到山。
note: go upstairs 不加 to；反義 downstairs

en: We often use our phones to look up new words in English class.
exzh: 我們在英文課常用手機查生字。
note: used to + V 過去常常

en: This app is really useful for checking bus times in the morning.
exzh: 這個 app 早上查公車時間真的很有用。
note: a useful（u 發 /ju/ 音，用 a）

en: Tom got to school later than usual because his bike had a flat tire.
exzh: Tom 因為腳踏車爆胎，比平常晚到學校。

en: Emma usually takes the MRT to school, but today she walked.
exzh: Emma 通常搭捷運上學，但今天她走路。
note: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

en: Our family is going to Hualien for a week during summer vacation.
exzh: 暑假時我們家要去花蓮玩一個星期。

en: My grandfather taught me the value of hard work and saving money.
exzh: 我爺爺教我勤奮工作和存錢的價值。

en: My mom always tells me to eat more vegetables and less fried food.
exzh: 我媽總是叫我多吃蔬菜、少吃炸的東西。

en: The test was very hard, but most of us passed it.
exzh: 考試很難，但我們大部分人都及格了。
note: very 修飾原級；比較級要用 much

en: Leo made a short video about our school for the English contest.
exzh: Leo 為英文比賽拍了一支介紹我們學校的短片。

en: My grandparents live in a small village near the mountains in Nantou.
exzh: 我的祖父母住在南投山邊的一個小村莊。

en: Mia has played the violin in the school orchestra for three years.
exzh: Mia 在學校管弦樂團拉小提琴已經三年了。
note: play the violin（樂器前加 the）

en: We visited a science museum in Taichung on our class trip last week.
exzh: 我們上週班遊時去參觀了臺中的一間科學博物館。
note: pay a visit to 拜訪

en: Many visitors come to the night market to try the local snacks.
exzh: 很多遊客來夜市品嚐當地小吃。

en: Our class voted to have a party after the final exams.
exzh: 我們班投票決定期末考後辦派對。

en: These pants are too big for me around the waist.
exzh: 這條褲子的腰圍對我來說太大了。

en: Please wait for me at the school gate after club practice.
exzh: 社團練習完請在校門口等我。

en: The waiter brought us two bowls of beef noodles and some tea.
exzh: 服務生端給我們兩碗牛肉麵和一些茶。

en: The waitress at the breakfast shop always remembers what I like to order.
exzh: 早餐店的女服務生總是記得我喜歡點什麼。

en: I usually wake up at six to catch the early bus.
exzh: 我通常六點起床，好趕上早班公車。

en: Ken and his dog take a walk in the park every evening.
exzh: Ken 每天傍晚帶狗去公園散步。

en: Our teacher put our best drawings on the wall of the classroom.
exzh: 老師把我們最好的畫作貼在教室的牆上。

en: Kevin left his wallet at home, so I paid for his lunch.
exzh: Kevin 把皮夾忘在家裡，所以我幫他付午餐錢。

en: Lisa wants to join the dance club when the new semester starts.
exzh: Lisa 想在新學期開始時加入熱舞社。
note: want to + V；want + 人 + to V

en: We read a story about a family's life after the war in history class.
exzh: 我們在歷史課讀了一個關於一家人戰後生活的故事。

en: It's cold outside, so remember to bring a warm jacket.
exzh: 外面很冷，記得帶件保暖的外套。

en: After dinner, I help my dad wash the dishes in the kitchen.
exzh: 晚餐後，我在廚房幫爸爸洗碗。

en: Don't waste your time playing games the night before a big test.
exzh: 大考前一晚別浪費時間打電動。

en: We watched a basketball game on TV at Ben's house last night.
exzh: 我們昨晚在 Ben 家看電視上的籃球比賽。
note: watch 專心看（動態）；see 看見

en: Drink plenty of water when you play sports on hot days.
exzh: 大熱天運動時要多喝水。

en: We hiked for two hours to see the beautiful waterfalls in the mountains.
exzh: 我們健行兩個小時，去看山裡美麗的瀑布。

en: Nothing tastes better than cold watermelon on a hot summer afternoon.
exzh: 炎熱的夏日午後，沒有什麼比冰西瓜更好吃。

en: The waves were too big, so we couldn't swim at the beach.
exzh: 浪太大了，所以我們沒辦法在海邊游泳。

en: Riding a bike is a healthy way to get to school.
exzh: 騎腳踏車是一種健康的上學方式。
note: on the way 在途中；by the way 順帶一提

en: Amy felt weak after having a fever for three days.
exzh: Amy 發燒三天後覺得很虛弱。

en: Students have to wear their uniforms to school on Mondays.
exzh: 學生星期一必須穿制服到校。
note: wear–wore–worn；wear 指穿著狀態，put on 指穿上動作

en: The weather was so nice that we had lunch outside.
exzh: 天氣好到我們在外面吃午餐。

en: My whole family went to my cousin's wedding last Saturday.
exzh: 我們全家上星期六去參加了我表哥的婚禮。

en: We have PE class every Wednesday, so I bring sports shoes.
exzh: 我們每週三有體育課，所以我會帶運動鞋。

en: We have two big tests and a speech contest this week.
exzh: 我們這星期有兩個大考和一場演講比賽。

en: On weekdays, I go to bed early because I have school.
exzh: 平日我很早睡，因為要上學。

en: Ben and I often play basketball together on the weekend.
exzh: Ben 和我週末常一起打籃球。

en: Kevin started running every morning to lose some weight.
exzh: Kevin 開始每天早上跑步來減重。

en: Our class held a small party to welcome the new exchange student.
exzh: 我們班辦了一個小派對歡迎新來的交換學生。

en: Mia sings so well that she won first place in the contest.
exzh: Mia 唱得很好，在比賽中拿下第一名。

en: Our school is on the west side of the city, near the river.
exzh: 我們學校在城市的西邊，靠近河邊。

en: I forgot my umbrella, so my shoes got wet in the rain.
exzh: 我忘了帶傘，所以鞋子被雨淋濕了。
note: get wet 弄濕；反義 dry

en: On our trip to Hualien, we took a boat to watch whales.
exzh: 我們去花蓮玩時，搭船去賞鯨。

en: What I need most before the exam is a good night's sleep.
exzh: 考試前我最需要的是一夜好眠。
note: what 引導名詞子句＝the thing(s) that

en: The front wheel of my bike is broken, so I took the bus.
exzh: 我腳踏車的前輪壞了，所以我搭公車。

en: When I got home, my mom was already cooking dinner.
exzh: 我到家時，我媽已經在煮晚餐了。
note: 表未來的 when 子句用現在式代替未來式

en: Do you know where the new library is on campus?
exzh: 你知道新圖書館在校園的哪裡嗎？
note: 間接問句用直述句語序

en: Leo isn't sure whether he should join the basketball team or the band.
exzh: Leo 不確定他該參加籃球隊還是樂隊。

en: This is the bakery which sells the best bread in our town.
exzh: 這就是我們鎮上賣最好吃麵包的那家麵包店。

en: My phone rang while I was taking a shower last night.
exzh: 我昨晚洗澡時手機響了。
note: while + 進行式；for a while 一會兒

en: Our school uniform is a white shirt with dark blue pants.
exzh: 我們的制服是白襯衫配深藍色長褲。

en: The girl who sits next to me is really good at math.
exzh: 坐我旁邊的那個女生數學很好。

en: Tom spent the whole weekend studying for the math test.
exzh: Tom 花了整個週末準備數學考試。
note: the whole + 單數名詞；同音 hole 洞

en: Whose phone is this? I found it on my desk.
exzh: 這是誰的手機？我在我桌上發現的。

en: Can you tell me why you were late for class this morning?
exzh: 你可以告訴我你今天早上為什麼上課遲到嗎？
note: 間接問句用直述句語序

en: The road in front of our school is wide and has a bike lane.
exzh: 我們學校前面的馬路很寬，還有自行車道。

en: Our English teacher and his wife often hike on weekends.
exzh: 我們的英文老師和他太太週末常去爬山。

en: We saw some wild monkeys on our hike up the mountain.
exzh: 我們爬山時看到一些野生猴子。

en: I will call you as soon as I get to the station.
exzh: 我一到車站就打電話給你。

en: Our team won the basketball game by just two points.
exzh: 我們隊以兩分之差贏了籃球比賽。
note: win–won–won；win 比賽，beat 打敗對手

en: The wind was so strong that my umbrella broke on the way home.
exzh: 風大到我的傘在回家路上壞掉了。

en: Could you open the window? It's really hot in here.
exzh: 你可以開窗嗎？這裡面真的好熱。

en: It was too windy to fly our kites at the beach yesterday.
exzh: 昨天海邊風太大，沒辦法放風箏。

en: The little bird hurt its wing, so we took it to the vet.
exzh: 那隻小鳥翅膀受傷了，所以我們帶牠去看獸醫。

en: The winner of the speech contest will get a new tablet.
exzh: 演講比賽的優勝者將獲得一臺新平板。

en: In winter, my family likes to eat hot pot together.
exzh: 冬天時，我們家喜歡一起吃火鍋。

en: It was wise of you to bring an umbrella today.
exzh: 你今天帶傘真是明智。
note: It is wise of + 人 + to V；名詞 wisdom

en: I wish I could sleep a little longer on school days.
exzh: 真希望上學日能多睡一會兒。
