note: wish + 過去式，表與現在事實相反

en: Amy went to the night market with her friends after school.
exzh: Amy 放學後和朋友去逛夜市。

en: Ken left home without eating breakfast because he got up late.
exzh: Ken 因為晚起，沒吃早餐就出門了。

en: My dad cooked fried rice in a big wok for the whole family.
exzh: 我爸用一個大炒菜鍋為全家人炒飯。

en: Our biology teacher showed us a video about how wolves live in groups.
exzh: 生物老師給我們看了一部關於狼如何群居的影片。

en: The woman at the front desk helped us find the right classroom.
exzh: 櫃臺的那位女士幫我們找到正確的教室。

en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the women's room is?
exzh: 不好意思，可以告訴我女廁在哪裡嗎？
note: 男廁 men's room；也說 ladies' room

en: We had a wonderful time at the beach during the summer vacation.
exzh: 我們暑假在海邊玩得很愉快。
note: have a wonderful time 玩得愉快

en: The desks in our art room are made of wood.
exzh: 我們美術教室的桌子是木頭做的。

en: We walked through the woods and found a small, quiet lake.
exzh: 我們穿過樹林，發現了一座安靜的小湖。
note: woods 樹林（比 forest 小）

en: I try to learn ten new English words every day.
exzh: 我試著每天學十個新的英文單字。
note: in other words 換句話說

en: My mom works at a hospital and often comes home late.
exzh: 我媽在醫院工作，常常很晚回家。

en: Please finish pages 20 to 25 in your workbook by Friday.
exzh: 請在星期五前寫完作業簿第 20 到 25 頁。

en: The workers are fixing the road near our school this week.
exzh: 這星期工人在修我們學校附近的路。

en: Leo hopes to travel around the world after he finishes university.
exzh: Leo 希望大學畢業後環遊世界。

en: After the heavy rain, there were many worms on the sidewalk.
exzh: 大雨過後，人行道上有很多蚯蚓。

en: Don't worry about the test; you've studied really hard.
exzh: 別擔心考試，你已經很用功了。

en: Would you like to have lunch with us in the cafeteria?
exzh: 你想和我們一起在學生餐廳吃午餐嗎？
note: Would you like…? 禮貌邀請

en: The nurse cleaned the wound on my knee after I fell in PE class.
exzh: 我體育課跌倒後，護理師幫我清理膝蓋的傷口。
note: 讀 /wund/；另為 wind（纏繞）的過去式 /waʊnd/

en: Our teacher asked us to write a short story about our summer.
exzh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於暑假的短篇故事。

en: Emma loves reading and wants to become a writer someday.
exzh: Emma 熱愛閱讀，希望有一天成為作家。

en: I got on the wrong bus and ended up late for school.
exzh: 我搭錯公車，結果上學遲到了。

en: Our dog loves to run and play in the yard behind our house.
exzh: 我們家的狗喜歡在屋後的院子裡跑來跑去。

en: Yeah, I finished my homework, so I can go out now.
exzh: 對啊，我寫完作業了，所以現在可以出門了。

en: Kevin has been playing the guitar for almost three years.
exzh: Kevin 彈吉他快三年了。

en: The leaves on the trees turn yellow in late fall.
exzh: 樹上的葉子在晚秋時變黃。

en: When our teacher asked for volunteers, Mia was the first to say yes.
exzh: 老師找自願者時，Mia 是第一個說好的。

en: I left my math book at school yesterday, so I couldn't do my homework.
exzh: 我昨天把數學課本忘在學校，所以沒辦法寫作業。

en: I haven't finished my science report yet, and it's due tomorrow.
exzh: 我還沒寫完自然報告，而且明天就要交了。
note: 用於否定句、疑問句；肯定句用 already

en: When my dad was young, he walked to school every day.
exzh: 我爸年輕的時候，每天走路上學。

en: My phone's battery is dead. Can I use yours for a minute?
exzh: 我手機沒電了，可以借用你的一下嗎？
note: 所有格代名詞＝your + 名詞

en: Take care of yourself and get some rest before the exam.
exzh: 考試前好好照顧自己，多休息。
note: 複數 yourselves；by yourself 獨自

zh: 青春；青少年時期；年輕人
en: My grandmother often tells us stories about her youth in the countryside.
exzh: 我奶奶常跟我們說她在鄉下度過的年少時光。

en: The beef noodles at this shop are really yummy and cheap.
exzh: 這家店的牛肉麵真的好吃又便宜。

en: We saw zebras and giraffes at the zoo on our class trip.
exzh: 我們班遊時在動物園看到斑馬和長頸鹿。

en: It was so cold on the mountain that the temperature dropped below zero.
exzh: 山上冷到氣溫降到零度以下。

en: Our family went to the zoo to see the new baby panda.
exzh: 我們全家去動物園看新出生的熊貓寶寶。

zh: 做；（助動詞，構成問句與否定）
en: Did you do your English homework before dinner?
exzh: 你晚餐前有做英文作業嗎？
note: do–did–done；第三人稱單數 does；do homework 寫作業

en: My father drives me to school when it rains.
exzh: 下雨時，我爸爸會開車送我上學。
note: 口語作 dad；Father's Day 父親節

en: Lisa waved goodbye to her friends at the MRT station.
exzh: Lisa 在捷運站向朋友揮手道別。
note: 也寫作 good-bye；口語作 bye；say goodbye to sb. 向某人道別

zh: 有；吃、喝；（助動詞，構成完成式）
en: We have PE class on Tuesday and Friday this semester.
exzh: 這學期我們星期二和星期五有體育課。
note: have–had–had；第三人稱單數 has；have to 必須

en: Ben is my classmate, and he is good at basketball.
exzh: Ben 是我的同學，他很會打籃球。

en: Amy lost her phone, so I helped her look for it.
exzh: Amy 弄丟了她的手機，所以我幫她找。
note: 主格 she；her 可當受格（help her）也可當所有格（her phone）

en: Mia taught herself to play the guitar by watching videos.
exzh: Mia 看影片自學彈吉他。
note: teach oneself 自學；by herself 她獨自

en: Kevin was sick, so we called him after school.
exzh: Kevin 生病了，所以我們放學後打電話給他。

en: Tom cut himself while he was making a salad.
exzh: Tom 做沙拉時割傷了自己。
note: by himself 他獨自；enjoy himself 他玩得開心

en: I usually take the bus to school with my sister.
exzh: 我通常和妹妹一起搭公車上學。
note: 永遠大寫；受格 me；所有格 my

zh: 它；牠；（指天氣、時間、距離等）
en: It rained all day, so our soccer game was canceled.
exzh: 下了一整天的雨，所以我們的足球比賽取消了。
note: It is…to… 句型的虛主詞；所有格 its

en: The cat is licking its paws on the sofa.
exzh: 貓正在沙發上舔牠的爪子。
note: its 是所有格；it's ＝ it is／it has，不要混淆

en: The robot can clean the floor and charge itself.
exzh: 這台機器人會掃地，也會自己充電。
note: by itself 單獨地；自動地

en: Could you send me the photos from the class trip?
exzh: 你可以把校外教學的照片傳給我嗎？
note: 主格 I；介系詞、動詞後面用 me

en: My mother makes beef noodles for us every Sunday.
exzh: 我媽媽每個星期天都會煮牛肉麵給我們吃。
note: 口語作 mom；Mother's Day 母親節

en: I made this birthday card for Emma by myself.
exzh: 我自己一個人做了這張給 Emma 的生日卡片。
note: by myself 我獨自；help myself 自己來（取用）

en: We cleaned the classroom ourselves before the school festival.
exzh: 校慶前，我們自己把教室打掃乾淨。
note: by ourselves 我們自己；enjoy ourselves 我們玩得開心

en: Emma loves animals, and she wants to be a vet.
exzh: Emma 很愛動物，她想當獸醫。

en: I bought some apples and put them in the fridge.
exzh: 我買了一些蘋果，把它們放進冰箱。

en: The students made the posters for the club fair themselves.
exzh: 學生們自己製作社團博覽會的海報。

en: Leo and Ken missed the bus, so they were late for class.
exzh: Leo 和 Ken 錯過了公車，所以上課遲到了。

en: Our teacher gave us ten minutes to finish the quiz.
exzh: 老師給我們十分鐘完成小考。

en: We are going to visit the night market after the game.
exzh: 比賽結束後，我們要去逛夜市。

en: Are you free after school today, Mia?
exzh: Mia，你今天放學後有空嗎？
note: 單複數同形；所有格 your

en: Don't forget to bring your PE clothes tomorrow.
exzh: 明天別忘了帶你的體育服。
note: your 是所有格；you're ＝ you are，不要混淆

en: Help yourselves to the snacks on the table, everyone.
exzh: 大家，桌上的點心請自己拿。
note: 單數為 yourself；help yourselves to… 請自行取用…
